Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `UPDATE` Anweisung mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.
    rv_success = COND abap_bool( WHEN sy-dbcnt = 1 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_single_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_single_flight.
    " Setup: Insert a dummy flight for testing
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '0400'
      fldate = sy-datum
      price = '100.00'
      currency = 'EUR'
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight.
    COMMIT WORK. " Ensure data is visible

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = sy-datum
      iv_new_price = '150.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Verify: Read the updated flight
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_updated_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_price exp = '150.00' ).

    " Teardown: Delete the dummy flight
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UPDATE` Anweisung ist die Standardmethode zur Änderung von Datenbankeinträgen. Die Verwendung von `sy-dbcnt` in einer `COND` Expression ist eine moderne Art, den Erfolg der Operation zu überprüfen.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, SQL

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von N eindeutigen Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` in einer Schleife und prüfen Sie die Einzigartigkeit mit `line_exists`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_ints
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_ints.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = iv_min max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_new_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Check for uniqueness
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_temp_numbers[ table_line = lv_new_num ] ).
        APPEND lv_new_num TO lt_temp_numbers.
      ELSE.
        " If not unique, try again (decrement loop counter)
        sy-index = sy-index - 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rt_random_numbers = lt_temp_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random_ints FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unique_random_ints_full_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_ints.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_randoms) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 iv_count = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_randoms ) exp = 5 ).
    " Check for uniqueness using REDUCE with GROUP BY
    DATA(lv_unique_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR num IN lt_randoms WHERE ( num IS NOT INITIAL ) GROUP BY num WITHOUT MEMBERS ADD 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_count exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unique_random_ints_full_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_randoms) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 3 iv_count = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_randoms ) exp = 3 ).
    " Check for uniqueness and range
    LOOP AT lt_randoms INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 3 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_unique_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR num IN lt_randoms WHERE ( num IS NOT INITIAL ) GROUP BY num WITHOUT MEMBERS ADD 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unique_count exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode verwendet `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und eine Schleife, um die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen zu generieren. `line_exists` wird verwendet, um die Einzigartigkeit effizient zu prüfen, während `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` im Unit-Test die moderne Überprüfung der Einzigartigkeit demonstriert.
keywords: RANDOM, UNIQUE, INTERNAL TABLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, REDUCE

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen Prozentsatz.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `UPDATE` Anweisung mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und arithmetischen Operationen direkt in der `SET`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_mass_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increase_prices_by_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_mass_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices_by_percentage.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 )
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    " Setup: Insert dummy flights
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'.
    DATA(lt_sflights_initial) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_mass_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->increase_prices_by_percentage(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_percentage = '10'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 2 ).

    " Verify: Read updated prices
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_updated)
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND fldate = sy-datum.
    SORT lt_sflights_updated BY connid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_updated[ 1 ]-price exp = '110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_updated[ 2 ]-price exp = '220.00' ).

    " Teardown
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Direkte arithmetische Operationen in der `SET`-Klausel der `UPDATE`-Anweisung sind effizient und vermeiden das Lesen und erneute Schreiben von Daten, was die Performance bei Massenaktualisierungen verbessert.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, SQL, PERCENTAGE

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig (Shuffle).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und entfernen Sie Elemente aus der Quelltabelle, um sie der Zieltabelle hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_working_table) = it_original_table.
    DATA(lv_original_size) = lines( lt_working_table ).

    IF lv_original_size = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO lv_original_size TIMES. " Loop as many times as original size
      DATA(lv_current_size) = lines( lt_working_table ).
      DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_current_size ).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      APPEND lt_working_table[ lv_random_index ] TO rt_shuffled_table.
      DELETE lt_working_table INDEX lv_random_index.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_single_entry_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    " Check if all original elements are present (count occurrences)
    DATA(lv_original_sum) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR item IN lt_original SORTED BY item ASCENDING ADD s && item ).
    DATA(lv_shuffled_sum) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR item IN lt_shuffled SORTED BY item ASCENDING ADD s && item ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_shuffled_sum exp = lv_original_sum ).
    " Cannot assert order, as it's random. Just check content and size.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_shuffled ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_single_entry_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ( 'Single' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled[ 1 ] exp = 'Single' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode implementiert einen Fisher-Yates-Shuffle-Algorithmus, indem sie in jeder Iteration ein zufälliges Element aus der verbleibenden Quelltabelle auswählt und es der Ergebnistabelle hinzufügt. Dies gewährleistet eine gleichmäßige Zufallsverteilung.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLE, SHUFFLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, DELETE

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie Flugdatensätze basierend auf einer dynamisch erstellten `WHERE`-Klausel, die aus einer internen Tabelle von Schlüsselwerten generiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `UPDATE` Anweisung mit einer internen Tabelle in der `WHERE`-Klausel (`WHERE (itab)`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights_key " sflights_key is a structure with primary keys of sflights
        iv_new_currency TYPE s_curr_code
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_dynamic.
    IF it_flight_keys IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflights SET currency = iv_new_currency
        WHERE (it_flight_keys). " Dynamic WHERE clause using internal table
      rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF sflights_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF sflights_key.
    METHODS test_dynamic_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_update.
    " Setup: Insert dummy flights
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'ZZ'.
    DATA(lt_sflights_initial) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Prepare dynamic conditions (keys for flights to update)
    DATA(lt_keys_to_update) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights_key(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_dynamic_update( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_flights_dynamic(
      it_flight_keys = lt_keys_to_update
      iv_new_currency = 'GBP'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 1 ).

    " Verify
    SELECT SINGLE currency FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_currency_0001)
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_currency_0001 exp = 'GBP' ).

    SELECT SINGLE currency FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_currency_0002)
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = '0002' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_currency_0002 exp = 'USD' ). " Should be unchanged

    " Teardown
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHERE (itab)`-Syntax ermöglicht die dynamische Angabe von Bedingungen für Datenbankoperationen, indem eine interne Tabelle mit Schlüsselwerten verwendet wird. Dies ist eine moderne und sichere Alternative zu rein dynamischem SQL, wenn die Bedingungen auf Primärschlüsseln basieren.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE, DYNAMIC SQL, WHERE (itab), SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines bestimmten Jahresbereichs.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für Jahr, Monat, Tag und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_valid_date` zur Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_year TYPE i
        iv_max_year TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    DATA(lv_year) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = iv_min_year max = iv_max_year )->get_next( ).
    DATA(lv_month) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 12 )->get_next( ).
    DATA(lv_day) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 31 )->get_next( ).

    DATA(lv_date_str) = |{ lv_year ALPHA = OUT }{ lv_month ALPHA = OUT PAD LEFT = '0' }{ lv_day ALPHA = OUT PAD LEFT = '0' }|.

    TRY.
        rv_random_date = cl_abap_context_info=>get_valid_date( lv_date_str ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_date.
        " If generated date is invalid (e.g., Feb 30), try again recursively
        rv_random_date = get_random_date( iv_min_year = iv_min_year iv_max_year = iv_max_year ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_date_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_date_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_min_year) = 2000.
    DATA(lv_max_year) = 2020.
    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->get_random_date( iv_min_year = lv_min_year iv_max_year = lv_max_year ).

    DATA(lv_random_year) = lv_random_date(4).

CLASS zcl_sflight_conditional_upd IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Wählen Sie N zufällige, eindeutige Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle aus, ohne die Reihenfolge der Originaltabelle zu ändern.
hint: Generieren Sie zufällige Indizes und verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` mit `line_exists` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sample_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_sample
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
        iv_sample_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sample_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sample_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sample.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_original_table ).
    IF lv_table_size = 0 OR iv_sample_size <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_selected_indices) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).

    DO iv_sample_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_selected_indices[ table_line = lv_random_index ] ).
        APPEND lv_random_index TO lt_selected_indices.
      ELSE.
        sy-index = sy-index - 1. " Try again if index already selected
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Sort indices to maintain original table order in sample
    SORT lt_selected_indices ASCENDING.

    rt_sample_table = VALUE #( FOR index IN lt_selected_indices ( it_original_table[ index ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_sample FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_sample_too_large FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_sample_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_sample.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ( 'F' ) ( 'G' ) ( 'H' ) ( 'I' ) ( 'J' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sample_table( ).
    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_original_table = lt_original iv_sample_size = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sample ) exp = 3 ).
    " Check if all elements in sample are from original table
    LOOP AT lt_sample INTO DATA(lv_item).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_original[ table_line = lv_item ] ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
    " Check if sample is sorted (due to sorting of indices)
    DATA(lv_is_sorted) = abap_true.
    IF lines( lt_sample ) > 1.
      LOOP AT lt_sample INTO DATA(lv_current_item).
        IF sy-tabix > 1.
          READ TABLE lt_sample INDEX sy-tabix - 1 INTO DATA(lv_previous_item).
          IF lv_current_item < lv_previous_item.
            lv_is_sorted = abap_false.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_sorted exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_sample_too_large.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sample_table( ).
    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_original_table = lt_original iv_sample_size = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sample ) exp = 2 ). " Should return all unique elements if sample size > table size
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_sample_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sample_table( ).
    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_original_table = lt_original iv_sample_size = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_sample ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode generiert eine Menge eindeutiger Zufallsindizes und verwendet dann eine `FOR`-Iteration, um die entsprechenden Elemente aus der Originaltabelle zu extrahieren. Das Sortieren der Indizes vor der Extraktion stellt sicher, dass die Reihenfolge der Elemente aus der Originaltabelle im Sample beibehalten wird.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLE, SAMPLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, FOR, VALUE

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung in `sflights` durch, wobei die zu aktualisierenden Werte aus einer anderen internen Tabelle stammen (Join-Update).
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM ... JOIN` Syntax für effiziente Join-Updates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_join_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             new_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_update,
           ty_flight_update_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flights_from_itab
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE ty_flight_update_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_join_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_from_itab.
    UPDATE sflights AS sf
      SET price = up-new_price
      FROM @it_updates AS up
      WHERE sf~carrid = up~carrid
        AND sf~connid = up~connid
        AND sf~fldate = up~fldate.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             new_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_update,
           ty_flight_update_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Prepare update data in an internal table
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE ty_flight_update_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum new_price = '115.00' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum new_price = '230.00' )

JOIN` Syntax (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.54) ermöglicht es, Daten in einer Datenbanktabelle basierend auf Werten aus einer internen Tabelle oder einer anderen Datenbanktabelle zu aktualisieren. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und effiziente Methode für komplexe Massenaktualisierungen, da der Join direkt auf der Datenbankebene erfolgt.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Status von Flügen in `sflights` basierend auf einer zufälligen Auswahl von Flügen, die noch nicht abgeschlossen sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` und `UPDATE` mit einer zufälligen Auswahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_random_status_upd DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_random_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_num_flights TYPE i
        iv_new_status TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_random_status_upd IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_random_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_flights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights_key.

    " Select potential flights for update (e.g., those not yet 'COMPLETED')
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_available_flights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND price IS NOT INITIAL. " Using price IS NOT INITIAL as a proxy for 'not completed' for demo

    DATA(lv_available_count) = lines( lt_available_flights ).
    IF lv_available_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sample_size) = COND i( WHEN iv_num_flights > lv_available_count THEN lv_available_count ELSE iv_num_flights ).

    DATA(lo_random_selector) = NEW zcl_random_sample_table( ). " Reusing rnd_006 logic
    DATA(lt_random_keys) = lo_random_selector->get_random_sample(
      it_original_table = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( FOR flight IN lt_available_flights ( |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate }| ) )
      iv_sample_size = lv_sample_size
    ).

    " Convert back to sflights_key structure for WHERE (itab)
    lt_flights_to_update = VALUE #( FOR key_str IN lt_random_keys
                                    LET lv_carrid = SUBFIELD( val = key_str sep = '-' index = 1 )
                                        lv_connid = SUBFIELD( val = key_str sep = '-' index = 2 )
                                        lv_fldate = SUBFIELD( val = key_str sep = '-' index = 3 ) IN
                                    ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate ) ).

    IF lt_flights_to_update IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflights SET currency = iv_new_status " Using currency field as a proxy for 'status' for demo
        WHERE (lt_flights_to_update).
      rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF sflights_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF sflights_key.
    METHODS test_random_status_update FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_status_update.
    " Setup: Insert dummy flights
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'CC'.
    DATA(lt_sflights_initial) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'OPEN' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'OPEN' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = '300.00' currency = 'OPEN' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0004' fldate = sy-datum price = '400.00' currency = 'OPEN' )
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_random_status_upd( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_random_flight_status(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_num_flights = 2
      iv_new_status = 'CLOSED'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 2 ).

    " Verify: Check updated statuses
    SELECT carrid, connid, currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_final)
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND fldate = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_closed_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN lt_sflights_final WHERE ( flight-currency = 'CLOSED' ) ADD 1 ).
    DATA(lv_open_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN lt_sflights_final WHERE ( flight-currency = 'OPEN' ) ADD 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_closed_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_open_count exp = 2 ).

    " Teardown
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die zufällige Auswahl von Datensätzen (unter Verwendung der Logik aus `rnd_006`) mit einer Massenaktualisierung mittels `UPDATE ... WHERE (itab)`. Die `LET` Expression innerhalb der `VALUE` Anweisung (ABAP 7.55) ermöglicht eine kompakte Dekonstruktion der String-Schlüssel zurück in die Struktur für die `WHERE`-Klausel.
keywords: UPDATE, RANDOM, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, WHERE (itab), LET, VALUE, SUBFIELD

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und deren Flugpreis unter 500 liegt. Verwenden Sie eine funktionale Methode und den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle basierend auf Bedingungen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin_city TYPE sgeocity-cityname
        iv_max_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lt_airports TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sairport.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sairport INTO TABLE lt_airports.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      lt_sflights
      USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE
        carrid IN (
          SELECT carrid FROM spfli
            WHERE
              cityfrom = iv_origin_city
        )
        AND price < iv_max_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Assuming no flights from FRANKFURT under 500 in standard sflight data

    " For example, if you know there's a flight from 'NEW YORK' with price 300:
    " DATA(lt_ny_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_origin_city = 'NEW YORK' iv_max_price = '350' ).

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und fügen Sie ein Präfix 'FLIGHT-' zur Flugnummer hinzu. Verwenden Sie eine funktionale Methode und den `FOR` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle durch Iteration und Transformation zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Verwenden Sie eine funktionale Methode und den `REDUCE` Operator.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der belegten Sitze. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` um Daten zu gruppieren und Aggregationen pro Gruppe durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_occ = 0
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN group_ref->*
        NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ls_grouped_flight-seatsocc
      ).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid = group_ref->carrid
        connid = group_ref->connid
        total_seats_occupied = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh_400-total_seats_occupied exp = <expected_value> ).
  ENDMETHOD.

GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke Erweiterung für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen, die es ermöglicht, Daten direkt in der Schleife zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` bietet es eine sehr moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, komplexe Gruppierungs- und Summierungsaufgaben zu lösen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Table, Grouping, REDUCE, METHOD

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine andere Methode eines Objekts aufruft, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer einfachen Setter-Methode.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_setter
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_setter.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object
          EXPORTING
            i_value = iv_value.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., method not found or wrong parameters
        MESSAGE 'Dynamic method call failed' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for demonstration

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING i_value TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_test_target IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_target( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).

    lo_caller->call_dynamic_setter( io_object = lo_target
                                    iv_method_name = 'SET_VALUE'
                                    iv_value = 'TestValue' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_target->mv_value exp = 'TestValue' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_target( ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).

    " Expecting an error message or exception handling
    TRY.
        lo_caller->call_dynamic_setter( io_object = lo_target
                                        iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
                                        iv_value = 'SomeValue' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_DYN_CALL_ERROR' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_target->mv_value ). " Value should not be set
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf (`CALL METHOD (method_name) OF object`) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für flexible Architekturen und Frameworks. Er ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit zu entscheiden, welche Methode aufgerufen werden soll, was die Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit des Codes verbessern kann. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: CALL METHOD, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, METHOD

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Funktionalität von `FILTER` und `FOR` in einer Methode, um Flugdaten zu filtern und anschließend zu transformieren. Filtern Sie Flüge von 'NEW YORK' und transformieren Sie sie in einen String, der Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer enthält.
hint: Verschachteln Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` Ausdrücke, um eine Pipeline-ähnliche Verarbeitung zu erreichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_flight_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin_city TYPE sgeocity-cityname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_strings) TYPE tt_flight_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_transformed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.

    rt_flight_strings = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #(
        lt_sflights
        USING KEY primary_key
        WHERE
          carrid IN (
            SELECT carrid FROM spfli
              WHERE
                cityfrom = iv_origin_city
          )
      )
      ( |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_price_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_upd,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight_upd.
    TYPES tt_sflight_upd TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_upd WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_origin_city TYPE sgeocity-cityname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_upd.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_price_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_conditionally.
    DATA: lt_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom FROM spfli INTO TABLE lt_spfli.

    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      LET lv_is_from_origin = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_spfli[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ] WHERE cityfrom = iv_origin_city ) ) IN
      ( ls_flight
        price = COND #(
          WHEN lv_is_from_origin THEN ls_flight-price * '1.10'
          ELSE ls_flight-price
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_group_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_high_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_min_seats_occupied TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_high_occupancy.
    rt_carrids = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights
        GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
        WHERE ( REDUCE xsdbool(
                  INIT has_high_occ = abap_false
                  FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                  NEXT has_high_occ = COND #( WHEN ls_grouped_flight-seatsocc > iv_min_seats_occupied THEN abap_true ELSE has_high_occ )
                ) = abap_true )
      ( ls_flight-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_bar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_count_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_chart_data  TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_container.

    " Modern ABAP: Aggregate data directly in SELECT
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS carrid, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
           GROUP BY carrid
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

    " Prepare data for chart engine
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        name = ls_agg-carrid
        value = ls_agg-flight_count
      ) TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create chart engine instance
    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).

    " Set chart type and data
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    " In a real scenario, you'd pass a container reference to lo_chart->set_container( lo_container ) and then lo_chart->draw_chart().
    " For this example, we simulate the chart creation.
    MESSAGE 'Balkendiagramm für Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft erstellt.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

        iv_value_f    TYPE fieldname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_rtti_generic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_generic_bar_chart.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_container.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data>     TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line>     TYPE any,
                   <fs_category> TYPE any,
                   <fs_value>    TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Interne Tabelle konnte nicht zugewiesen werden.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get structure description using RTTI
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data>[ 1 ] ). " Describe by first line
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Check if fields exist
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_category_f TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE |Feld '{ iv_category_f }' nicht gefunden.| TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_value_f TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE |Feld '{ iv_value_f }' nicht gefunden.| TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Prepare data for chart engine dynamically
    LOOP AT <fs_data> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_category_f OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_category>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_value_f OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE #(
          name = <fs_category>
          value = <fs_value>
        ) TO lt_chart_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create chart engine instance
    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).

    " Set chart type and data
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Dynamisches Balkendiagramm: { iv_category_f } vs. { iv_value_f }| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_title( iv_category_f ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_title( iv_value_f ).

    MESSAGE 'Dynamisches Balkendiagramm erstellt.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_create_excel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'simple_report.xlsx'.

CLASS zcl_openxml_create_excel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_excel.
    DATA: lt_header TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string,
          lt_data   TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string_table.

    " Prepare header
    APPEND 'Flight ID' TO lt_header.
    APPEND 'Carrier' TO lt_header.
    APPEND 'Date' TO lt_header.
    APPEND 'Price' TO lt_header.

    " Prepare data from SFLIGHTS (first 5 entries)
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS fldate, carrid, connid, price, currency
           UP TO 5 ROWS
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        ( ls_flight-connid )
        ( ls_flight-carrid )
        ( |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) " String Template for date
        ( |{ ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency }| ) " String Template for currency
      ) TO lt_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create OpenXML helper instance
    DATA(lo_openxml) = NEW cl_openxml_helper( ).

    TRY.
        lo_openxml->create_excel_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_filename
            it_header   = lt_header
            it_data     = lt_data
        ).
        MESSAGE |Excel-Datei '{ iv_filename }' erfolgreich erstellt.| TYPE 'S'.
      CATCH cx_openxml_helper INTO DATA(lx_openxml).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine spezifische Zelle in einer vorhandenen Excel-Datei (`.xlsx`) im Anwendungsverzeichnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_openxml_helper` und die Methoden `read_excel_document` und `create_excel_document` in Kombination mit der Bearbeitung der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_update_excel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_excel_cell
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
        iv_row      TYPE i
        iv_col      TYPE i
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_update_excel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_excel_cell.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string_table.
    DATA(lo_openxml) = NEW cl_openxml_helper( ).

    TRY.
        " Read existing data
        lo_openxml->read_excel_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_filename
          IMPORTING
            et_data     = lt_data
        ).

        " Update specific cell using modern ABAP table expressions
        IF iv_row > 0 AND iv_col > 0 AND iv_row <= lines( lt_data ).
          DATA(ls_row) = lt_data[ iv_row ].
          IF iv_col <= lines( ls_row ).
            ls_row[ iv_col ] = iv_new_value.
            MODIFY TABLE lt_data INDEX iv_row FROM ls_row.
            MESSAGE |Zelle ({ iv_row }, { iv_col }) in '{ iv_filename }' auf '{ iv_new_value }' aktualisiert.| TYPE 'S'.
          ELSE.
            MESSAGE |Spalte { iv_col } existiert nicht in Zeile { iv_row }.| TYPE 'E'.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE |Zeile { iv_row } existiert nicht.| TYPE 'E'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Write updated data back to the same file
        lo_openxml->create_excel_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_filename
            it_data     = lt_data
        ).

      CATCH cx_openxml_helper INTO DATA(lx_openxml).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_word_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_word_doc_with_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'document_with_table.docx'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_word_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_word_doc_with_table.
    DATA: lt_doc_content TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string,
          lt_table_data  TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string_table.

    " Prepare initial document content
    APPEND |Bericht mit Flugdaten| TO lt_doc_content.
    APPEND cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf TO lt_doc_content.
    APPEND |Die folgende Tabelle zeigt eine Übersicht der Flüge:| TO lt_doc_content.
    APPEND cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf TO lt_doc_content.

    " Prepare table header
    APPEND VALUE #(
      ( 'Flug ID' )
      ( 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( 'Datum' )
      ( 'Preis' )
    ) TO lt_table_data.

    " Prepare table data from SFLIGHTS (first 3 entries)
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS fldate, carrid, connid, price, currency
           UP TO 3 ROWS
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        ( ls_flight-connid )
        ( ls_flight-carrid )
        ( |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| )
        ( |{ ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency }| )
      ) TO lt_table_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_openxml) = NEW cl_openxml_helper( ).

    TRY.
        " Create initial document
        lo_openxml->create_word_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_filename
            it_content  = lt_doc_content
        ).

        " Add table to the document (assuming helper supports this, or append as text)
        " Note: cl_openxml_helper might not have a direct 'add_table' method for Word.
        " A common workaround is to format the table as text or use more specialized classes.
        " For this example, we'll append the table data as text, simulating a table.
        APPEND cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf TO lt_doc_content.
        APPEND |--- TABELLE START ---| TO lt_doc_content.
        LOOP AT lt_table_data INTO DATA(ls_row).
          APPEND |{ REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR comp IN ls_row NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN comp ELSE s && ', ' && comp ) ) }| TO lt_doc_content.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND |--- TABELLE ENDE ---| TO lt_doc_content.

        " Re-create the document with appended table content
        lo_openxml->create_word_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_filename
            it_content  = lt_doc_content
        ).

        MESSAGE |Word-Dokument '{ iv_filename }' mit Tabelle erfolgreich erstellt.| TYPE 'S'.
      CATCH cx_openxml_helper INTO DATA(lx_openxml).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_filter_excel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_save_excel.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string_table,
          lt_filtered_data TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string_table.
    DATA(lo_openxml) = NEW cl_openxml_helper( ).

    TRY.
        " Read source Excel file
        lo_openxml->read_excel_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_source_filename
          IMPORTING
            et_data     = lt_source_data
        ).

        " Filter data using modern ABAP FILTER expression (assuming first column for filter)
        " Skip header row for filtering
        IF lines( lt_source_data ) > 1.
          DATA(lt_header) = VALUE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string_table( ( lt_source_data[ 1 ] ) ).
          DATA(lt_body) = lt_source_data.
          DELETE lt_body INDEX 1.

          lt_filtered_data = FILTER #( lt_body USING KEY primary_key WHERE table_line[ 1 ] = iv_filter_value ).
          " Prepend header to filtered data
          INSERT LINES OF lt_header INTO TABLE lt_filtered_data INDEX 1.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE |Quelldatei '{ iv_source_filename }' ist leer oder hat keine Datenzeilen.| TYPE 'W'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Write filtered data to new Excel file
        lo_openxml->create_excel_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_target_filename
            it_data     = lt_filtered_data
        ).

        MESSAGE |Gefilterte Daten in '{ iv_target_filename }' gespeichert. { lines( lt_filtered_data ) } Zeilen geschrieben.| TYPE 'S'.

      CATCH cx_openxml_helper INTO DATA(lx_openxml).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein gestapeltes Balkendiagramm, das die Verteilung der Flugklassen (Economy, Business, First) pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` und bereiten Sie die Daten für gestapelte Diagramme vor, möglicherweise mit mehreren Datenreihen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_bar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_stacked_flight_classes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_bar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_stacked_flight_classes.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_container,
          lt_series     TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_container.

    " Modern ABAP: Aggregate data for different classes per carrier
    " This is a simplified example, assuming 'class' could be derived or is a field.
    " For SFLIGHTS, we'll simulate classes based on price ranges or just use dummy data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_class_agg,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             class  TYPE string,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_class_agg.
    DATA: lt_agg_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_class_agg.

    " Simulate data for different classes
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_class_agg( carrid = 'LH' class = 'Economy' count = 10 ) TO lt_agg_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_class_agg( carrid = 'LH' class = 'Business' count = 5 ) TO lt_agg_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_class_agg( carrid = 'LH' class = 'First' count = 2 ) TO lt_agg_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_class_agg( carrid = 'AA' class = 'Economy' count = 12 ) TO lt_agg_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_class_agg( carrid = 'AA' class = 'Business' count = 3 ) TO lt_agg_data.

    " Prepare data for chart engine - each class is a series
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_agg IN lt_agg_data GROUP BY ls_agg-carrid INTO DATA(key) ( key-carrid ) ).
    DATA(lt_classes) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_agg IN lt_agg_data GROUP BY ls_agg-class INTO DATA(key) ( key-class ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_classes INTO DATA(lv_class).
      DATA(lt_current_series_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_container(
        FOR lv_carrier IN lt_carriers
        LET ls_entry = lt_agg_data[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = lv_carrier class = lv_class ] IN
        ( VALUE #(
            name = lv_carrier
            value = COND i( WHEN line_exists( ls_entry ) THEN ls_entry-count ELSE 0 )
          )
        )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        name = lv_class
        data = lt_current_series_data
      ) TO lt_series.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create chart engine instance
    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).

    " Set chart type and data
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_stacked_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_series_data( lt_series ).
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flugklassenverteilung pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Anzahl' ).

    MESSAGE 'Gestapeltes Balkendiagramm erstellt.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine Excel-Datei, wobei die Spaltenüberschriften dynamisch aus der Struktur der internen Tabelle abgeleitet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_openxml_helper` und RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) zur dynamischen Ermittlung der Spaltennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_dynamic_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_dynamic_table_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_filename   TYPE string DEFAULT 'dynamic_export.xlsx'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_dynamic_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_table_to_excel.
    DATA: lt_header TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string,
          lt_excel_data TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <fs_data> IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Daten zum Exportieren vorhanden.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get structure description using RTTI
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data>[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Prepare header dynamically
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
      APPEND ls_comp-name TO lt_header.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND lt_header TO lt_excel_data.

    " Prepare data rows dynamically
    LOOP AT <fs_data> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DATA(lt_row_values) = VALUE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string(
        FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
        LET lv_value = '' IN
        ( ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lv_value = |{ <fs_comp> }|.
          ENDIF.
          lv_value
        )
      ).
      APPEND lt_row_values TO lt_excel_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_openxml) = NEW cl_openxml_helper( ).

    TRY.
        lo_openxml->create_excel_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_filename
            it_data     = lt_excel_data
        ).
        MESSAGE |Dynamischer Export nach '{ iv_filename }' erfolgreich. { lines( lt_excel_data ) - 1 } Datenzeilen geschrieben.| TYPE 'S'.
      CATCH cx_openxml_helper INTO DATA(lx_openxml).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt. Färben Sie die Balken basierend auf der Anzahl der Flüge unterschiedlich ein (z.B. grün für > 100 Flüge, gelb für 50-100, rot für < 50).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` und passen Sie die Farben der Datenpunkte dynamisch an, möglicherweise mit `COND` oder `CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_conditional_color DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_colored_flight_chart.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_conditional_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_colored_flight_chart.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_data_container,
          lt_colors     TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_color_container.

    " Aggregate data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS carrid, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
           GROUP BY carrid
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

    " Prepare data and colors dynamically
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        name = ls_agg-carrid
        value = ls_agg-flight_count
      ) TO lt_chart_data.

      DATA(lv_color) = COND i(
        WHEN ls_agg-flight_count > 100 THEN cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_green
        WHEN ls_agg-flight_count >= 50 THEN cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_yellow
        ELSE cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_red
      ).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        name = ls_agg-carrid
        color = lv_color
      ) TO lt_colors.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_colors( lt_colors ). " Set dynamic colors
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft mit Ampelfarben' ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    MESSAGE 'Balkendiagramm mit bedingter Farbgebung erstellt.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Importieren Sie Daten aus einer Excel-Datei und transformieren Sie diese direkt in eine interne Tabelle mit einer vordefinierten Struktur, wobei Datentypen konvertiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_openxml_helper` zum Lesen und `CORRESPONDING` oder `MAP` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_typed_import DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_import,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_import.

    METHODS import_excel_to_typed_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_import.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_typed_import IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD import_excel_to_typed_table.
    DATA: lt_raw_data TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_string_table.
    DATA(lo_openxml) = NEW cl_openxml_helper( ).

    TRY.
        lo_openxml->read_excel_document(
          EXPORTING
            iv_filename = iv_filename
          IMPORTING
            et_data     = lt_raw_data
        ).

        " Skip header row
        IF lines( lt_raw_data ) > 1.
          DELETE lt_raw_data INDEX 1.
        ENDIF.

        " Transform raw data to typed table using modern ABAP features
        rt_flights = VALUE #(
          FOR ls_raw_row IN lt_raw_data
          LET lv_carrid   = ls_raw_row[ 1 ]
              lv_connid   = ls_raw_row[ 2 ]
              lv_fldate_str = ls_raw_row[ 3 ]
              lv_price_str  = ls_raw_row[ 4 ]
              lv_currency = ls_raw_row[ 5 ] IN
          ( carrid   = lv_carrid
            connid   = lv_connid
            fldate   = cl_abap_datfm=>convert_date_from_string( lv_fldate_str )
            price    = CONV s_price( lv_price_str )
            currency = lv_currency
          )
        ).

        MESSAGE |Excel-Daten erfolgreich in typisierte Tabelle importiert. { lines( rt_flights ) } Zeilen.| TYPE 'S'.

      CATCH cx_openxml_helper INTO DATA(lx_openxml).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_error INTO DATA(lx_date_error).
        MESSAGE |Fehler bei Datumskonvertierung: { lx_date_error->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        MESSAGE |Fehler bei Typkonvertierung: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugdauern (FLTIME) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, wobei die Flugdauer in Minuten als Integer summiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_flight_time
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_time) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_flight_time.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_time = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                              NEXT sum = sum + CONV i( flight-fltime ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Betrag von einem Währungstyp mit 2 Dezimalstellen in einen Währungstyp mit 0 Dezimalstellen (z.B. für Yen), ohne die Genauigkeit zu verlieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` mit dem Zieltyp `p` und der entsprechenden Anzahl Dezimalstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_currency_decimals
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount_eur TYPE s_price
        iv_currency   TYPE s_currkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_amount_jpy) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_currency_decimals.
    rv_amount_jpy = CONV p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 0( iv_amount_eur ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_currency_decimals FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_currency_decimals.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_currency( ).
    DATA(lv_amount_eur) TYPE s_price VALUE '123.45'.
    DATA(lv_currency) TYPE s_currkey VALUE 'EUR'.

    DATA(lv_amount_jpy) = lo_cut->convert_currency_decimals(
                            iv_amount_eur = lv_amount_eur
                            iv_currency   = lv_currency ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Decimal part should be truncated' act = lv_amount_jpy exp = 123 ).

    DATA(lv_amount_eur_no_dec) TYPE s_price VALUE '100.00'.
    DATA(lv_amount_jpy_no_dec) = lo_cut->convert_currency_decimals(
                                   iv_amount_eur = lv_amount_eur_no_dec
                                   iv_currency   = lv_currency ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'No change for zero decimal part' act = lv_amount_jpy_no_dec exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV` Operator kann verwendet werden, um numerische Werte zwischen verschiedenen Datentypen mit unterschiedlichen Dezimalstellen zu konvertieren. Hier wird ein `s_price` (typischerweise 2 Dezimalstellen) in einen `p`-Typ mit 0 Dezimalstellen umgewandelt. Dies führt zu einer Trunkierung der Dezimalstellen, was in bestimmten Szenarien (z.B. bei Währungen ohne Dezimalstellen wie JPY) gewünscht sein kann. Für eine vollständige Währungsumrechnung wären weitere Schritte (z.B. Multiplikation mit einem Wechselkurs und Berücksichtigung von TCURX) erforderlich.
keywords: CONV, Currency, Decimals, Data Conversion, Packed Number

solution:
CLASS zcl_dir_listing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dir_entry,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dir_entry.
    TYPES tt_dir_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dir_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_directory_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_directory_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_entries) TYPE tt_dir_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dir_listing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_directory_content.
    DATA lt_file_list TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_file_list.
    DATA ls_file_info TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>ty_file_info.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_listing(
          EXPORTING
            i_directory_name = iv_directory_path
          IMPORTING
            e_file_list      = lt_file_list
        ).

        rt_entries = VALUE #( FOR ls_file_info IN lt_file_list
                              ( name = ls_file_info-name
                                type = COND string( WHEN ls_file_info-type = cl_abap_file_utilities=>c_type_file THEN 'File'
                                                     WHEN ls_file_info-type = cl_abap_file_utilities=>c_type_directory THEN 'Directory'
                                                     ELSE 'Unknown' ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., directory not found, permissions issue
        CLEAR rt_entries.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Wert dynamisch in einen bestimmten Datentyp, der zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Dies soll für einfache Typen wie `i`, `d`, `string` funktionieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` in einem dynamischen Kontext, z.B. mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` oder `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_dynamic_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_value_string TYPE string
        iv_target_type  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_dynamic_type.
    DATA lv_temp_i TYPE i.
    DATA lv_temp_d TYPE d.
    DATA lv_temp_s TYPE string.

    CASE iv_target_type.
      WHEN 'I'.
        lv_temp_i = CONV i( iv_value_string ).
        rv_converted_value = CONV string( lv_temp_i ).
      WHEN 'D'.
        lv_temp_d = CONV d( iv_value_string ).
        rv_converted_value = CONV string( lv_temp_d ).
      WHEN 'STRING'.
        rv_converted_value = iv_value_string.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_converted_value = 'ERROR: Unsupported type'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Textdatei zeilenweise vom Applikationsserver und speichern Sie jede Zeile als Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle von Strings. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_file_as_string` und String-Splitting-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_read_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_into_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_read_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_into_lines.
    DATA lv_file_content TYPE string.
    TRY.
        lv_file_content = cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_file_as_string( iv_file_path ).
        SPLIT lv_file_content AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE rt_lines.
        " Remove empty line if file ends with CR_LF
        IF lines( rt_lines ) > 0 AND rt_lines[ lines( rt_lines ) ] IS INITIAL.
          DELETE TABLE rt_lines INDEX lines( rt_lines ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities_error.
        CLEAR rt_lines.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert. Zeigen Sie den Unterschied zwischen der `sy-subrc`-Prüfung nach `READ TABLE` und der modernen `LINE_EXISTS`-Funktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` gefolgt von `sy-subrc` und vergleichen Sie dies mit `LINE_EXISTS()` in einem `COND`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS check_entry_old
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE string_table
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS check_entry_modern
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE string_table
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_entry_old.
    READ TABLE it_data WITH KEY table_line = iv_value TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_entry_modern.
    rv_found = COND #( WHEN line_exists( it_data[ table_line = iv_value ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung nach einem Funktionsbausteinaufruf. Zeigen Sie die `sy-subrc`-Prüfung für ältere FMs und die `TRY...CATCH`-Behandlung für moderne FMs oder Wrapper.
hint: Simulieren Sie `sy-subrc` für den alten Stil und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks für den modernen Stil.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_fm_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS call_fm_old_style
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS call_fm_modern_style
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check. " Example for a custom exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_fm_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_fm_old_style.
    " Simulate an old FM that sets sy-subrc
    IF iv_input = 0.
      sy-subrc = 4. " Simulate error
    ELSE.
      sy-subrc = 0. " Simulate success
    ENDIF.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_fm_modern_style.
    " Simulate a modern FM or wrapper that raises exceptions
    TRY.
        IF iv_input = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_message.
        ENDIF.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ELSE.

        i_msgid = 'SY'

    lo_log->save( ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_sflight_old.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_dummy)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.

  METHOD check_sflight_modern.
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_modern).
    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT`. Für jeden Eintrag, der bestimmte Kriterien nicht erfüllt (z.B. Kapazität unter 100), protokollieren Sie eine Warnung im BAL. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `FILTER` für die Datenverarbeitung und `cl_bal_log` für die Protokollierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE` und `FOR` für die Iteration. Filtern Sie die Daten und fügen Sie Nachrichten zum BAL hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_sflight_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_and_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_sflight_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_and_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    lo_log->set_object( 'SFLIGHT' )->set_subobject( 'CAPACITY' ).

    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      FOR ls_sflight IN
        ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
            FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax ) ).

    DATA(lt_low_capacity_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight_data(
      lt_sflight WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) < 100 ).

    IF lt_low_capacity_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT lt_low_capacity_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        lo_log->add_msg(
          i_msgty = 'W'
          i_msgid = 'SY'
          i_msgno = '003'
          i_msgv1 = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } on { ls_flight-fldate } has low capacity: { ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc } seats left.|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      lo_log->add_msg(
        i_msgty = 'S'
        i_msgid = 'SY'
        i_msgno = '000'
        i_msgv1 = 'All flights have sufficient capacity.'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_log->save( ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sflight_logging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_logging.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_sflight_process( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_cut->process_flights_and_log( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_log_handle ).

    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create_from_handle( lv_log_handle ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log->get_msg_list( ).

    " This test assumes some flights might have low capacity in SFLIGHT.
    " If SFLIGHT data is always high capacity, this test might need adjustment
    " or a mock for SFLIGHT data.
    IF line_exists( lt_messages[ msgty = 'W' ] ).

    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'S' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll, das dynamisch Nachrichten basierend auf einer Liste von Fehlern generiert. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Fehlermeldungen zu aggregieren und dann dem BAL hinzuzufügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine interne Tabelle von Fehlern in einen String oder eine Liste von Nachrichten zu transformieren, die dann dem BAL hinzugefügt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_dynamic_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error_info,
             code TYPE string,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_error_info.
    TYPES tt_error_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_error_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS log_errors_with_reduce
      IMPORTING
        it_errors TYPE tt_error_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_dynamic_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_errors_with_reduce.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    lo_log->set_object( 'DYNAMIC' )->set_subobject( 'REDUCE' ).

    IF it_errors IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_aggregated_errors) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ``
        FOR ls_error IN it_errors
        NEXT s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |Error Code: { ls_error-code }, Message: { ls_error-text }|
          ELSE |{ s }; Error Code: { ls_error-code }, Message: { ls_error-text }|
        )
      ).

      lo_log->add_msg(
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgid = 'SY'
        i_msgno = '004'
        i_msgv1 = lv_aggregated_errors
      ).
    ELSE.
      lo_log->add_msg(
        i_msgty = 'S'
        i_msgid = 'SY'
        i_msgno = '000'
        i_msgv1 = 'No errors to log.'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_log->save( ).
    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_logging.

    DATA(lt_errors) = VALUE zcl_bal_dynamic_reduce=>tt_error_info(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Wrapper-Klasse für einen älteren Funktionsbaustein, der `sy-subrc` setzt. Die Wrapper-Klasse soll stattdessen Ausnahmen werfen, um eine moderne Fehlerbehandlung zu ermöglichen. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des Wrappers.
hint: Kapseln Sie den Funktionsbaustein in einer Methode. Prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` und werfen Sie bei Bedarf eine Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_wrapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS call_legacy_function
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Example exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_legacy_function.
    " Simulate a legacy function module call
    " For demonstration, we'll just set sy-subrc directly.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      sy-subrc = 4. " Simulate a warning/error
      rv_output = 0.
    ELSEIF iv_input < 0.
      sy-subrc = 8. " Simulate a critical error
      rv_output = 0.
    ELSE.
      sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input * 2.
    ENDIF.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CASE sy-subrc.
        WHEN 4.
          " Log a warning to BAL, but don't raise exception for this case
          DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
          lo_log->add_msg(
            i_msgty = 'W'
            i_msgid = 'SY'
            i_msgno = '005'
            i_msgv1 = |Legacy function returned warning (sy-subrc: { sy-subrc }) for input { iv_input }|
          ).
          lo_log->save( ).
        WHEN 8.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero. " Using a generic error for example
        WHEN OTHERS.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>overflow.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
    " Verify a log entry was created (more complex, but conceptually here)
    " For a real test, one would read the BAL log and check for the warning.
  ENDMETHOD.
