Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) basierend auf einem `sy-subrc`-ähnlichen Kriterium (z.B. Flugstatus). Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `COND` um die Tabelle zu verarbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem `WHERE`-Ausdruck, der eine Bedingung basierend auf einem simulierten Status prüft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             status TYPE i, " 0=OK, 4=Warning, 8=Error
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_status
        iv_min_status TYPE i " e.g., 4 for warnings/errors, 8 for errors only
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_status.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_flight_status(
      it_flights WHERE status >= iv_min_status
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_subrc_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sy_subrc_filter=>tt_flight_status(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' status = 0 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' status = 4 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' status = 8 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0987' status = 0 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_warnings_and_errors) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_min_status = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_warnings_and_errors ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_warnings_and_errors[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_warnings_and_errors[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).

    DATA(lt_errors_only) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_min_status = 8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors_only ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors_only[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).

    DATA(lt_all_statuses) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_min_status = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_statuses ) exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks, um interne Tabellen basierend auf einem numerischen Statusfeld zu filtern, das `sy-subrc`-Werte simulieren kann. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu selektieren, ohne explizite Schleifen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugverbindungen (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte maximale Kapazität überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE seatsmax > iv_min_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( 200 ). " Assuming some flights have more than 200 seats

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge mit mehr als 200 Plätzen gefunden werden.'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_flight-seatsmax > 200
        msg = 'Alle gefilterten Flüge sollten mehr als 200 Plätze haben.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Filterung von internen Tabellen. Hier wird eine neue Tabelle erstellt, die nur Einträge enthält, deren `seatsmax` den angegebenen Wert überschreitet. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und effizienter als eine klassische `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleife mit `APPEND`.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Deklarativ, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugverbindungen (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden und eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität haben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE` Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.

        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_multi IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS mindestens ein Flug existiert, der von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt wird und dessen Flugnummer mit 'LH' beginnt, unter Verwendung von `FILTER` und `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: `LINE_EXISTS( FILTER ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax )
    ).

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid CS iv_connid_prefix ) )
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_check_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_check_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid_prefix = '04' ). " Assuming LH flights starting with '04' exist

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_exists
      msg = 'Ein passender Flug sollte gefunden werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid_prefix = '999' ). " Assuming no such flight exists

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_exists
      msg = 'Kein passender Flug sollte gefunden werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `LINE_EXISTS` ermöglicht eine effiziente Prüfung auf die Existenz von Einträgen in einer internen Tabelle, die bestimmten Kriterien entsprechen, ohne die gesamte gefilterte Tabelle materialisieren zu müssen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für schnelle Prüfungen.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,

             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_carrid_connids.
    TYPES tt_carrid_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_group_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_carrid_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_group_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax )
    ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE tt_carrid_connids(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE seatsmax > iv_min_capacity ) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connids = VALUE #( FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( ls_group_flight-connid ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_for( ).

explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `FILTER` ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Datenaggregation und -transformation. Zuerst werden die Daten gefiltert, dann nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert und schließlich die Flugnummern in einer Untertabelle gesammelt. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Stil.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die entweder von 'LH' oder 'AA' durchgeführt werden, und kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse in einer einzigen internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `UNION ALL`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' UNION ALL SELECT ... FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_lh_aa_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_aa_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).
    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_lh_aa_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_aa_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_union( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_aa_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should retrieve flights for LH and AA' act = lt_result ).
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSEIF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain LH flights' act = ( lv_lh_count > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain AA flights' act = ( lv_aa_count > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` in Open SQL ermöglicht das Kombinieren der Ergebnisse von zwei oder mehr `SELECT`-Anweisungen in einem einzigen Resultset. `ALL` stellt sicher, dass alle Zeilen, einschließlich Duplikate, zurückgegeben werden. Dies ist nützlich, um Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen oder mit unterschiedlichen Filterkriterien zu konsolidieren.
keywords: SELECT, UNION ALL, SFLIGHTS

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine `cl_gui_toolbar` verwaltet, einen Button hinzufügt und dessen `button_click`-Event behandelt. Simulieren Sie einen Klick und überprüfen Sie, ob das Event ausgelöst wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER ... FOR ...` und `RAISE EVENT` für die Simulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_toolbar_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS create_and_handle_toolbar.
    METHODS get_last_clicked_fcode RETURNING VALUE(rv_fcode) TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>fcode.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    DATA mv_last_clicked_fcode TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>fcode.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar IMPORTING fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_handle_toolbar.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = mv_container_name.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar EXPORTING parent = mo_container.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      EXPORTING
        fcode = 'BTN_CLICK'
        icon  = icon_execute_object
        butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_button
        text  = 'Click Me'
        quickinfo = 'Click this button'
    ).

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    mv_last_clicked_fcode = fcode.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_clicked_fcode.
    rv_fcode = mv_last_clicked_fcode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_button_click_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_button_click_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_toolbar_event_handler( iv_container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_EVENT' ).
    lo_cut->create_and_handle_toolbar( ).

    " Simulate a button click by directly calling the event handler method
    " In a real scenario, the event would be raised by the GUI framework.
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->(handle_button_click) PARAMETER-TABLE VALUE #( ( fcode = 'BTN_CLICK' ) ).

    DATA(lv_fcode) = lo_cut->get_last_clicked_fcode( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Event handler should capture correct fcode' act = lv_fcode exp = 'BTN_CLICK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Event-Behandlung in ABAP mit `FOR EVENT` und `SET HANDLER` ist ein zentrales Konzept der objektorientierten Programmierung. Hier wird ein lokaler Event-Handler für das `button_click`-Event der Toolbar registriert. Im Unit-Test wird das Event simuliert, um die Funktionalität zu überprüfen, ohne eine vollständige GUI-Umgebung zu benötigen.
keywords: CL_GUI_TOOLBAR, EVENT, BUTTON_CLICK, SET HANDLER, OBJECT ORIENTATION

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Daten, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie eine Tabellenexpression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' AND seatsocc < 20 ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax - seatsocc >= iv_min_free_seats )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 85.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 95.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 80.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free_seats = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should find 1 flight' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered flight carrid' act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered flight connid' act = <fs_flight>-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenexpressions mit `VALUE #( FOR ... WHERE ... )` bieten eine kompakte und funktionale Syntax, um interne Tabellen zu filtern und neue Tabellen zu konstruieren. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und oft performanter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ...` Konstrukte.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, TABLE EXPRESSION, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Daten. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE s_seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_seats.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 85.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 95.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 80.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total occupied seats for LH should be 180' act = lv_total_seats exp = 180 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Aggregation durchführt. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen zu implementieren.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, REDUCE, AGGREGATION, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus SFLIGHTS basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Flugdatum. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass kein Datensatz gefunden wird, mit `EXCEPTIONS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE ... INTO @DATA(...) EXCEPTIONS ...` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_data_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      INTO @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_data_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_single_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_single_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_single_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_single( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250228' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should be AA' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connection ID should be 0017' act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_single_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_single( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'cx_sy_no_data_found expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_data_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'cx_sy_no_data_found caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SELECT SINGLE` ist für das Lesen eines einzelnen Datensatzes optimiert. Die explizite Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach dem `SELECT` und das Auslösen einer Ausnahme (`RAISING cx_sy_no_data_found`) ist der moderne Weg, um das Fehlen von Daten zu signalisieren, anstatt nur `sy-subrc` zu prüfen und den Aufrufer dies selbst interpretieren zu lassen.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, EXCEPTIONS, SY-SUBRC, SFLIGHTS, ERROR HANDLING

Instructions: Wählen Sie spezifische Felder aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus. Nutzen Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und `WHERE IN` mit einer Inline-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_flights) WHERE carrid IN @(VALUE #( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ))`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_where_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_where_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carriers.
    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_where_in( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE s_carr_id_tt( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should retrieve flights for LH and AA' act = lt_result ).
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_aa_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain LH flights' act = lv_lh_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain AA flights' act = lv_aa_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` ist nützlich, wenn die Struktur der Zieltabelle nicht exakt der Datenbanktabelle entspricht, aber übereinstimmende Feldnamen vorhanden sind. `WHERE IN @it_carriers` ermöglicht die Übergabe einer internen Tabelle von Werten für die `WHERE`-Klausel, was dynamische Filterungen vereinfacht und SQL-Injections vorbeugt.
keywords: SELECT, CORRESPONDING, WHERE IN, SFLIGHTS, INTERNAL TABLES

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Top 5 der Flüge mit den meisten belegten Sitzen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Nutzen Sie `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... ORDER BY seatsocc DESCENDING UP TO 5 ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_top_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      ORDER BY seatsocc DESCENDING
      UP TO iv_top_n ROWS.
    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_5_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_top_0_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_5_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flights( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should retrieve 5 flights' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    " Verify sorting (first flight should have more occupied seats than the last)
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 5.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'First flight should have more seats than last' act = ( lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsocc >= lt_result[ 5 ]-seatsocc ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_top_0_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flights( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Should retrieve 0 flights for TOP 0' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ORDER BY` sortiert die Ergebnisse direkt auf der Datenbank, und `UP TO N ROWS` begrenzt die Anzahl der zurückgegebenen Zeilen. Diese Kombination ist sehr effizient, um Top-N-Listen zu erstellen, da die Datenbank nur die benötigten Daten sortiert und überträgt, anstatt alle Daten zu holen und dann in ABAP zu sortieren und zu kürzen.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, SFLIGHTS, SORTING

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Aggregation über die Tabelle SFLIGHTS durch, um die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln. Nutzen Sie `AVG` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT carrid, AVG( seatsocc ) AS avg_seats FROM sflights GROUP BY carrid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_seats,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_seats TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_seats.
    METHODS get_avg_occupied_seats_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_seats) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupied_seats_per_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( seatsocc ) AS avg_seats
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_avg_seats)
      GROUP BY carrid.
    rt_avg_seats = lt_avg_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_avg_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_avg_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupied_seats_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should retrieve average seats per carrier' act = lt_result ).
    " Check if 'LH' exists and has a reasonable average (assuming test data has LH flights)
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_avg>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average seats for LH should be positive' act = ( <fs_avg>-avg_seats > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Aggregationsfunktionen wie `AVG` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` sind essenziell für die Datenanalyse direkt auf der Datenbank. Sie ermöglichen es, statistische Werte für Gruppen von Datensätzen zu berechnen, ohne alle Detaildaten in das ABAP-Programm laden zu müssen, was die Performance erheblich verbessert.
keywords: SELECT, AVG, GROUP BY, AGGREGATION, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Bestimme den Datentyp, die Länge und die Anzahl der Dezimalstellen eines beliebigen Feldes zur Laufzeit.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
             decimals TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    METHODS get_field_info IMPORTING iv_data TYPE any RETURNING VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_info.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    rs_info-name = lo_descr->get_name( ).
    rs_info-type = lo_descr->type_kind.

    IF lo_descr IS INSTANCE OF cl_abap_elemdescr.
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_descr ).
      rs_info-length = lo_elem_descr->length.
      rs_info-decimals = lo_elem_descr->decimals.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_packed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string.
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_info( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_field_info( lv_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-type exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-length exp = 11 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-decimals exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_packed.
    DATA(lv_packed) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '123.45'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_info( ).
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_field_info( lv_packed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-type exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-length exp = 8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-decimals exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die RTTI-Klassen `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_elemdescr` ermöglichen die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) und `CAST` für die Typumwandlung sind moderne ABAP-Features.
keywords: RTTI, Typanalyse, Dynamisch, cl_abap_elemdescr, cl_abap_typedescr

Instructions: Greife dynamisch auf Felder einer Struktur zu, deren Namen zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, und gib deren Werte zurück.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und Feldsymbole mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_field_values TYPE TABLE OF string.
    METHODS get_field_values_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_structure    TYPE any
        it_field_names  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE tt_field_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_values_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = lv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF is_structure TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
        IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
          APPEND |{ <fs_value> }| TO rt_values.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfe, ob eine interne Tabelle eine Standardtabelle mit einem Zeilentyp ist, der eine bestimmte Struktur (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) repräsentiert.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_ddic_type_name`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS is_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_sflight) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ) ).

    IF lo_table_descr->get_table_kind( ) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std.
      DATA(lo_line_type_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
      IF lo_line_type_descr IS INSTANCE OF cl_abap_structdescr.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_type_descr ).
        " Check if the DDIC type name matches SFLIGHT or a custom type based on SFLIGHT
        IF lo_struct_descr->get_ddic_type_name( ) = 'SFLIGHT' OR
           lo_struct_descr->get_ddic_type_name( ) = 'ZCL_RTTI_TABLE_CHECK=>TY_SFLIGHT_SIMPLE'. " For local types
          rv_is_sflight = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeuge dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit dem Zeilentyp `SFLIGHT` und fülle sie mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_line_type) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    DATA(lo_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                  p_line_type = lo_line_type
                                  p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                  p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type.
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(ls_sflight_data) TYPE sflight.
      ls_sflight_data-carrid = 'AA'.
      ls_sflight_data-connid = '0017'.
      ls_sflight_data-fldate = sy-datum.
      ls_sflight_data-price = '100.00'.
      INSERT ls_sflight_data INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

      ls_sflight_data-carrid = 'LH'.
      ls_sflight_data-connid = '0400'.
      ls_sflight_data-fldate = sy-datum + 1.
      ls_sflight_data-price = '200.00'.
      INSERT ls_sflight_data INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermittle zur Laufzeit die IMPORTING-Parameter einer Methode einer Klasse (z.B. `CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT=>ASSERT_EQUALS`) und gib deren Namen und Typen zurück.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `cl_abap_methdescr=>get_parameters`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE string,
             is_optional TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_param_info.
    TYPES: tt_param_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_method_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_params) TYPE tt_param_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_method_parameters.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
        DATA(lo_method_descr) = lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).
        DATA(lt_parameters) = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).

        rt_params = VALUE #( FOR ls_param IN lt_parameters
                             WHERE ( parameter_kind = cl_abap_methdescr=>parameterkind_importing )
                             ( name = ls_param-name
                               type_kind = ls_param-type->type_kind
                               is_optional = ls_param-optional ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error if class or method not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeuge dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem generischen Zeilentyp (z.B. `ANY TABLE`) und füge Daten hinzu, wobei der tatsächliche Zeilentyp zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` mit `p_line_type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_generic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_generic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_line_type_kind TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_generic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_generic_table.
    DATA: lo_line_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    CASE iv_line_type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        lo_line_type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
        lo_line_type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default to string if unknown
        lo_line_type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lo_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                  p_line_type = lo_line_type
                                  p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                  p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type.
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      IF iv_line_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        ASSIGN 'Hello' TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_string_line> TYPE string).
        INSERT <fs_string_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ASSIGN 'World' TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_string_line> TYPE string).
        INSERT <fs_string_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
      ELSEIF iv_line_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
        ASSIGN 10 TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_int_line> TYPE i).
        INSERT <fs_int_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ASSIGN 20 TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_int_line> TYPE i).
        INSERT <fs_int_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges aus `sflights` von der Originalwährung in EUR. Nehmen Sie an, der Umrechnungskurs ist in der Datenbank hinterlegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `CALCULATE` Anweisung mit `CURRENCY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_converted,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             price_eur TYPE sflight-price,
             currency_eur TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_converted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_converted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_converted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight_converted) TYPE ty_sflight_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flight_price.
    rs_sflight_converted-carrid = is_sflight-carrid.
    rs_sflight_converted-connid = is_sflight-connid.
    rs_sflight_converted-fldate = is_sflight-fldate.
    rs_sflight_converted-price = is_sflight-price.
    rs_sflight_converted-currency = is_sflight-currency.

    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'EUR'.
    DATA(lv_conversion_date) = sy-datum.

    CALCULATE is_sflight-price CURRENCY is_sflight-currency
              FROM lv_target_currency
              ON lv_conversion_date
              INTO rs_sflight_converted-price_eur CURRENCY rs_sflight_converted-currency_eur.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_currency_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_currency_conversion.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_sflight-price = '100.00'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_currency( ).
    DATA(ls_converted) = lo_cut->convert_flight_price( ls_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted-currency_eur exp = 'EUR' msg = 'Target currency should be EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_converted-price_eur msg = 'Converted price should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CALCULATE`-Anweisung ist die Standardmethode in ABAP für Währungs- und Einheitenumrechnungen. Sie berücksichtigt automatisch die im Customizing hinterlegten Umrechnungskurse und -regeln, was sie robust und zuverlässig macht. Hier wird ein Flugpreis von einer Quellwährung in EUR umgerechnet.
keywords: CALCULATE, CURRENCY, sflights, math, conversion

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie die Anzahl der freien Sitze (`SEATSMAX`) eines Fluges in eine andere Einheit (z.B. von 'PC' nach 'EA'). Nehmen Sie an, die Einheiten sind in der Datenbank hinterlegt.

CLASS zcl_calc_unit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_unit_converted,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste der Flugdaten an und berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft. Die Liste soll die Fluggesellschaft und den Gesamtpreis anzeigen.
hint: Bereiten Sie die Daten vorher mit `GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator vor, bevor Sie sie an `cl_abap_list_layout` übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_agg(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid currency = ls_sflight-currency )
      (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        currency = ls_sflight-currency,
        total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price )
      )
    ).

    lo_list_layout->set_data( it_data = lt_aggregated_data ).
    lo_list_layout->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '150.00'.
    <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '200.00'.
    <fs_sflight>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_list_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated_result) = VALUE zcl_list_aggregation=>tt_sflight_agg(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid currency = ls_sflight-currency )
      (
        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        currency = ls_sflight-currency,
        total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs_sflight_in_group> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight_in_group>-price )
      )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 aggregated entries' ).
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_agg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_agg-total_price exp = '250.00' msg = 'LH total price incorrect' ).
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_agg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_agg-total_price exp = '200.00' msg = 'AA total price incorrect' ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_aggregated_sflights( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump expected during display' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Dump occurred during display' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`-Operatoren, um Daten vor der Anzeige zu aggregieren. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster, um Summen oder andere Aggregationen direkt bei der Tabellenverarbeitung zu bilden. `cl_abap_list_layout` zeigt dann die vorbereiteten Aggregationsdaten an.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Flugdaten enthält, und konvertieren Sie dabei alle Preise in EUR mit `CALCULATE` innerhalb einer `FOR`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `CALCULATE` in Kombination, um die neue Tabelle zu befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_converted,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             price_eur TYPE sflight-price,
             currency_eur TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_converted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_converted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_converted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_all_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_converted) TYPE tt_sflight_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_all_flight_prices.
    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'EUR'.
    DATA(lv_conversion_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_sflights_converted = VALUE tt_sflight_converted(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      LET lv_price_eur = ls_sflight-price
          lv_currency_eur = ls_sflight-currency IN
        (
          carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
          connid = ls_sflight-connid,
          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
          price = ls_sflight-price,
          currency = ls_sflight-currency,
          price_eur = CALCULATE ls_sflight-price CURRENCY ls_sflight-currency
                                FROM lv_target_currency
                                ON lv_conversion_date
                                INTO lv_price_eur CURRENCY lv_currency_eur,
          currency_eur = lv_currency_eur
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.

    <fs_sflight>-currency = 'GBP'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_for_loop( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_converted ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 converted entries' ).
    READ TABLE lt_converted WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_converted).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_converted-currency_eur exp = 'EUR' msg = 'LH target currency should be EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_converted-price_eur msg = 'LH converted price should not be initial' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_aa_converted-price_eur msg = 'AA converted price should not be initial' ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges nur dann in EUR, wenn die Originalwährung nicht bereits EUR ist. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne Konditionaloperatoren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CALCULATE` mit `COND` oder `SWITCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_cond_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_cond_converted,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             price_final TYPE sflight-price,
             currency_final TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_cond_converted.

    METHODS convert_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight_converted) TYPE ty_sflight_cond_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_cond_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_conditionally.
    rs_sflight_converted-carrid = is_sflight-carrid.
    rs_sflight_converted-connid = is_sflight-connid.
    rs_sflight_converted-price = is_sflight-price.
    rs_sflight_converted-currency = is_sflight-currency.

    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'EUR'.
    DATA(lv_conversion_date) = sy-datum.

    rs_sflight_converted-price_final = COND #( WHEN is_sflight-currency = lv_target_currency THEN is_sflight-price
                                               ELSE CALCULATE is_sflight-price CURRENCY is_sflight-currency
                                                            FROM lv_target_currency
                                                            ON lv_conversion_date
                                                            INTO DATA(lv_converted_price) CURRENCY DATA(lv_converted_currency) ).
    rs_sflight_converted-currency_final = COND #( WHEN is_sflight-currency = lv_target_currency THEN is_sflight-currency
                                                  ELSE lv_converted_currency ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_cond_conv( ).

    " Test case 1: Already EUR
    DATA(ls_sflight_eur) TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight_eur-price = '100.00'.
    ls_sflight_eur-currency = 'EUR'.
    DATA(ls_converted_eur) = lo_cut->convert_conditionally( ls_sflight_eur ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted_eur-price_final exp = '100.00' msg = 'EUR price should not change' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted_eur-currency_final exp = 'EUR' msg = 'EUR currency should remain EUR' ).

    " Test case 2: Needs conversion (USD to EUR)
    DATA(ls_sflight_usd) TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight_usd-price = '100.00'.
    ls_sflight_usd-currency = 'USD'.
    DATA(ls_converted_usd) = lo_cut->convert_conditionally( ls_sflight_usd ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted_usd-currency_final exp = 'EUR' msg = 'USD currency should convert to EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_converted_usd-price_final msg = 'Converted USD price should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = ls_converted_usd-price_final exp = '100.00' msg = 'Converted USD price should differ from original' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CALCULATE` mit dem `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine elegante und moderne Implementierung von bedingten Währungsumrechnungen. Der Code ist dadurch kompakter und besser lesbar als mit klassischen `IF`-Anweisungen, da die Logik direkt in der Zuweisung ausgedrückt wird.
keywords: CALCULATE, COND, SWITCH, currency, conditional logic

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Währungsumrechnung mit `CALCULATE` durch und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler (z.B. ungültige Währungscodes) mit einer modernen Fehlerbehandlung ab.
hint: Umschließen Sie die `CALCULATE` Anweisung mit `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_safe_converted,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             price_eur TYPE sflight-price,
             currency_eur TYPE sflight-currency,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_safe_converted.

    METHODS convert_price_safe
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight_converted) TYPE ty_sflight_safe_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_price_safe.
    rs_sflight_converted-carrid = is_sflight-carrid.
    rs_sflight_converted-connid = is_sflight-connid.
    rs_sflight_converted-price = is_sflight-price.
    rs_sflight_converted-currency = is_sflight-currency.

    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'EUR'.
    DATA(lv_conversion_date) = sy-datum.

    TRY.
        CALCULATE is_sflight-price CURRENCY is_sflight-currency
                  FROM lv_target_currency
                  ON lv_conversion_date
                  INTO rs_sflight_converted-price_eur CURRENCY rs_sflight_converted-currency_eur.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        rs_sflight_converted-error_message = lx_conversion_error->get_text( ).
        rs_sflight_converted-price_eur = 0.
        rs_sflight_converted-currency_eur = lv_target_currency.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_sflight_converted-error_message = lx_root->get_text( ).
        rs_sflight_converted-price_eur = 0.
        rs_sflight_converted-currency_eur = lv_target_currency.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_safe_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_safe_conversion_error FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_conversion_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_error_handling( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-price = '100.00'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(ls_converted) = lo_cut->convert_price_safe( ls_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_converted-error_message msg = 'No error expected for valid conversion' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted-currency_eur exp = 'EUR' msg = 'Target currency should be EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_converted-price_eur msg = 'Converted price should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_safe_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calc_error_handling( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-price = '100.00'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste, die dynamisch Spalten basierend auf einer Konfiguration ein- oder ausblendet und deren Reihenfolge ändert. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Features für die dynamische Feldkatalogerstellung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_list_layout` und erstellen Sie den Feldkatalog dynamisch mit `FOR` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_config,
             fieldname TYPE fieldname,
             visible   TYPE abap_bool,
             position  TYPE i,
             text      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_column_config.
    TYPES tt_column_config TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_config WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_config   TYPE tt_column_config.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_columns.
    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).

    DATA(lt_field_catalog) = VALUE cl_abap_list_layout=>tt_field_catalog(
      FOR ls_config IN it_config
      WHERE ( ls_config-visible = abap_true )
      (
        fieldname = ls_config-fieldname,
        text      = ls_config-text,
        col_pos   = ls_config-position
      )
    ).

    SORT lt_field_catalog BY col_pos.

    lo_list_layout->set_field_catalog( it_field_catalog = lt_field_catalog ).
    lo_list_layout->set_data( it_data = it_sflights ).
    lo_list_layout->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Währungsumrechnung für eine Liste von Flugpreisen durch, wobei die Zielwährung und das Umrechnungsdatum dynamisch pro Eintrag variieren können. Nutzen Sie dabei den `FOR`-Operator und `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `IN` und `CALCULATE` innerhalb des `VALUE`-Operators, um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calc_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_dynamic_conv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             target_currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             conversion_date TYPE sy-datum,
             converted_price TYPE sflight-price,
             converted_currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_dynamic_conv.
    TYPES tt_sflight_dynamic_conv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_dynamic_conv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_dynamic_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_dynamic_conv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_dynamic_conv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calc_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_dynamic_prices.
    rt_converted_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight_dynamic_conv(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      LET lv_converted_price = ls_flight-price
          lv_converted_currency = ls_flight-currency IN
        (
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid = ls_flight-connid,
          price = ls_flight-price,
          currency = ls_flight-currency,
          target_currency = ls_flight-target_currency,
          conversion_date = ls_flight-conversion_date,
          converted_price = CALCULATE ls_flight-price CURRENCY ls_flight-currency
                                    FROM ls_flight-target_currency
                                    ON ls_flight-conversion_date
                                    INTO lv_converted_price CURRENCY lv_converted_currency,
          converted_currency = lv_converted_currency
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_list_styling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_styled_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_styling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_styled_sflights.
    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).
    lo_list_layout->set_data( it_data = it_sflights ).

    DATA(lt_row_styles) = VALUE cl_abap_list_layout=>tt_row_styles(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( ls_sflight-price > iv_price_threshold )

        style     = cl_abap_list_layout=>c_style_critical
      )
    ).

    lo_list_layout->set_row_styles( it_row_styles = lt_row_styles ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste, die sowohl Flugdaten als auch die umgerechneten Preise in EUR anzeigt. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_list_layout` und kombinieren Sie `SELECT` mit `CALCULATE` für die Datenbeschaffung.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `SELECT`-Anweisung, um die Daten zu holen, und führen Sie die `CALCULATE`-Anweisung direkt im `LOOP` über die Ergebnisse durch, bevor Sie die Daten an `cl_abap_list_layout` übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_calc_combined DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             price_eur TYPE sflight-price,
             currency_eur TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights_with_converted_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_calc_combined IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_converted_price.
    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_display) = VALUE tt_sflight_display( ).

    DATA(lv_target_currency) = 'EUR'.
    DATA(lv_conversion_date) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      DATA(ls_display_line) = CORRESPONDING ty_sflight_display( ls_sflight_raw ).

      TRY.
          CALCULATE ls_sflight_raw-price CURRENCY ls_sflight_raw-currency
                    FROM lv_target_currency
                    ON lv_conversion_date
                    INTO ls_display_line-price_eur CURRENCY ls_display_line-currency_eur.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          ls_display_line-price_eur = 0.
          ls_display_line-currency_eur = lv_target_currency.
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND ls_display_line TO lt_sflights_display.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_list_layout->set_data( it_data = lt_sflights_display ).
    lo_list_layout->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combined_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combined_display.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_list_calc_combined( ).

    " We can't directly test the UI display, but we can test if the method runs.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_flights_with_converted_price( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump expected' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Dump occurred during display' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Datenbeschaffung mittels `SELECT` mit der Währungsumrechnung durch `CALCULATE` in einem `LOOP`. Die vorbereiteten Daten, die sowohl Original- als auch umgerechnete Preise enthalten, werden dann von `cl_abap_list_layout` angezeigt. Dies zeigt, wie verschiedene moderne ABAP-Features nahtlos zusammenarbeiten können, um komplexe Anforderungen zu erfüllen.
keywords: cl_abap_list_layout, CALCULATE, SELECT, LOOP, currency, data preparation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste, die die Flugdaten anzeigt und zusätzlich eine berechnete Spalte 'Status' enthält, die 'High Price' oder 'Normal Price' basierend auf dem Preis anzeigt. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_list_layout` und moderne ABAP-Ausdrücke.

CLASS zcl_list_calculated_col DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_list_calculated_col IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).

    DATA(lt_display_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_with_status(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights

        carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price = ls_sflight-price,
        currency = ls_sflight-currency,
        status = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN 'High Price' ELSE 'Normal Price' )

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculated_column.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.

explanation: Die Erstellung einer berechneten Spalte direkt im `VALUE`-Operator mit `FOR` und `COND` ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster. CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flugnummer und den Preis aller Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, deren Preis über 500 liegt, und multiplizieren Sie den Preis mit 1.1 (10% Aufschlag).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_flight_price,
      tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_adjusted_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_adjusted_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_adjusted_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( price > 500 )
        ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid   = ls_sflight-connid
          price    = ls_sflight-price * '1.1'
          currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_adjusted_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjusted_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_adjusted_prices) = lo_cut->get_adjusted_flight_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_adjusted_prices ).
    IF lines( lt_adjusted_prices ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_adjusted_prices[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_entry-price > 500 * '1.1' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR ... IN ... WHERE (...)` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code sehr prägnant und effizient macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, um einen String zu verarbeiten (z.B. trimmen, in Großbuchstaben umwandeln, dann ein Präfix hinzufügen).
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain.
    METHODS add_prefix IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    mv_string = cl_abap_string_util=>trim( mv_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_string = to_upper( mv_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    mv_string = |{ iv_prefix }{ mv_string }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_main_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_example
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_main_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_example.
    rv_output = NEW zcl_method_chain( '  hello world  ' )->trim( )->to_upper( )->add_prefix( 'ABAP: ' )->get_result( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chain.
    DATA(lo_main) = NEW zcl_main_method_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_main->run_example( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABAP: HELLO WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies führt zu einem flüssigeren und oft lesbareren Code, insbesondere bei Fluent Interfaces. Jede Methode, die das Chaining fortsetzen soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, String Processing

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Verketten Sie die Namen aller Fluggesellschaften (Feld CARRNAME) aus der Tabelle SCARR zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch ein Komma und Leerzeichen.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE in Kombination mit FOR ... IN GROUP und GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        total_price TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_summaries = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
        INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
        FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
        GROUP BY carrid
        LET current_carrid = flight-carrid IN
        NEXT result = VALUE #( 
            BASE result
            ( carrid       = current_carrid
              flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT c = c + 1 )
              total_price  = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT p = 0 FOR f IN GROUP flight NEXT p = p + f-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    " Assert that the table is not empty if SFLIGHT has data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = lines( lt_summaries ) > 0
        msg = 'Summary table should not be empty' ).

    " Find a specific carrier and check its summary (requires known test data)
    " DATA(ls_summary_aa) = lt_summaries[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-total_price exp = 3000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von REDUCE mit FOR GROUPS OF ... BY für Gruppierungen und Aggregationen. Innerhalb der GROUP-Schleife werden weitere REDUCE-Operatoren verwendet, um die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis pro Gruppe zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um komplexe Datenaggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_reduce_map_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_map( )
        FOR carrier IN lt_scarr
        NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = carrier-carrid carrname = carrier-carrname ) ) ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHT, die im Jahr 2025 stattfinden und deren Preis über 1000 liegt. Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um die Anzahl dieser Flüge zu zählen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie REDUCE mit FOR und einer komplexeren WHERE-Bedingung, die auch String-Operationen für das Datum beinhaltet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( fldate >= '20250101' AND fldate <= '20251231' AND price > 1000 )
        NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assert that the count is non-negative. For a precise test, specific data is needed.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = lv_actual_count >= 0
        msg = 'Count should be non-negative' ).

    " Example with test data:
    " INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 1200 currency = 'EUR' ) .
    " INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20240101' price = 1500 currency = 'USD' ) .

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (SCARR) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die CARRID und eine berechnete 'Carrier Code' Spalte enthält, die aus den ersten beiden Zeichen des CARRID besteht, gefolgt von '-CODE'. Verwenden Sie REDUCE für die Transformation.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE mit VALUE #( BASE result ... ) und String-Operationen oder String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_transform_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_code,
             carrid     TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrier_code TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_code.
    TYPES tt_carrier_code TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_code WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_codes RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_codes) TYPE tt_carrier_code.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_transform_scarr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_codes.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_carrier_codes = REDUCE tt_carrier_code(
        INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_code( )
        FOR carrier IN lt_scarr
        NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                                ( carrid = carrier-carrid
                                  carrier_code = |{ substring( val = carrier-carrid len = 2 ) }-CODE| ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR und CL_SALV_COLUMN_LIST. Die ALV-Metadaten werden intern durch Klassen wie CL_SALV_CONTROLLER_METADATA verwaltet.

CLASS zcl_salv_rtti_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_rtti_headers.
