CLASS zcl_salv_rtti_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_rtti_headers.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflight
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column_list) = lo_columns->get_column_list( ).

        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflight )->get_table_line_type( ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          DATA(lv_column_name) = ls_component-name.
          DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_name ).
          IF lo_column IS BOUND.
            lo_column->set_long_text( to_upper( lv_column_name ) ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_abap_descr_ref_error INTO DATA(lx_descr_error).
        MESSAGE lx_descr_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_with_custom_function.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_scarr
        ).

        DATA(lo_functions) = lo_salv_table->get_functions( ).
        lo_functions->add_function(
          name     = gc_custom_function
          tooltip  = 'Meine benutzerdefinierte Funktion'
          text     = 'Custom Func'
          icon     = icon_execute_object
          position = if_salv_c_function_position=>right_of_salv_functions
        ).

        DATA(lo_events) = lo_salv_table->get_event_manager( ).
        SET HANDLER handle_function_selected FOR lo_events.

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_function_selected.
    IF e_salv_function = gc_custom_function.
      MESSAGE 'Benutzerdefinierte Funktion geklickt!' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    IF cl_rest_status_code=>is_client_error( iv_code = iv_status_code ).

    ELSE IF cl_rest_status_code=>is_server_error( iv_code = iv_status_code ).
      rv_message = |Server-Fehler ({ iv_status_code }): Internes Problem auf dem Server.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Kein Fehler oder unbekannter Status ({ iv_status_code }).|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Listenlayout für eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), filtern Sie die Daten nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die Datenreduktion und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation des Durchschnittspreises.
solution:
CLASS zcl_all_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_filtered_avg_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_all_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_avg_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab FROM lt_sflights
                                 WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE dmbtr(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_avg_price) = COND dmbtr(
      WHEN lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights )
      ELSE 0
    ).

    DATA(lo_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( )->set_header_text( |Durchschnittspreis für Flüge von { iv_carrid }| )
                                        ->add_column( iv_fieldname = 'CARRID' iv_text = 'Airline' )
                                        ->add_column( iv_fieldname = 'CONNID' iv_text = 'Flugnr.' )
                                        ->add_column( iv_fieldname = 'PRICE' iv_text = 'Preis' )
                                        ->set_footer_text( |Durchschnittspreis: { lv_avg_price }| ).

    lo_layout->display( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rsc_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_status_constant TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rsc_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_message_from_constant.
    CASE iv_status_constant.
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>c_200_ok.
        rv_message = 'Operation erfolgreich (OK)'.
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>c_404_not_found.
        rv_message = 'Ressource nicht gefunden (Not Found)'.
      WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>c_500_internal_server_error.
        rv_message = 'Interner Serverfehler (Internal Server Error)'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine binäre Beziehung zwischen zwei generischen Objekten (z.B. 'OBJ_A' und 'OBJ_B') vom Typ 'GENERIC_REL' und rufe diese Beziehung anschließend ab.
hint: Nutze `cl_binary_relation=>create_link` und `cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_relation_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_link_info,
             link_id        TYPE sibflguid,
             object_id_a    TYPE string,
             object_type_a  TYPE string,
             object_id_b    TYPE string,
             object_type_b  TYPE string,
             relation_type  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_link_info.
    TYPES tt_link_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_link_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_link_and_get_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id_a TYPE string
        iv_object_id_b TYPE string
        iv_relation_type TYPE string DEFAULT 'GENERIC_REL'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_link_id) TYPE sibflguid.

    METHODS get_links_for_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id   TYPE string
        iv_object_type TYPE string DEFAULT 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ'
        iv_relation_type TYPE string DEFAULT 'GENERIC_REL'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_links) TYPE tt_link_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_relation_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_link_and_get_id.
    DATA(lo_relation) = cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      i_object_id_a    = iv_object_id_a
      i_object_type_a  = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ'
      i_object_id_b    = iv_object_id_b
      i_object_type_b  = 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ'
      i_relation_type  = iv_relation_type
    ).
    rv_link_id = lo_relation->get_link_id( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_links_for_object.
    DATA(lt_raw_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object(
      i_object_id   = iv_object_id
      i_object_type = iv_object_type
      i_relation_type = iv_relation_type
    ).

    rt_links = VALUE #( FOR <link> IN lt_raw_links
                        ( link_id       = <link>-link_id
                          object_id_a   = <link>-object_id_a
                          object_type_a = <link>-object_type_a
                          object_id_b   = <link>-object_id_b
                          object_type_b = <link>-object_type_b
                          relation_type = <link>-relation_type ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_get_link FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_get_link.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_relation_basic( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_a) = 'OBJ_A_' && sy-uzeit. " Unique ID for test
    DATA(lv_obj_b) = 'OBJ_B_' && sy-uzeit. " Unique ID for test
    DATA(lv_relation_type) = 'GENERIC_REL_TEST'.

    " Create a link
    DATA(lv_link_id) = lo_cut->create_link_and_get_id(
      iv_object_id_a   = lv_obj_a
      iv_object_id_b   = lv_obj_b
      iv_relation_type = lv_relation_type
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Link ID should not be initial' act = lv_link_id ).

    " Get links for object A
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_links_for_object(
      iv_object_id   = lv_obj_a
      iv_relation_type = lv_relation_type
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'One link should be found' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Object A should match' act = lt_result[1]-object_id_a exp = lv_obj_a ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Object B should match' act = lt_result[1]-object_id_b exp = lv_obj_b ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Relation type should match' act = lt_result[1]-relation_type exp = lv_relation_type ).

    " Clean up the created link
    cl_binary_relation=>get_link_by_id( lv_link_id )->delete_link( ).
    COMMIT WORK. " Ensure deletion is persisted for subsequent checks

    " Verify deletion
    DATA(lt_after_delete) = lo_cut->get_links_for_object(
      iv_object_id   = lv_obj_a
      iv_relation_type = lv_relation_type
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No links should be found after deletion' act = lines( lt_after_delete ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung demonstriert die Erstellung und Abfrage binärer Beziehungen mit `cl_binary_relation`. Die Methode `create_link_and_get_id` erstellt eine Beziehung und gibt deren ID zurück, während `get_links_for_object` alle Beziehungen für ein gegebenes Objekt abruft. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für die Transformation der Ergebnisdaten ist ein Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax, die Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. Die Beziehungen werden generisch zwischen Objekten vom Typ 'Z_GENERIC_OBJ' hergestellt.

Instructions: Definiere eine benutzerdefinierte binäre Beziehung 'PRODUCT_COMPONENT' zwischen Produkten und Komponenten. Füge ein Attribut 'QUANTITY' hinzu, das die Menge der Komponente im Produkt speichert. Erstelle eine solche Beziehung und rufe sie mit Attribut ab.
hint: Nutze `cl_binary_relation=>create_link` mit `i_relation_type` und `i_attributes` (als XML-String).
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_rel_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             product_id   TYPE string,
             component_id TYPE string,
             quantity     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_product_component_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_id   TYPE string
        iv_component_id TYPE string
        iv_quantity     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_link_id) TYPE sibflguid.

    METHODS get_product_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product_component_link.
    DATA(lv_attributes_xml) = `<ATTRIBUTES><QUANTITY>` && iv_quantity && `</QUANTITY></ATTRIBUTES>`. " Modern String Template

    DATA(lo_relation) = cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      i_object_id_a    = iv_product_id
      i_object_type_a  = 'Z_PRODUCT'
      i_object_id_b    = iv_component_id
      i_object_type_b  = 'Z_COMPONENT'
      i_relation_type  = 'PRODUCT_COMPONENT'
      i_attributes     = lv_attributes_xml
    ).
    rv_link_id = lo_relation->get_link_id( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_product_components.
    DATA(lt_raw_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object(
      i_object_id   = iv_product_id
      i_object_type = 'Z_PRODUCT'
      i_relation_type = 'PRODUCT_COMPONENT'
    ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR <link> IN lt_raw_links
                             LET lv_quantity_xml = cl_binary_relation=>get_attribute(
                                                     i_link_id = <link>-link_id
                                                     i_attribute_name = 'QUANTITY' )
                                 lv_quantity = COND i( WHEN lv_quantity_xml IS NOT INITIAL THEN cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create_by_encoding( )->uc_to_int( lv_quantity_xml ) ELSE 0 )
                             IN
                             ( product_id   = <link>-object_id_a
                               component_id = <link>-object_id_b
                               quantity     = lv_quantity ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_product_component_link FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_product_component_link.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_rel_attributes( ).
    DATA(lv_product_id) = 'PROD_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_component_id) = 'COMP_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_quantity) = 5.

    " Create link with attribute
    DATA(lv_link_id) = lo_cut->create_product_component_link(
      iv_product_id   = lv_product_id
      iv_component_id = lv_component_id
      iv_quantity     = lv_quantity
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Link ID should not be initial' act = lv_link_id ).

    " Get components for product
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_product_components( iv_product_id = lv_product_id ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'One component should be found' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Product ID should match' act = lt_result[1]-product_id exp = lv_product_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Component ID should match' act = lt_result[1]-component_id exp = lv_component_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Quantity should match' act = lt_result[1]-quantity exp = lv_quantity ).

    " Clean up
    cl_binary_relation=>get_link_by_id( lv_link_id )->delete_link( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die alle indirekten Komponenten eines Produkts in einer mehrstufigen 'PRODUCT_COMPONENT'-Beziehung rekursiv findet.
hint: Nutze eine rekursive Hilfsmethode, die `cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object` verwendet, um die Hierarchie zu durchlaufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_rel_recursion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_component_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_subcomponents
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_subcomponents) TYPE tt_component_ids.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _get_subcomponents_recursive
      IMPORTING
        iv_current_id TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_found_components TYPE tt_component_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_recursion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_subcomponents.
    _get_subcomponents_recursive(
      iv_current_id       = iv_product_id
      CHANGING
        ct_found_components = rt_subcomponents
    ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_subcomponents. " Remove duplicates if a component is used multiple times
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_subcomponents_recursive.
    DATA(lt_raw_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object(
      i_object_id   = iv_current_id
      i_object_type = 'Z_PRODUCT' " Assuming components can also be 'products' in a sub-assembly context
      i_relation_type = 'PRODUCT_COMPONENT'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_raw_links INTO DATA(ls_link).
      DATA(lv_component_id) = ls_link-object_id_b.
      IF NOT line_exists( ct_found_components[ table_line = lv_component_id ] ).
        APPEND lv_component_id TO ct_found_components.
        " Recursively find sub-components of this component
        _get_subcomponents_recursive(
          iv_current_id       = lv_component_id
          CHANGING
            ct_found_components = ct_found_components
        ).
      ENDIF.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_recursive_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_recursive_components.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_rel_recursion( ).
    DATA(lo_rel_creator) = NEW zcl_bin_rel_attributes( ). " Re-use creator from example 2

    DATA(lv_prod_a) = 'PROD_A_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_comp_b) = 'COMP_B_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_comp_c) = 'COMP_C_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_comp_d) = 'COMP_D_' && sy-uzeit.

    " Create a hierarchy: A -> B, B -> C, B -> D
    DATA(lv_link_ab) = lo_rel_creator->create_product_component_link( lv_prod_a lv_comp_b 1 ).
    DATA(lv_link_bc) = lo_rel_creator->create_product_component_link( lv_comp_b lv_comp_c 1 ).
    DATA(lv_link_bd) = lo_rel_creator->create_product_component_link( lv_comp_b lv_comp_d 1 ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_subcomponents) = lo_cut->get_all_subcomponents( iv_product_id = lv_prod_a ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 subcomponents' act = lines( lt_subcomponents ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Component B should be found' act = line_exists( lt_subcomponents[ table_line = lv_comp_b ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Component C should be found' act = line_exists( lt_subcomponents[ table_line = lv_comp_c ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Component D should be found' act = line_exists( lt_subcomponents[ table_line = lv_comp_d ] ) ).

    " Clean up
    cl_binary_relation=>get_link_by_id( lv_link_ab )->delete_link( ).
    cl_binary_relation=>get_link_by_id( lv_link_bc )->delete_link( ).
    cl_binary_relation=>get_link_by_id( lv_link_bd )->delete_link( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die rekursive Traversierung von Beziehungen, die mit `cl_binary_relation` erstellt wurden. Eine private Hilfsmethode wird verwendet, um die Hierarchie zu durchlaufen und doppelte Einträge zu vermeiden. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für die Arbeit mit Graphenstrukturen in ABAP.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, Recursion, Graph Traversal, ABAP 7.55, get_links_for_object

Instructions: Lösche eine spezifische binäre Beziehung zwischen zwei Objekten und überprüfe anschließend, ob diese Beziehung nicht mehr existiert.
hint: Nutze `cl_binary_relation=>get_link_by_id` und die Instanzmethode `delete_link` sowie `cl_binary_relation=>link_exists`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_rel_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_delete_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id_a TYPE string
        iv_object_id_b TYPE string
        iv_relation_type TYPE string DEFAULT 'TEST_DEL_REL'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_delete_link.
    DATA(lo_relation) = cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      i_object_id_a    = iv_object_id_a
      i_object_type_a  = 'Z_DEL_OBJ'
      i_object_id_b    = iv_object_id_b
      i_object_type_b  = 'Z_DEL_OBJ'
      i_relation_type  = iv_relation_type
    ).
    DATA(lv_link_id) = lo_relation->get_link_id( ).

    " Check if link exists before deletion
    IF cl_binary_relation=>link_exists( i_link_id = lv_link_id ).
      lo_relation->delete_link( ).
      COMMIT WORK. " Persist deletion
      " Check if link exists after deletion
      IF NOT cl_binary_relation=>link_exists( i_link_id = lv_link_id ).
        rv_deleted = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_link FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_link.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_rel_delete( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_a) = 'DEL_A_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_obj_b) = 'DEL_B_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_relation_type) = 'TEST_DEL_REL'.

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->create_and_delete_link(
      iv_object_id_a   = lv_obj_a
      iv_object_id_b   = lv_obj_b
      iv_relation_type = lv_relation_type
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Link should have been deleted' act = lv_deleted ).

    " Verify that the link truly does not exist anymore
    DATA(lt_remaining_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object(
      i_object_id   = lv_obj_a
      i_object_type = 'Z_DEL_OBJ'
      i_relation_type = lv_relation_type
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No links should remain for object A' act = lines( lt_remaining_links ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_time_chart_multi_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             date TYPE d,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_series_data.
    TYPES tt_series_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_series_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_series,
             name TYPE string,
             data TYPE tt_series_data,
           END OF ty_chart_series.
    TYPES tt_chart_series TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_series WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_airline_flights_chart_data
      IMPORTING
        it_airlines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY

CLASS zcl_time_chart_multi_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_flights_chart_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    rt_chart_series = VALUE #( FOR lv_airline IN it_airlines
                                LET lt_filtered_flights = FILTER sflights_tab FROM lt_sflights WHERE carrid = lv_airline
                                    lt_series_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights BY ls_flight-fldate
                                                               ( date  = ls_flight-fldate
                                                                 value = GROUP SIZE ) )
                                IN
                                ( name = lv_airline
                                  data = lt_series_data ) ).

    LOOP AT rt_chart_series ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_series>).
      SORT <fs_series>-data BY date ASCENDING.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_chart_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_time_chart_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights_chart_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `REDUCE` um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_chart_avg_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             date TYPE d,
             avg_duration TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_flight_duration_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_chart_avg_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_flight_duration_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT fldate, fltime FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-fldate
                             LET lv_total_duration = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <f> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT sum = sum + <f>-fltime )
                                 lv_group_size = GROUP SIZE
                             IN
                             ( date         = ls_flight-fldate
                               avg_duration = COND decfloat16( WHEN lv_group_size > 0 THEN lv_total_duration / lv_group_size ELSE 0 ) ) ).
    SORT rt_chart_data BY date ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Zuerst Beziehungen mit `cl_binary_relation` abfragen, dann die relevanten `sflights` Daten für `cl_time_chart_simple` filtern und aggregieren.

CLASS zcl_mix_rel_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             date TYPE d,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_event_related_flights_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_event_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_rel_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_event_related_flights_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    " 1. Get all flight IDs related to the event via binary relation
    DATA(lt_related_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object(
      i_object_id   = iv_event_id
      i_object_type = 'Z_EVENT'
      i_relation_type = 'EVENT_FLIGHT'
    ).

    DATA(lt_related_flight_ids) = VALUE s_conn_id_tab( FOR ls_link IN lt_related_links
                                                      ( ls_link-object_id_b ) ).

    IF lt_related_flight_ids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Select flights based on these IDs and aggregate
    SELECT fldate, connid
      FROM sflights
      WHERE connid IN @lt_related_flight_ids
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-fldate
                             ( date  = ls_flight-fldate
                               count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
    SORT rt_chart_data BY date ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_flights_chart.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mix_rel_chart( ).
    DATA(lo_rel_creator) = NEW zcl_bin_relation_basic( ). " Re-use creator

    DATA(lv_event_id) = 'EVENT_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_flight_id_1) = '0001'. " Example flight ID from SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lv_flight_id_2) = '0002'. " Example flight ID from SFLIGHTS

    " Create dummy links: Event -> Flight 0001, Event -> Flight 0002
    DATA(lv_link_1) = cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      i_object_id_a    = lv_event_id
      i_object_type_a  = 'Z_EVENT'
      i_object_id_b    = lv_flight_id_1
      i_object_type_b  = 'Z_FLIGHT'
      i_relation_type  = 'EVENT_FLIGHT'
    ).
    DATA(lv_link_2) = cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      i_object_id_a    = lv_event_id
      i_object_type_a  = 'Z_EVENT'
      i_object_id_b    = lv_flight_id_2
      i_object_type_b  = 'Z_FLIGHT'
      i_relation_type  = 'EVENT_FLIGHT'
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_cut->get_event_related_flights_data( iv_event_id = lv_event_id ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Chart data should not be empty' act = lines( lt_chart_data ) ).
    " Assuming flights 0001 and 0002 exist and have different dates, or at least one entry
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one flight entry expected' act = ( lines( lt_chart_data ) >= 1 ) ).

    " Clean up
    lv_link_1->delete_link( ).
    lv_link_2->delete_link( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_check_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_manage_link.
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'Z_CHECK_OBJ'.

    " Check if link exists before creation (should be false)
    IF cl_binary_relation=>link_exists(
         i_object_id_a    = iv_object_id_a
         i_object_type_a  = lv_object_type
         i_object_id_b    = iv_object_id_b
         i_object_type_b  = lv_object_type
         i_relation_type  = iv_relation_type
       ) = abap_true.
      " Should not happen in a clean test, but handle if it does
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create the link
    DATA(lo_relation) = cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      i_object_id_a    = iv_object_id_a
      i_object_type_a  = lv_object_type
      i_object_id_b    = iv_object_id_b
      i_object_type_b  = lv_object_type
      i_relation_type  = iv_relation_type
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Check if link exists after creation (should be true)
    IF cl_binary_relation=>link_exists(
         i_object_id_a    = iv_object_id_a
         i_object_type_a  = lv_object_type
         i_object_id_b    = iv_object_id_b
         i_object_type_b  = lv_object_type
         i_relation_type  = iv_relation_type
       ) = abap_true.
      rv_exists_after_creation = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    " Clean up: Delete the link
    lo_relation->delete_link( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Objekte, die mit einem gegebenen Objekt über eine bestimmte binäre Beziehung verknüpft sind, und zwar in beide Richtungen (als Objekt A oder Objekt B).
hint: Nutze `cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object` und `get_links_of_object` und kombiniere die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_rel_bidirectional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_related_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_bidirectional_relations
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id     TYPE string
        iv_object_type   TYPE string DEFAULT 'Z_BI_OBJ'
        iv_relation_type TYPE string DEFAULT 'BI_REL'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_related_objects) TYPE tt_related_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_rel_bidirectional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_bidirectional_relations.
    " Links where iv_object_id is Object A
    DATA(lt_links_as_a) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_for_object(
      i_object_id   = iv_object_id
      i_object_type = iv_object_type
      i_relation_type = iv_relation_type
    ).

    " Links where iv_object_id is Object B
    DATA(lt_links_as_b) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links_of_object(
      i_object_id   = iv_object_id
      i_object_type = iv_object_type
      i_relation_type = iv_relation_type
    ).

    rt_related_objects = VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_links_as_a ( ls_link-object_id_b ) )
                         && VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_links_as_b ( ls_link-object_id_a ) ).

    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_related_objects.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_bidirectional_links FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bidirectional_links.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_rel_bidirectional( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_center) = 'CENTER_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_obj_left) = 'LEFT_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_obj_right) = 'RIGHT_' && sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_relation_type) = 'BI_REL_TEST'.

    " Create links: LEFT -> CENTER, CENTER -> RIGHT
    DATA(lo_link_lc) = cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      i_object_id_a    = lv_obj_left
      i_object_type_a  = 'Z_BI_OBJ'
      i_object_id_b    = lv_obj_center
      i_object_type_b  = 'Z_BI_OBJ'
      i_relation_type  = lv_relation_type
    ).
    DATA(lo_link_cr) = cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
      i_object_id_a    = lv_obj_center
      i_object_type_a  = 'Z_BI_OBJ'
      i_object_id_b    = lv_obj_right
      i_object_type_b  = 'Z_BI_OBJ'
      i_relation_type  = lv_relation_type
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_related) = lo_cut->get_bidirectional_relations(
      iv_object_id     = lv_obj_center
      iv_relation_type = lv_relation_type
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 related objects' act = lines( lt_related ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Left object should be found' act = line_exists( lt_related[ table_line = lv_obj_left ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Right object should be found' act = line_exists( lt_related[ table_line = lv_obj_right ] ) ).

    " Clean up
    lo_link_lc->delete_link( ).
    lo_link_cr->delete_link( ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man bidirektionale Beziehungen mit `cl_binary_relation` abfragt. Es verwendet sowohl `get_links_for_object` (wo das Objekt A ist) als auch `get_links_of_object` (wo das Objekt B ist) und kombiniert die Ergebnisse mit dem `&&` Operator für interne Tabellen (ABAP 7.50+). Doppelte Einträge werden anschließend entfernt.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, Bidirectional Relations, get_links_for_object, get_links_of_object, Internal Table Concatenation, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Berechne die kumulative Anzahl der Flüge über die Zeit aus der Tabelle `sflights` und gib die Datenstruktur für ein Zeitdiagramm zurück.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` mit einem kumulativen Zähler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_chart_cumulative DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             date TYPE d,
             cumulative_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cumulative_flights_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_chart_cumulative IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_flights_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.
    SORT lt_sflights BY fldate ASCENDING.

    DATA(lt_daily_counts) = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-fldate
                                     ( date  = ls_flight-fldate
                                       count = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    DATA(lv_cumulative_sum) = 0.
    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_daily IN lt_daily_counts
                             ( date             = ls_daily-date
                               cumulative_count = ( lv_cumulative_sum = lv_cumulative_sum + ls_daily-count ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cumulative_flights_chart FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_flights_chart.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_time_chart_cumulative( ).
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_flights_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Chart data should not be empty' act = lines( lt_chart_data ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Data should be sorted by date' act = ( lt_chart_data IS SORTED BY date ASCENDING ) ).

    DATA(lv_last_cumulative_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Cumulative count should be non-decreasing' act = ( ls_data-cumulative_count >= lv_last_cumulative_count ) ).
      lv_last_cumulative_count = ls_data-cumulative_count.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check if the final cumulative count is reasonable (e.g., matches total flights in the sample)
    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO lv_total_flights UP TO 200 ROWS.
    IF lines( lt_chart_data ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Final cumulative count should match total flights' act = lt_chart_data[ lines( lt_chart_data ) ]-cumulative_count exp = lv_total_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel berechnet die kumulative Anzahl der Flüge über die Zeit. Zuerst werden die täglichen Flugzahlen mit `FOR GROUPS OF` aggregiert. Anschließend wird ein weiterer `FOR` Ausdruck verwendet, um die kumulative Summe zu berechnen, indem eine Variable (`lv_cumulative_sum`) innerhalb der Schleife aktualisiert wird. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für die Berechnung von Running Totals in modernen ABAP-Ausdrücken (ABAP 7.55+).
keywords: cl_time_chart_simple, sflights, Cumulative Sum, FOR, FOR GROUPS OF, ABAP 7.55, Running Total

Instructions: Lese Flugdaten aus `sflights` und füge eine Spalte `FLIGHT_STATUS` hinzu. Der Status soll 'ON_TIME' sein, wenn `fldate` in der Zukunft liegt, sonst 'PAST_FLIGHT'.
hint: Verwende eine `CASE` Expression direkt im `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid       TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate       TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE WHEN fldate > @sy-datum THEN 'ON_TIME'
                ELSE 'PAST_FLIGHT'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_data).

    rt_flights = lt_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_status( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum.

CLASS zcl_sflight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Flight count for LH should not be zero' act = ls_agg-flight_count exp = 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Total seats for LH should not be zero' act = ls_agg-total_seats_occupied exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT(*)` und `SUM()` direkt im `SELECT`-Statement ermöglicht die effiziente Berechnung von Kennzahlen auf Datenbankebene. Dies vermeidet das manuelle Iterieren und Summieren in ABAP und ist performanter für große Datenmengen.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, COUNT, SUM, Aggregate Functions, sflights

Instructions: Kombiniere die Flugnummern (connid) aus `sflights` für die Fluggesellschaften 'LH' und 'AA' in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste.
hint: Verwende den `UNION` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_connid.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_union_connids RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_union_connids.
    SELECT connid FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      UNION
    SELECT connid FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_connids).

    rt_connids = lt_connids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_union( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_union_connids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lt_connids IS INITIAL ).

    " Check if some expected connids are present (assuming 'LH' and 'AA' have data)
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_count_lh.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @lv_count_aa.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Union result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 0 ).
    " The exact count depends on distinct connids, so just check if it's not zero if source tables have data
    IF lv_count_lh > 0 OR lv_count_aa > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Union result should contain entries' act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `UNION` Operator in Open SQL ermöglicht das Kombinieren der Ergebnismengen mehrerer `SELECT`-Statements. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Daten aus verschiedenen Abfragen zu vereinigen, ohne sie manuell in ABAP zusammenführen zu müssen. `UNION` entfernt automatisch Duplikate.
keywords: SELECT, UNION, sflights, Database Access

Instructions: Erstelle eine Classrun-Klasse, die die ersten 3 Flüge aus `sflights` liest und deren Flugnummern auf der Konsole ausgibt.

CLASS zcl_cls_read_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_top_n_flights( 3 ).
    out->write( |Top 3 Flights:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |  Carrier: { ls_flight-carrid }, Connection: { ls_flight-connid }| ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_top_n_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should retrieve exactly 5 flights' ).

    DATA(lt_flights_default) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_default ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should retrieve exactly 3 flights by default' ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UP TO n ROWS` Klausel im `SELECT`-Statement ist eine effiziente Methode, um eine begrenzte Anzahl von Datensätzen von der Datenbank abzurufen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Vorschauen oder Paginierung und reduziert den Netzwerk-Traffic und die Verarbeitungszeit. Die `if_oo_adt_classrun` Klasse dient hier als einfacher Ausführer.
keywords: if_oo_adt_classrun, SELECT, UP TO, sflights, Database Access

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus `sflights` und filtere anschließend die Flüge heraus, die mehr als 100 freie Sitze haben.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` für die Initialbefüllung und dann `FILTER` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights meet the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight should have more than 100 free seats' act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) > 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Optional: Check if the count is reasonable (e.g., not empty if data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Filtered table should not be empty' act = lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist ein moderner Weg, interne Tabellen deklarativ zu filtern. Er ist effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte, insbesondere wenn die Filterkriterien komplexer werden. Er erzeugt eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
keywords: SELECT, FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstelle eine Classrun-Klasse, die eine Division durch Null provoziert und diese Exception abfängt. Gib eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung aus.
hint: Verwende `TRY...CATCH` und die vordefinierte Exception `cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cls_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    METHODS perform_division
      IMPORTING iv_numerator   TYPE i
                iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cls_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ) ).
    out->write( perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_division.
    DATA: lv_quotient TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lv_quotient = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Result: { lv_quotient }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result = |Error: Division by zero! { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cls_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Result: 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cls_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Division by zero!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke sind der Standardmechanismus für die strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen es, Ausnahmen (Exceptions) gezielt abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Dies ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen.
keywords: if_oo_adt_classrun, TRY...CATCH, Exceptions, Error Handling, cx_sy_arithmetic_error

Instructions: Führe eine `LEFT OUTER JOIN` zwischen `sflights` und `sairport` durch, um den Namen des Abflugflughafens zu jedem Flug hinzuzufügen. Zeige nur Flüge von 'LH' an.
hint: Nutze `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und die Alias-Funktion für Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_airport,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom    TYPE sairport-city,
           END OF ty_flight_with_airport.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_airport TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_airport WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_departure_city RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_airport.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_departure_city.
    SELECT sf~carrid, sf~connid, sf~fldate, sa~city AS cityfrom
      FROM sflights AS sf
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sairport AS sa ON sf~airpfrom = sa~id
      WHERE sf~carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_flights_airports FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_flights_airports.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_departure_city( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Departure city should not be initial' act = ls_flight-cityfrom ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` ist ein Standard-SQL-Feature, das in Open SQL vollständig unterstützt wird. Er ermöglicht das Verknüpfen von Tabellen, wobei alle Zeilen der linken Tabelle (hier `sflights`) beibehalten werden, auch wenn keine passende Zeile in der rechten Tabelle (`sairport`) gefunden wird. Die Verwendung von Tabellen-Aliasen (`sf~`, `sa~`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei Joins.
keywords: SELECT, JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, sflights, sairport, Database Access

Instructions: Erstelle eine Classrun-Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (carrid, connid) in einen String im CSV-Format umwandelt. Nutze `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `CONCAT_LINES_OF` oder manueller String-Verkettung und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cls_reduce_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flights_to_csv
      IMPORTING it_flights    TYPE tt_flight_key
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cls_reduce_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_key(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv) = convert_flights_to_csv( lt_flights ).
    out->write( |CSV Output:\n{ lv_csv }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_flights_to_csv.
    rv_csv_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = 'CARRID,CONNID'
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = s && |\n{ ls_flight-carrid },{ ls_flight-connid }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_to_csv FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_to_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cls_reduce_csv( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_cls_reduce_csv=>tt_flight_key(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '123' )
      ( carrid = 'YY' connid = '456' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_csv) = lo_cut->convert_flights_to_csv( lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lv_expected_csv) = 'CARRID,CONNID\nXX,123\nYY,456'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_csv exp = lv_expected_csv ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges funktionales Konstrukt, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert (hier einen String) zu reduzieren. In Kombination mit `FOR` und String-Templates bietet es eine sehr elegante und effiziente Methode zur Datenaggregation und -transformation, wie hier die Erstellung eines CSV-Strings.
keywords: if_oo_adt_classrun, REDUCE, FOR, String Templates, Data Transformation, CSV

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus `sflights` für die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und sortiere sie nach Flugdatum und Flugnummer. Verwende `ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY`.
hint: Nutze `ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY` für eine performante Sortierung, wenn die Reihenfolge der Primärschlüssel gewünscht ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ordered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ordered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_ordered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ordered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_order( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_ordered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).

    DATA: lv_prev_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
          lv_prev_connid TYPE sflight-connid.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        " Check sorting by fldate, then connid
        IF ls_flight-fldate < lv_prev_fldate.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Flights not sorted by fldate' ).
        ELSE IF ls_flight-fldate = lv_prev_fldate AND ls_flight-connid < lv_prev_connid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Flights not sorted by connid for same fldate' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY` ist eine performante Option in Open SQL, um die Ergebnismenge einer `SELECT`-Anweisung gemäß der Reihenfolge des Primärschlüssels der Datenbanktabelle zu sortieren. Dies ist oft schneller als eine explizite `ORDER BY`-Klausel mit einzelnen Feldern, da der Datenbank-Index direkt genutzt werden kann.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY, sflights, Database Access, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Namen und ein Alter entgegennimmt, eine Begrüßungsnachricht generiert und diese sowie eine Log-Nachricht im Anwendungsprotokoll speichert.

    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).

Instructions: Suchen Sie in der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach einem Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Wenn der Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität zurück. Wenn nicht, protokollieren Sie eine Fehlermeldung.
hint: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke, um direkt auf Zeilen zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_seats) TYPE sflight-max_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_flight) = lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
        rv_max_seats = ls_flight-max_seats.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).

CLASS zcl_log_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_connections_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ( ls_flight-connid ) ).

    IF lines( rt_connids ) IS INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
      DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
        msgty = 'W'
        msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
        msgno = '003' " Replace with a real message number
        msgv1 = iv_carrid
        msgv3 = 'Keine Flüge gefunden'
      ).
      cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg(
        i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( )
        i_s_msg      = ls_msg
      ).
      lo_log->save( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHT. Protokollieren Sie eine Information, wenn die Summe 0 ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die REDUCE Expression für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_max_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-max_seats ).

    IF rv_total_seats = 0.
      DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
      DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
        msgty = 'I'
        msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
        msgno = '004' " Replace with a real message number
        msgv1 = iv_carrid
        msgv3 = 'Keine Sitzplätze summiert oder Summe ist Null'
      ).
      cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg(
        i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( )
        i_s_msg      = ls_msg
      ).
      lo_log->save( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitzplätze eines Fluges, ob der Flug 'voll', 'fast voll' oder 'verfügbar' ist. Protokollieren Sie eine entsprechende Nachricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie die COND Expression für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats
        iv_occup_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_free_seats) = iv_max_seats - iv_occup_seats.
    DATA(lv_occup_ratio) = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_max_seats = 0 THEN 0
                                            ELSE ( iv_occup_seats / iv_max_seats ) ).

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occup_ratio >= '0.9' THEN 'voll'
      WHEN lv_occup_ratio >= '0.7' THEN 'fast voll'
      ELSE 'verfügbar'
    ).

    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '005' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = rv_status
      msgv2 = lv_free_seats
      msgv3 = |Freie Plätze: { lv_free_seats }|
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg(
      i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( )
      i_s_msg      = ls_msg
    ).
    lo_log->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, die einen String verarbeitet (z.B. trimmen, in Großbuchstaben umwandeln) und das Ergebnis zurückgibt. Protokollieren Sie den ursprünglichen und den verarbeiteten String.

CLASS zcl_log_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS trim_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_log_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    rv_output = me->trim_string( iv_input )->to_upper_case( ).

    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    DATA(ls_msg_orig) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '008' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = 'Original String'
      msgv2 = iv_input
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) i_s_msg = ls_msg_orig ).

    DATA(ls_msg_proc) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '009' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = 'Verarbeiteter String'
      msgv2 = rv_output
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) i_s_msg = ls_msg_proc ).
    lo_log->save( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des nächsten Monats, ausgehend vom aktuellen Datum. Protokollieren Sie das aktuelle und das berechnete Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden der Klasse CL_ABAP_TSTMP für Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_date_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_month_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_month_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_date_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_month_date.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ).

    DATA(lv_next_month_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_months( iv_tstmp = lv_current_tstmp iv_months = 1 ).
    cl_abap_tstmp=>get_syst_from_utclong(
      EXPORTING
        iv_utclong = lv_next_month_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        ev_date    = rv_next_month_date
    ).

    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    DATA(ls_msg_curr) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '010' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = 'Aktuelles Datum'
      msgv2 = lv_current_date
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) i_s_msg = ls_msg_curr ).

    DATA(ls_msg_next) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '011' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = 'Datum nächster Monat'
      msgv2 = rv_next_month_date
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) i_s_msg = ls_msg_next ).
    lo_log->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_next_month_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_next_month_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_date_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_next_month) = lo_cut->get_next_month_date( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_date) TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_months( iv_tstmp = lv_current_tstmp iv_months = 1 ).
    cl_abap_tstmp=>get_syst_from_utclong(
      EXPORTING
        iv_utclong = lv_expected_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        ev_date    = lv_expected_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_next_month exp = lv_expected_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein übergebenes Objekt einer bestimmten Klasse angehört und protokollieren Sie das Ergebnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie die RTTI-Funktionalität mit dem IS INSTANCE OF Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_rtti_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_object_type
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_instance) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_rtti_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_object_type.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_message) TYPE string.

    IF io_object IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_rtti_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).
      DATA(lv_actual_class_name) = lo_rtti_descr->get_name( ).

      IF lo_rtti_descr->is_instance_of( p_class_name = iv_class_name ) = abap_true.
        rv_is_instance = abap_true.
        lv_message = |Objekt ist eine Instanz von '{ iv_class_name }'. Tatsächliche Klasse: '{ lv_actual_class_name }'|.
      ELSE.
        rv_is_instance = abap_false.
        lv_message = |Objekt ist KEINE Instanz von '{ iv_class_name }'. Tatsächliche Klasse: '{ lv_actual_class_name }'|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_instance = abap_false.
      lv_message = |Übergebenes Objekt ist nicht gebunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '012' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = iv_class_name
      msgv2 = lv_message
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) i_s_msg = ls_msg ).
    lo_log->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp erzeugt und eine Zeile hinzufügt. Protokollieren Sie den Erfolg oder Misserfolg.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR und CREATE DATA für die dynamische Tabellenerzeugung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_add_row
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
        iv_field_value     TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_add_row.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_message) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_dynamic_table) TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
        ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_dynamic_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_line_descr.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE ANY.
        ASSIGN lr_dynamic_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

        " Assuming the first component of the line structure can be set
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_descr ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        IF lt_components IS NOT INITIAL.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component> TYPE ANY.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lt_components[ 1 ]-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_component>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_component> = iv_field_value.
            APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
            rv_success = abap_true.
            lv_message = |Dynamische Tabelle '{ iv_table_type_name }' erstellt und Zeile hinzugefügt. Wert: '{ iv_field_value }'|.
          ELSE.
            rv_success = abap_false.
            lv_message = |Fehler beim Zugriff auf erste Komponente der Zeile.|.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
          lv_message = |Tabellenzeilentyp '{ iv_table_type_name }' hat keine Komponenten.|.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
        lv_message = |Fehler bei dynamischer Tabellenerzeugung: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = COND sy-msgty( WHEN rv_success = abap_true THEN 'S' ELSE 'E' )
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '013' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = iv_table_type_name
      msgv2 = lv_message
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) i_s_msg = ls_msg ).
    lo_log->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Factory-Muster, das basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter verschiedene Objekttypen erzeugt. Protokollieren Sie die Erstellung des Objekts.
hint: Verwenden Sie Interfaces und den CREATE OBJECT-Befehl mit Typangabe.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_message) TYPE string.

    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_product TYPE zcl_product_a.
        lv_message = 'Product A erstellt'.
      WHEN 'B'.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_product TYPE zcl_product_b.
        lv_message = 'Product B erstellt'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_message = |Unbekannter Produkttyp '{ iv_product_type }'. Kein Objekt erstellt.|.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = COND sy-msgty( WHEN ro_product IS BOUND THEN 'S' ELSE 'E' )
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '014' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = iv_product_type
      msgv2 = lv_message
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) i_s_msg = ls_msg ).
    lo_log->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Protokollieren Sie die Ergebnisse.
hint: Verwenden Sie die GROUP BY-Klausel in einer LOOP-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_flight_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_t_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight_group) GROUP BY ls_flight_group-carrid.
      DATA(ls_flight_count) = VALUE ty_s_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_flight_group-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_flight_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_message) TYPE string.
    LOOP AT rt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_result).
      lv_message = |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_result-carrid }, Anzahl Flüge: { ls_result-flight_count }|.
      DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
        msgty = 'I'
        msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
        msgno = '015' " Replace with a real message number
        msgv1 = ls_result-carrid
        msgv2 = ls_result-flight_count
        msgv3 = lv_message
      ).
      cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg( i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ) i_s_msg = ls_msg ).
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_log->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts ).
    " Example: Check if 'AA' has at least one flight
    DATA(ls_aa_flights) = VALUE zcl_log_group_by=>ty_s_flight_count(
      FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_counts WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' ) ( ls_count )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_aa_flights-flight_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die GROUP BY-Klausel in LOOP-Anweisungen ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit GROUP SIZE können Aggregationen wie das Zählen von Elementen pro Gruppe effizient durchgeführt werden.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP, CL_BAL_LOG, Logging, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzplätzen haben. Protokollieren Sie die Anzahl der gefundenen Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie die FILTER Expression, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_with_min_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_filter_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_min_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( max_seats - seatsocc >= iv_min_free_seats ) ).

    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( rt_filtered_flights ).
    DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'ZMSG' " Replace with a real message class if available
      msgno = '016' " Replace with a real message number
      msgv1 = iv_min_free_seats
      msgv2 = lv_count
      msgv3 = |{ lv_count } Flüge mit mindestens { iv_min_free_seats } freien Plätzen gefunden.|
    ).
    cl_bal_log_msg=>add_msg(
      i_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( )
      i_s_msg      = ls_msg
    ).
    lo_log->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_filter_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_free_seats( 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_log_filter_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_free_seats( 9999 ). " Unlikely to find any
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FILTER Expression bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Sie ist eine moderne Alternative zu LOOPs mit IF-Bedingungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: FILTER Expression, Internal Tables, CL_BAL_LOG, Logging, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem Mindestpreis. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative Filterung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = '1000' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid ). " Check if any entry exists
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ). " Check if any entry exists

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte LH sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-price >= 1000 ) msg = 'Preis sollte mindestens 1000 sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne und deklarative Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte, insbesondere bei komplexeren Filterbedingungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Open SQL, sflights

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und fügen Sie ein Präfix hinzu. Verwenden Sie die `FOR` Expression.
hint: Die `FOR` Expression ermöglicht die Transformation und Iteration über interne Tabellen in einer Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( flight_id = |{ iv_prefix }{ ls_flight-carrid }{ ls_flight-connid }|
                                        carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid    = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
