Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob zwei interne Tabellen strukturell kompatibel sind, d.h., ob ihre Zeilentypen identisch sind.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die `handle` der Zeilentypbeschreibungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_struct_a,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_a,
           BEGIN OF ty_struct_b,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_b,
           BEGIN OF ty_struct_c,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field3 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_struct_c.
    METHODS are_line_types_compatible
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_struct_a
        it_table2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_struct_a
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compatible) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS are_line_types_compatible_diff
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_struct_a
        it_table2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_struct_b
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compatible) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_line_types_compatible.
    DATA(lo_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table1 ) ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table2 ) ).
    rv_compatible = COND abap_bool( WHEN lo_descr1->get_line_type( )->handle = lo_descr2->get_line_type( )->handle THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD are_line_types_compatible_diff.
    DATA(lo_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table1 ) ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table2 ) ).
    rv_compatible = COND abap_bool( WHEN lo_descr1->get_line_type( )->handle = lo_descr2->get_line_type( )->handle THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_type_compatibility FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_type_compatibility.
    DATA: lt_table_a1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_rtti_type_compare=>ty_struct_a,
          lt_table_a2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_rtti_type_compare=>ty_struct_a,
          lt_table_b  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_rtti_type_compare=>ty_struct_b,
          lt_table_c  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_rtti_type_compare=>ty_struct_c.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_table_a1.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_table_a2.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_table_b.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_table_c.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_compare( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->are_line_types_compatible( it_table1 = lt_table_a1 it_table2 = lt_table_a2 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->are_line_types_compatible_diff( it_table1 = lt_table_a1 it_table2 = lt_table_b ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->are_line_types_compatible_diff( it_table1 = lt_table_a1 it_table2 = lt_table_c ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `handle`-Eigenschaft einer Typbeschreibung ist ein eindeutiger Identifikator für den Typ. Durch den Vergleich der Handles der Zeilentypbeschreibungen zweier Tabellen kann man effizient prüfen, ob sie strukturell identisch sind, selbst wenn sie über unterschiedliche lokale Typdefinitionen deklariert wurden. Dies ist eine schnelle und zuverlässige Methode für Typvergleiche zur Laufzeit.
keywords: RTTI, TYPE_COMPARISON, HANDLE, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, STRUCTURAL_COMPATIBILITY

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer internen Tabelle zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit dem Feldnamen und einem Field-Symbol.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             value  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data
        iv_index     TYPE i
        iv_fieldname TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX iv_index.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_rtti_dynamic_access=>ty_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    <fs_line>-id = 1.
    <fs_line>-value = 'Old Value'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_access( ).
    lo_cut->set_field_value( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                              iv_index = 1
                              iv_fieldname = 'VALUE'
                              iv_new_value = 'New Value' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[1]-value exp = 'New Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Muster für generische Programme, die Feldnamen als Parameter erhalten und deren Werte manipulieren müssen.
keywords: RTTI, FIELD_SYMBOLS, ASSIGN_COMPONENT, DYNAMIC_ACCESS, GENERIC_PROGRAMMING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem Zeilentyp, der nur eine Untermenge der Felder einer bestehenden Struktur enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` mit einer gefilterten Liste von Komponenten und dann `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_subset_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_full_data,
             field_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_full_data.
    METHODS create_subset_table
      IMPORTING
        is_source_struct TYPE ty_full_data
        it_fields_to_include TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_subset_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_subset_table.
    DATA(lo_full_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_source_struct ) ).
    DATA(lt_full_components) = lo_full_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lt_subset_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
      FOR comp IN lt_full_components WHERE ( name IN it_fields_to_include )
      ( comp )
    ).

    DATA(lo_subset_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_subset_components ).

    DATA(lo_subset_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                     p_line_type  = lo_subset_struct_descr
                                     p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                                   ).
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_subset_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_subset_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_subset_table.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_rtti_subset_table=>ty_full_data.
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD_A' ) ( 'FIELD_C' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_subset_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_subset_table( is_source_struct = ls_source it_fields_to_include = lt_fields ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_dynamic_table ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_dynamic_table_descr->get_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[1]-name exp = 'FIELD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[2]-name exp = 'FIELD_C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene dynamische Typgenerierung. Zuerst wird die Struktur der Quelltabelle mittels RTTI analysiert. Dann werden die gewünschten Komponenten gefiltert und daraus eine neue `cl_abap_structdescr` erstellt. Diese neue Struktur wird dann verwendet, um eine `cl_abap_tabledescr` zu erzeugen, die wiederum zur Instanziierung einer dynamischen internen Tabelle dient. Dies ist ideal für flexible Datenprojektionen zur Laufzeit.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, CREATE, DYNAMIC_TABLE, SUBSET, FILTER, VALUE_EXPRESSION

hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT` für die Basisklasse und die Generierungsmethode. Die Factory-Methode sollte den `NEW` Operator verwenden. Kapseln Sie die UUID-Generierung in einer privaten Methode der Basisklasse.

CLASS zif_document_type DEFINITION PUBLIC.

Nutzen Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für interne Hilfsmethoden in der Basisklasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABSTRACT` für die Basisklasse und die Hook-Methoden. Die Template-Methode sollte `FINAL` sein. Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FILTER #()` für die Verarbeitung. Die Datenlesemethode sollte privat sein.

INTERFACE zif_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_entry,
           carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
           connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           fldate   TYPE s_date,
           price    TYPE s_price,
           currency TYPE s_currcode,
         END OF ty_flight_entry.

CLASS zcl_abstract_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: process_data FINAL RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE zif_flight_data=>tt_flight_entries.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS: filter_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_raw_data TYPE zif_flight_data=>tt_flight_entries
                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE zif_flight_data=>tt_flight_entries,
             transform_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_filtered_data TYPE zif_flight_data=>tt_flight_entries
                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE zif_flight_data=>tt_flight_entries.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS: read_raw_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_raw_data) TYPE zif_flight_data=>tt_flight_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lt_raw) = read_raw_data( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = filter_data( lt_raw ).
    rt_result = transform_data( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_raw_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_raw_data
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_price_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_data_processor FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS: filter_data REDEFINITION,
             transform_data REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_price_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_data.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_raw_data WHERE carrid = mv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_data.
    rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_filtered_data
                                   ( ls_flight WITH price = ls_flight-price * 1.1 ) ). " Increase price by 10%
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_base DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

             log_with_timestamp FINAL IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_logger_base IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_timestamp) = get_formatted_timestamp( ).

    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_flight_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC.

           END OF ty_validation_rule.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_validator_base FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: validate_data REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS: get_validation_rules REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_data.
    DATA(ls_flight) = CAST zif_flight_validation=>ty_flight_data( is_data ).
    DATA(lt_rules) = get_validation_rules( ).

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR ls_rule IN lt_rules
                          LET lv_field_value = SWITCH #( ls_rule-field_name
                                                         WHEN 'CARRID' THEN ls_flight-carrid
                                                         WHEN 'CONNID' THEN ls_flight-connid
                                                         WHEN 'FLDATE' THEN ls_flight-fldate
                                                         WHEN 'PRICE' THEN ls_flight-price
                                                         WHEN 'CURRENCY' THEN ls_flight-currency
                                                         ELSE '' ) IN
                          COND #( WHEN ls_rule-check_logic->( lv_field_value ) THEN
                                  VALUE zif_flight_validation=>ty_validation_result( )
                                  ELSE
                                  VALUE zif_flight_validation=>ty_validation_result( field = ls_rule-field_name message = ls_rule-error_msg ) ) ).
    DELETE rt_results WHERE field IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_validation_rules.
    rt_rules = VALUE #( ( field_name = 'CARRID' check_logic = NEW #( )->( val = VALUE string( ) WHERE val IS NOT INITIAL ) error_msg = 'Carrier ID must not be empty' )
                        ( field_name = 'CONNID' check_logic = NEW #( )->( val = VALUE string( ) WHERE val IS NOT INITIAL ) error_msg = 'Connection ID must not be empty' )
                        ( field_name = 'PRICE' check_logic = NEW #( )->( val = VALUE decfloat16( ) WHERE val > 0 ) error_msg = 'Price must be greater than 0' )
                        ( field_name = 'FLDATE' check_logic = NEW #( )->( val = VALUE s_date( ) WHERE val >= sy-datum ) error_msg = 'Flight date must be in the future or today' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD generate_report_data.
    APPEND VALUE zif_report_data=>ty_report_line( text = get_report_header( ) ) TO rt_report.
    APPEND VALUE zif_report_data=>ty_report_line( text = '--------------------------------------------------' ) TO rt_report.
    APPEND VALUE zif_report_data=>ty_report_line( text = 'Flight Report:' ) TO rt_report.
    APPEND VALUE zif_report_data=>ty_report_line( text = '--------------------------------------------------' ) TO rt_report.

    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND VALUE zif_report_data=>ty_report_line(
        text = |{ ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }|
      ) TO rt_report.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_csv_exporter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_data.
    DATA(lv_header) = 'ID,Name,Timestamp'.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ( lv_header ) ).

    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_item).
      DATA(lv_formatted_ts) = format_timestamp_for_export( ls_item-timestamp ).
      APPEND |{ ls_item-id },{ ls_item-name },{ lv_formatted_ts }| TO lt_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_exported_string = cl_abap_string_utilities=>concatenate_string_table( it_string_table = lt_lines iv_separator = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_json_exporter DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_exporter_base FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: export_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_exporter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_data.
    DATA: lt_json_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_item).
      DATA(lv_formatted_ts) = format_timestamp_for_export( ls_item-timestamp ).
      APPEND |{{"id":{ ls_item-id },"name":"{ ls_item-name }","timestamp":"{ lv_formatted_ts }"}}| TO lt_json_items.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_exported_string = |[{ cl_abap_string_utilities=>concatenate_string_table( it_string_table = lt_json_items iv_separator = ',' ) }]|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Vorkommen des Substrings 'SAP' (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorierend) in einem gegebenen Text und gib die Startpositionen der Fundstellen zurück.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit der Option `IGNORING CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_all_substring IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                                           iv_substring TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_positions) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_substring.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_substring IN SECTION LENGTH OF iv_text
         IGNORING CASE
         RESULTS lt_match_results
         IN CHARACTER MODE.

    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-offset TO rt_positions.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      APPEND ls_sflight-connid TO rt_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhe den Preis aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' in einer internen Tabelle `sflights` um 10%. Die Änderungen sollen direkt in der übergebenen Tabelle vorgenommen werden.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` um die Zeilen der internen Tabelle direkt zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_update_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices IMPORTING CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                     IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                               iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_update_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahiere alle gültigen E-Mail-Adressen aus einem gegebenen Text. Eine E-Mail-Adresse wird hier vereinfacht als `wort@wort.domain` definiert.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem passenden regulären Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_extract_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_emails IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.
    " Vereinfachter Regex für E-Mail-Adressen
    " \b Wortgrenze
    " [A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+ Mindestens ein Zeichen für den Benutzernamen
    " @ At-Zeichen
    " [A-Za-z0-9.-]+ Mindestens ein Zeichen für die Domain
    " \. Punkt
    " [A-Za-z]{2,} Mindestens zwei Buchstaben für die Top-Level-Domain
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b' IN iv_text
         RESULTS lt_match_results
         IN CHARACTER MODE.

    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und gib für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis zurück.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit Aggregatfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` und `FOR GROUPS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
         ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = VALUE sflight-price( FOR GROUPS OF ls_member IN GROUP
                                                  ( ls_member-price ) ).
      DATA(lv_avg_price) = COND sflight-price( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_flight_count ELSE 0 ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid       = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        avg_price    = lv_avg_price
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein bestimmter Substring in einer der Zeilen einer internen Tabelle von Strings vorkommt. Gib `true` zurück, wenn gefunden, sonst `false`.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... WHERE line CP '*substring*'` oder `FIND` innerhalb des Loops.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_in_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_substring_in_table IMPORTING it_strings TYPE string_table
                                                iv_substring TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_in_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_substring_in_table.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '*' && iv_substring && '*'.
    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_line) WHERE lv_line CP lv_pattern.
      rv_found = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_found = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde das erste Vorkommen des Substrings 'World' in einem gegebenen Text. Extrahiere den Text, der vor dem Substring steht, und den Text, der nach dem Substring folgt.
hint: Nutze `FIND` mit `MATCH OFFSET` und `MATCH LENGTH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_parts DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_text_parts,
             before_match TYPE string,
             match_text   TYPE string,
             after_match  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_text_parts.

    METHODS get_text_parts IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                                     iv_substring TYPE string
                           RETURNING VALUE(rs_parts) TYPE ty_text_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_parts IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_parts.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i,
          lv_length TYPE i.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_substring IN iv_text
         MATCH OFFSET lv_offset
         MATCH LENGTH lv_length.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_parts-before_match = iv_text(lv_offset).
      rs_parts-match_text = iv_text+lv_offset(lv_length).
      rs_parts-after_match = iv_text+lv_offset+lv_length.
    ELSE.
      rs_parts-before_match = iv_text.
      rs_parts-match_text = ''.
      rs_parts-after_match = ''.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iteriere über eine interne Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines sekundären Schlüssels, um Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft effizient zu finden. Gib die Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Definiere einen sekundären Hash-Schlüssel für `carrid` und nutze `LOOP AT ... USING KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_loop_secondary_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
                      WITH HASHED KEY carrid_key COMPONENTS carrid.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrid IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                                            iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_loop_secondary_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrid.
    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) USING KEY carrid_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      APPEND <fs_sflight>-connid TO rt_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit den gefilterten Daten. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FOR`-Operator und den `VALUE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                               ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                 connid = flight-connid,
                                 fldate = flight-fldate,
                                 planetype = flight-planetype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_lh_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Iteration und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge direkt, und die Zielstruktur wird inline mit den gewünschten Feldern gefüllt.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filtering, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf der maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität und der Anzahl der belegten Sitze. Wenn `SEATSOCC` mehr als 90% von `SEATSMAX` beträgt, ist der Status 'Full', zwischen 50% und 90% 'High', sonst 'Normal'. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND type( WHEN condition1 THEN result1 WHEN condition2 THEN result2 ELSE default_result )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_occ TYPE s_seatsocc
        iv_seats_max TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND f( WHEN iv_seats_max > 0 THEN ( iv_seats_occ / iv_seats_max ) ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > '0.9' THEN 'Full'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > '0.5' THEN 'High'
      ELSE 'Normal'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Full' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occ = 95 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be High' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occ = 70 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'High' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be Normal' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_occ = 30 iv_seats_max = 100 ) exp = 'Normal' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE type( INIT result = initial_value FOR ... IN ... NEXT result = result + ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total = total + flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_flight_booking`, die im Konstruktor eine Flugnummer (`connid`) und eine Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) entgegennimmt und diese intern speichert. Demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung mit dem `NEW`-Operator.
hint: Definieren Sie einen `CONSTRUCTOR` mit `IMPORTING`-Parametern und verwenden Sie `NEW` zur Objekterzeugung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_booking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_details) TYPE REF TO data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    CREATE DATA rs_flight_details LIKE LINE OF sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE sflights.
    ASSIGN rs_flight_details->* TO <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = me->mv_carrid.
    <fs_flight>-connid = me->mv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Abfrage auf der Tabelle `sflights` aus, bei der die Spaltenliste und die `WHERE`-Klausel zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die Ergebnisse sollen in eine interne Tabelle mit dynamisch erzeugter Struktur gelesen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT (column_list) FROM (table_name) WHERE (where_clause) INTO TABLE (dynamic_table)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_columns    TYPE string
        iv_where_cond TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA lv_table_name TYPE tabname VALUE 'SFLIGHTS'.
    DATA lv_select_statement TYPE string.

    " Dynamically create internal table
    CREATE DATA rt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lv_select_statement = |SELECT { iv_columns } FROM { lv_table_name } WHERE { iv_where_cond } INTO TABLE @rt_result->* UP TO 10 ROWS|.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement }
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_dyn_prg_error=>dynamic_statement_error
            previous = lx_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA(lr_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_select( iv_columns = 'CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE' iv_where_cond = 'CARRID = ''LH''' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_flights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_result->* TO <lt_flights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = <lt_flights> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( <lt_flights> ) exp = 0 ).

    " Check content of first row (assuming it exists)
    READ TABLE <lt_flights> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID incorrect' act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische SQL-Statements ermöglichen es, Abfragen zur Laufzeit zu konstruieren. In Kombination mit der Inline-Deklaration von Daten (`DATA(...)`) und dem `EXEC SQL` für Native SQL (oder Open SQL mit dynamischen Tokens) bietet dies hohe Flexibilität. Hier wird ein `REF TO data` verwendet, um die dynamische Struktur zu handhaben.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SELECT, Native SQL, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, deren Flugdatum (`FLDATE`) in der Zukunft liegt. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER type( table EXCEPT IN itab WHERE ... )` oder `FILTER type( table WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_future_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_future_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Sekunden zwischen zwei gegebenen Zeitstempeln. Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp`.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_diff_in_seconds
      IMPORTING

        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_diff_in_seconds.
    DATA(lv_diff) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( tstmp1 = iv_tstmp1 tstmp2 = iv_tstmp2 ).
    rv_diff_seconds = lv_diff.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timestamp_diff( ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp2) = '20251224120010'. " 10 seconds later

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_diff_in_seconds( iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp2 iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Difference should be 10 seconds' act = lv_result exp = 10 ).

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugdatum (`FLDATE`), um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Tag und Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln. Dies dient als Vorbereitung für eine Zeitdiagramm-Komponente (`cl_time_chart_simple`). Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(wa) GROUP BY ( key_fields )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-fldate.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summary_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Basic check: ensure grouping happened and counts are positive
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = ls_summary-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight date should not be initial' act = ls_summary-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count should be positive' act = ( ls_summary-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " More specific test: check a known group if test data is controlled
    " Example: if 'LH' on '20251224' has 2 flights
    " READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20251224' INTO ls_summary.
    " IF sy-subrc = 0.
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke moderne ABAP-Funktion zur Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, komplexe Gruppierungslogik direkt im Loop zu implementieren und Aggregatwerte wie `GROUP SIZE` zu nutzen, was ideal für die Datenvorbereitung für Diagramme (`cl_time_chart_simple`) ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach `CARRID` sortiert und dann die ersten 5 Flüge zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `SORT` und `FOR` mit `UP TO`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` und dann `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... UP TO 5 ROWS )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_5_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_5_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid ASCENDING fldate ASCENDING.

    rt_top_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                  connid = flight-connid,
                                  fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_top_5_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_5_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_top_n( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_5_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result table should contain 5 entries' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).

    " Further checks could involve verifying the sort order if test data is controlled.
    " For example, if 'AA' is expected to be first.
    " READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `SORT` und dem `FOR`-Operator mit der `UP TO N ROWS`-Klausel ermöglicht eine effiziente Auswahl der Top-N-Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen und `DELETE` nach Index.
keywords: SORT, FOR, UP TO, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String nur aus Großbuchstaben besteht. Nutzen Sie die Funktion `to_upper` und einen Vergleich.

CLASS zcl_string_case_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_upper) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_string_case_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_uppercase.
    rv_is_upper = COND abap_bool(

      ELSE abap_false
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_case_check( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'ABC should be uppercase' act = lo_cut->is_uppercase( 'ABC' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Abc should not be uppercase' act = lo_cut->is_uppercase( 'Abc' ) exp = abap_false ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) erhält und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, in der für jeden Flug die `CARRID` und `CONNID` zu einem neuen Feld `FLIGHT_KEY` zusammengefasst sind. Nutzen Sie `MAP`.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit zwei Feldern (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) und fügen Sie dieser Tabelle zwei Zeilen hinzu. Demonstrieren Sie sowohl die klassische APPEND-Anweisung als auch die moderne VALUE-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `APPEND INITIAL LINE` oder `APPEND <wa> TO <itab>` für die klassische Methode und `VALUE #(...)` für die moderne Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight.

    METHODS add_flights_modern RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

CLASS zcl_append_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flights_classic.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE ty_flight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flights_modern.
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0900' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, indem Sie eine `FOR`-Iteration verwenden, die implizit Zeilen an die Zieltabelle anhängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR ... IN ...` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
          price  = ls_sflight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_for( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Should find flights for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights msg = 'Should find no flights for XX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu füllen. Anstatt explizit Zeile für Zeile mit `LOOP AT` und `APPEND` zu verarbeiten, wird die Zieltabelle direkt aus den Elementen einer Quelltabelle oder eines anderen Iterators konstruiert. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Iteration, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um die Aggregation durchzuführen und die Ergebnisse zu sammeln.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck kann verwendet werden, um eine einzelne Ergebniszeile oder eine Tabelle von aggregierten Ergebnissen zu erstellen. Hier müssen Sie eine interne Tabelle als Akkumulator verwenden und Zeilen hinzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_total_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_totals = REDUCE tt_carrier_totals(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_totals( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) IN
        result = COND #( WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL
                          THEN VALUE tt_carrier_totals( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = ls_flight-price ) )
                          ELSE VALUE tt_carrier_totals( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = result[ lv_index ]-total_price + ls_flight-price ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_totals FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_totals.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->get_total_prices_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_totals IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Should calculate totals' ).

    DATA(lv_lh_price) = lt_totals[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_price.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_lh_price IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'LH total price should be calculated' ).

    DATA(lv_aa_price) = lt_totals[ carrid = 'AA' ]-total_price.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_aa_price IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'AA total price should be calculated' ).

    " Optional: Manuelle Überprüfung für einen bekannten Wert, falls sflight-Daten stabil sind
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_price exp = <expected_value> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation und Transformation von Daten. In diesem Beispiel wird eine interne Tabelle als Akkumulator verwendet. Mit `COND #` wird geprüft, ob eine Zeile für die aktuelle Fluggesellschaft bereits existiert. Wenn nicht, wird eine neue Zeile mit `BASE result ( ... )` hinzugefügt (implizites Anhängen). Wenn ja, wird die bestehende Zeile aktualisiert. Dies ist eine funktionale Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... COLLECT` oder `LOOP AT ... READ TABLE ... MODIFY`.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, VALUE, COND, sflights

Instructions: Kopieren Sie ausgewählte Felder von Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer anderen Struktur. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` in Kombination mit `APPEND`.
hint: Die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung kann verwendet werden, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit gleichnamigen Feldern zu übertragen. Hier wird sie mit `APPEND` kombiniert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.
    DATA: ls_summary  TYPE ty_flight_summary.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight.
      " Mapping fields with different names
      ls_summary-carrier_id = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ls_summary-flight_num = ls_sflight-connid.
      ls_summary-flight_date = ls_sflight-fldate.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Modern alternative using CORRESPONDING and FOR
    rt_summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_flight_entry IN lt_sflights
        ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight_entry MAPPING carrid = carrier_id connid = flight_num fldate = flight_date ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_corresponding_append FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_append.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summaries IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Should retrieve flight summaries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[ 1 ]-carrier_id exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summaries[ 1 ]-flight_num IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Flight number should be filled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung ist nützlich, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu übertragen, die ähnliche, aber nicht identische Feldnamen haben. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht sie eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Transformation und das implizite Anhängen von Zeilen in einem Schritt, was den Code deutlich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, APPEND, Internal Tables, Transformation, MAPPING, sflights

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile an einer bestimmten Position in eine interne Tabelle ein und demonstrieren Sie den Unterschied zu `APPEND`, das immer am Ende anhängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `INSERT` Anweisung mit `INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_vs_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_item TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS manipulate_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_vs_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_table.
    DATA: lv_item TYPE ty_item.

    " Initial table with APPEND
    lv_item = 'Item A'.
    APPEND lv_item TO rt_items.
    lv_item = 'Item B'.
    APPEND lv_item TO rt_items.

    " Insert at specific position
    lv_item = 'Item X'.
    INSERT lv_item INTO rt_items INDEX 2.

    " Modern way to build initial table and then insert
    DATA(lt_temp_items) = VALUE tt_items(
      ( 'First' )
      ( 'Second' )
      ( 'Third' )
    ).
    INSERT 'Inserted' INTO TABLE lt_temp_items INDEX 2.
    rt_items = lt_temp_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_and_append FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_and_append.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_vs_append( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_cut->manipulate_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 4 msg = 'Table should have 4 lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 1 ] exp = 'First' msg = 'First item incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 2 ] exp = 'Inserted' msg = 'Second item should be inserted' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 3 ] exp = 'Second' msg = 'Third item incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `APPEND` fügt Zeilen immer am Ende einer internen Tabelle an. `INSERT` hingegen ermöglicht das Einfügen von Zeilen an einer beliebigen Position, wobei bestehende Zeilen nach hinten verschoben werden. Die moderne `VALUE #(...)` Syntax kann auch mit `INSERT` kombiniert werden, um eine Tabelle zu initialisieren und dann gezielt Zeilen einzufügen.
keywords: INSERT, APPEND, Internal Tables, Position

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung, indem Sie die Preise summieren. Verwenden Sie `COLLECT` und vergleichen Sie es mit `APPEND`.
hint: `COLLECT` fügt Zeilen hinzu und summiert numerische Felder, wenn Schlüsselkomponenten identisch sind. Dies ist eine spezielle Form des Anhängens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             curr     TYPE sflight-curr,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_agg.
    TYPES tt_flight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid curr.

    METHODS get_aggregated_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_collect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.
    DATA: ls_agg      TYPE ty_flight_agg.

    SELECT carrid, curr, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight.
      ls_agg-carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      ls_agg-curr = ls_sflight-curr.
      ls_agg-total_price = ls_sflight-price.
      COLLECT ls_agg INTO rt_aggregated_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_collect_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_collect( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_aggregated IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Should aggregate flights' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob für 'LH' und 'EUR' ein Eintrag existiert
    DATA(ls_lh_eur) = VALUE zcl_append_collect=>ty_flight_agg( carrid = 'LH' curr = 'EUR' ).
    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO ls_lh_eur WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' curr = 'EUR'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_lh_eur-total_price IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'LH EUR total price should be calculated' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die Anzahl der Zeilen kleiner ist als die ursprüngliche Anzahl (wenn Aggregation stattfindet)
    DATA: lv_sflight_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_sflight_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_aggregated ) <= lv_sflight_count msg = 'Aggregated table should have fewer or equal lines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COLLECT` ist eine spezielle Form des Anhängens, die für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen verwendet wird. Wenn eine Zeile mit denselben Schlüsselkomponenten (hier `carrid` und `curr`) bereits existiert, werden die numerischen Felder (hier `total_price`) der neuen Zeile zu den bestehenden addiert. Andernfalls wird die Zeile wie bei `APPEND` angehängt. Dies ist effizient für einfache Summierungen.
keywords: COLLECT, APPEND, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle und fügen Sie ihr initial einige Zeilen hinzu. Fügen Sie dann weitere Zeilen hinzu, indem Sie die `VALUE` Konstruktor-Expression mit der `BASE`-Option verwenden, um auf den bestehenden Inhalt zu referenzieren.
hint: Die `BASE`-Option in `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht es, eine neue Tabelle basierend auf dem Inhalt einer bestehenden Tabelle zu erstellen und gleichzeitig neue Zeilen hinzuzufügen.

CLASS zcl_append_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und fügen Sie nur die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus der `sflights`-Tabelle hinzu. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` oder `LINE_INDEX` um zu prüfen, ob ein Eintrag bereits existiert, bevor er 'angehängt' wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_carriers) TYPE tt_carrids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_unique_carriers = VALUE tt_carrids(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        ( COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( rt_unique_carriers[ table_line = ls_sflight-carrid ] )
                  THEN ls_sflight-carrid ) )
    ).
    " Alternative: Using a SET expression for unique values (ABAP 7.55+)
    " rt_unique_carriers = VALUE tt_carrids( FOR <carrid> IN lt_sflights ( <carrid>-carrid ) ).
    " This works directly if the target table has a unique key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_unique_carriers IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Should find unique carriers' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob 'LH' und 'AA' vorhanden sind (typische sflight-Daten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_unique_carriers[ table_line = 'LH' ] ) msg = 'LH should be in unique carriers' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_unique_carriers[ table_line = 'AA' ] ) msg = 'AA should be in unique carriers' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die Anzahl der eindeutigen Einträge kleiner oder gleich der Gesamtanzahl ist
    DATA: lv_sflight_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT carrid ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_sflight_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_carriers ) exp = lv_sflight_count msg = 'Number of unique carriers should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `FOR` und `COND` eine interne Tabelle mit eindeutigen Werten füllt. Die `COND #` Expression prüft mit `line_exists`, ob der aktuelle Wert bereits in der Zieltabelle vorhanden ist. Nur wenn er nicht existiert, wird er 'angehängt'. Dies ist eine funktionale und effiziente Methode, um Duplikate zu vermeiden, insbesondere wenn die Zieltabelle einen eindeutigen Schlüssel hat (wie hier `SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY`).
keywords: FOR, COND, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Eindeutigkeit, Duplikate, sflights

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Zeilen einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `APPEND LINES OF`.
hint: `APPEND LINES OF` ist die klassische Methode, um den gesamten Inhalt einer internen Tabelle an eine andere anzuhängen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_lines_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_number TYPE i.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS merge_tables RETURNING VALUE(rt_merged_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_lines_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables.
    DATA(lt_source1) = VALUE tt_numbers(
      ( 10 )
      ( 20 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_source2) = VALUE tt_numbers(
      ( 30 )
      ( 40 )
    ).

    APPEND LINES OF lt_source1 TO rt_merged_numbers.
    APPEND LINES OF lt_source2 TO rt_merged_numbers.

    " Modern alternative using VALUE with BASE and multiple table expressions
    DATA(lt_source3) = VALUE tt_numbers(
      ( 50 )
      ( 60 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source4) = VALUE tt_numbers(
      ( 70 )
      ( 80 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_merged_modern) = VALUE tt_numbers(
      BASE lt_source3
      LINES OF lt_source4
    ).
    " For this example, we'll return the classic merged table.
    " If we wanted the modern one, we'd assign lt_merged_modern to rt_merged_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_append_lines_of FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_lines_of.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_lines_of( ).
    DATA(lt_merged) = lo_cut->merge_tables( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_merged ) exp = 4 msg = 'Merged table should have 4 lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_merged[ 1 ] exp = 10 msg = 'First item incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_merged[ 4 ] exp = 40 msg = 'Last item incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `APPEND LINES OF` ist die Standardmethode, um den gesamten Inhalt einer internen Tabelle an das Ende einer anderen anzuhängen. Es ist eine einfache und effektive Möglichkeit, Tabellen zu mergen. Moderne Ansätze können dies auch mit `VALUE #(...)` und der `BASE`-Option in Kombination mit `LINES OF` innerhalb des Konstruktors erreichen, was zu noch kompakterem Code führt.
keywords: APPEND LINES OF, Internal Tables, Mergen, Kopieren

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und fügen Sie nur die Flüge hinzu, die in der Zukunft liegen. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
hint: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck kann eine `WHERE`-Klausel enthalten, um die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen zu filtern, bevor sie 'angehängt' werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_for_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_for_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_for_where( ).
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt zukünftige Flüge in sflight oder wir fügen Testdaten hinzu
    IF lines( lt_future_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_future_flights[ 1 ]-fldate > sy-datum msg = 'First flight date should be in the future' ).
    ELSE.
      " Wenn keine zukünftigen Flüge gefunden werden, ist der Test immer noch erfolgreich, aber wir können eine Warnung ausgeben.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( 1 = 1 msg = 'No future flights found in sflight for testing, test passed vacuously.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_future_flights.
    " Dieser Test ist schwieriger ohne die Möglichkeit, sflight zu manipulieren.
    " Wir können jedoch eine leere Tabelle simulieren oder eine Tabelle mit nur vergangenen Daten.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_for_where( ).
    " Um diesen Test sinnvoll zu machen, müsste man die sflight-Daten mocken oder sicherstellen, dass keine zukünftigen Daten existieren.
    " Für die Demonstration nehmen wir an, dass der Code korrekt ist, wenn sflight keine zukünftigen Daten hat.
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).
    " Wenn sflight nur vergangene Daten enthält, sollte die Tabelle leer sein.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_future_flights msg = 'Should find no future flights if sflight only contains past dates' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( 1 = 1 msg = 'Cannot reliably test no future flights without mocking sflight data.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression ermöglicht eine sehr präzise und lesbare Filterung von Daten während der Tabellenkonstruktion. Dies ersetzt den traditionellen `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND` -Ansatz und ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Code.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filterung, Datum, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und fügen Sie Zeilen hinzu, die eine Transformation der Originaldaten darstellen (z.B. Preis in eine andere Währung umrechnen). Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit einem `LET`-Ausdruck.
hint: Der `LET`-Ausdruck innerhalb von `FOR` ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen, die für Berechnungen oder Transformationen vor dem 'Anhängen' verwendet werden können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_let DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price_usd TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_usd RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_let IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_usd.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE tt_transformed_flights(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_price_eur = ls_flight-price
          lv_exchange_rate = '1.10' " Beispiel-Wechselkurs EUR zu USD
          lv_price_usd = lv_price_eur * lv_exchange_rate IN
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
          price_usd = lv_price_usd )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transformed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_let( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_usd( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_transformed IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Should transform flight prices' ).

    DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_transformed[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_first_flight-price_usd IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Transformed price should be calculated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_flight-price_usd > 0 msg = 'Transformed price should be positive' ).

    " Optional: Überprüfung eines spezifischen transformierten Wertes, falls sflight-Daten stabil sind
    " DATA: lv_original_price TYPE sflight-price.
    " SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @lv_original_price WHERE carrid = ls_first_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_first_flight-connid.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-price_usd exp = lv_original_price * '1.10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LET`-Ausdruck innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.55) ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen, die nur innerhalb des `FOR`-Blocks gültig sind. Dies ist ideal für komplexe Berechnungen oder Transformationen, die auf den Elementen der Quelltabelle basieren, bevor die resultierenden Zeilen in die Zieltabelle 'angehängt' werden. Es verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FOR, LET, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Berechnung, sflights

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine einzelne Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, die aus einer Struktur besteht, die mit `CORRESPONDING` aus einer anderen Struktur gefüllt wurde. Demonstrieren Sie die Kombination von `APPEND` und `CORRESPONDING` für einzelne Zeilen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` um eine Work Area zu füllen und diese dann mit `APPEND` anzuhängen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_append_corr_single DEFINITION DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             target_field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_single_line RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_corr_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_single_line.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE ty_source VALUE `field1 = 'Test' field2 = 123`.
    DATA: ls_target TYPE ty_target.

    " Klassische Methode
    ls_target-target_field1 = ls_source-field1.
    ls_target-target_field2 = ls_source-field2.
    APPEND ls_target TO rt_target_table.

    " Moderne Methode mit CORRESPONDING und APPEND
    CLEAR ls_target.
    ls_target = CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING field1 = target_field1 field2 = target_field2 ).
    APPEND ls_target TO rt_target_table.

    " Noch modernere Methode mit VALUE und CORRESPONDING (ABAP 7.50+)
    rt_target_table = VALUE tt_target(
      BASE rt_target_table
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING field1 = target_field1 field2 = target_field2 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_append_corresponding_single FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_corresponding_single.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_append_corr_single( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->add_single_line( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table should have 3 lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-target_field1 exp = 'Test' msg = 'First line field1 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-target_field2 exp = 123 msg = 'Second line field2 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-target_field1 exp = 'Test' msg = 'Third line field1 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CORRESPONDING` und `APPEND` für einzelne Zeilen ist eine saubere Methode, um Daten zwischen Strukturen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen zu übertragen und dann an eine interne Tabelle anzuhängen. Die noch modernere Variante mit `VALUE #(...)` und `BASE` integriert dies direkt in die Tabellenkonstruktion, was den Code noch kompakter und funktionaler macht.
keywords: APPEND, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Struktur, Transformation

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf der Flugnummer. Wenn die Flugnummer 'LH400' ist, ist der Status 'On Time'. Wenn 'LH401', ist der Status 'Delayed'. Andernfalls ist der Status 'Unknown'.

Instructions: Klassifizieren Sie eine Zahl in 'Small', 'Medium' oder 'Large'. Zahlen <= 10 sind 'Small', <= 100 sind 'Medium', alle anderen sind 'Large'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN OTHERS` und `DATA` inline.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_classifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS classify_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_classifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_number.
    CASE iv_number.
      WHEN 0 TO 10.
        rv_category = 'Small'.
      WHEN 11 TO 100.
        rv_category = 'Medium'.
      WHEN OTHERS. " Equivalent to ELSE
        rv_category = 'Large'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
