Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine SORTED TABLE für Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) mit CARRIER ID und CONNECTION ID als eindeutigem Schlüssel. Fügen Sie Datensätze hinzu und demonstrieren Sie den effizienten Zugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY` für die Deklaration und `INSERT ... INTO TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
      WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_and_read_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_key.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sorted_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_and_read_flight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate )
      INTO TABLE mt_sorted_flights.

    READ TABLE mt_sorted_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid
      INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_and_read FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_and_read.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->add_and_read_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Fluggesellschaft falsch gelesen.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400'
      msg = 'Flugnummer falsch gelesen.' ).

    " Test unique key violation
    TRY.
        lo_cut->add_and_read_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250102' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Eindeutiger Schlüssel sollte verletzt werden.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Eindeutiger Schlüssel wurde korrekt verletzt.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Sorted Tables bieten eine performante Möglichkeit, Daten zu speichern und darauf zuzugreifen, da sie intern sortiert sind und der Zugriff über den Schlüssel optimiert ist. `WITH UNIQUE KEY` stellt die Eindeutigkeit der Schlüsselkombination sicher.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, Internal Tables, Performance, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Datensatz aus einer SORTED TABLE mit einem Tabellenausdruck. Die Tabelle soll Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) mit CARRIER ID und CONNECTION ID als Schlüssel enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Tabellenausdruck `itab[ key_field = value ]` für den direkten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
      WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sorted_flights.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
                                 ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
                                 ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    rs_flight = mt_sorted_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie einen Datensatz in einer SORTED TABLE. Die Tabelle soll Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) mit CARRIER ID und CONNECTION ID als Schlüssel enthalten. Nutzen Sie den `MODIFY TABLE` Befehl.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM WORK AREA` für die Aktualisierung eines Eintrags in einer Sorted Table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
      WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS modify_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sorted_flights.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
                                 ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD modify_flight_date.
    DATA(ls_flight_wa) = is_flight_data.
    MODIFY TABLE mt_sorted_flights FROM ls_flight_wa.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight.
    rs_flight = mt_sorted_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle doppelten Einträge aus einer SORTED TABLE, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und das Flugdatum enthält. Behalten Sie dabei den ersten gefundenen Eintrag. Nutzen Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Tabelle nach den relevanten Feldern sortiert ist, bevor Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` verwenden. Bei einer Sorted Table ist dies bereits gegeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_dedup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_date,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid, " Additional field to show it's ignored by DAD
           END OF ty_flight_date.
    TYPES tt_sorted_flight_dates TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_date
      WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_with_dups TYPE tt_sorted_flight_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sorted_flight_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_dedup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights_with_dups.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_dedup( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_dedup=>tt_sorted_flight_dates(
      ( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101' connid = '0401' ) " Duplicate by carrid, fldate
      ( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250102' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250103' connid = '0402' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250102' connid = '0018' ) " Duplicate by carrid, fldate
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten drei eindeutige Einträge übrig bleiben.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-connid exp = '0400' " Original connid retained
      msg = 'Erster Eintrag für LH/20250101 falsch.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-fldate exp = '20250102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-connid exp = '0017' " Original connid retained
      msg = 'Erster Eintrag für AA/20250102 falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Duplikate aus internen Tabellen zu entfernen. Bei Sorted Tables ist sie besonders nützlich, da die Sortierung bereits gegeben ist und keine explizite `SORT` Anweisung vorab benötigt wird, was die Performance weiter verbessert.
keywords: DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Sorted Tables, Deduplication, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Schleife über die Tabelle SFLIGHTS und weisen Sie jede Zeile einem Feldsymbol zu. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL WHERE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs> WHERE condition` für effiziente Iteration und direkten Zugriff auf die Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_fs_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_fs_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT it_all_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_loop_fs_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_fs_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_fs_where( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_loop_fs_where=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Flüge für LH gefunden werden.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400'
      msg = 'Erster Flug für LH falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel ist eine sehr performante Methode, um interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und gleichzeitig zu filtern. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen vermeidet das Kopieren von Daten und verbessert die Effizienz.
keywords: LOOP AT, FIELD-SYMBOL, WHERE, Internal Tables, Performance, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, die eine ähnliche, aber nicht identische Struktur hat. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für die Zuweisung von gleichnamigen Feldern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE string,
             field_y TYPE c LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_tables.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING field3 = field_x ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_tables.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_operator=>tt_source(
      ( field1 = 'Value1' field2 = 10 field3 = 'String A' )
      ( field1 = 'Value2' field2 = 20 field3 = 'String B' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_tables( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich sein.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_target_line).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_line-field1 exp = 'Value1'
      msg = 'Feld1 wurde nicht korrekt gemappt.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_line-field2 exp = 10
      msg = 'Feld2 wurde nicht korrekt gemappt.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_line-field_x exp = 'String A'
      msg = 'Feld3 wurde nicht korrekt auf field_x gemappt.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target_line-field_y
      msg = 'field_y sollte initial sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ist eine moderne und flexible Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`. Er erlaubt nicht nur das Mapping von gleichnamigen Feldern, sondern auch das explizite Umbenennen von Feldern (`MAPPING`) und das Ignorieren von Feldern (`EXCEPT`), was den Code sehr prägnant und anpassbar macht.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MOVE-CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Mapping, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Gruppierung von Flügen aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum durch und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `GROUP SIZE` Zusatz, um die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_group
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_info) TYPE tt_flight_group_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_group.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      fldate = ls_group_key-fldate
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_group_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' )

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101' INTO DATA(ls_group_lh1).

Sie ersetzt komplexe manuelle Gruppierungslogiken und bietet direkten Zugriff auf Gruppeninformationen wie `GROUP SIZE`, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Datensätze in eine SORTED TABLE ein und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sortierreihenfolge beibehalten wird. Die Tabelle soll Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) mit CARRIER ID und CONNECTION ID als Schlüssel enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` für Sorted Tables. Das System sorgt automatisch für die korrekte Positionierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
      WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_flights

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_sorted_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) und ermitteln Sie den frühesten Flug für jede Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `MIN` Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_min_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_earliest_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             earliest_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_earliest_flight.
    TYPES tt_earliest_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_earliest_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_earliest_flight_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_earliest_flights) TYPE tt_earliest_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_min_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_earliest_flight_per_carrier.
    rt_earliest_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                 GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   earliest_fldate = REDUCE #( INIT min_date = sy-datum
                                                               FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                               NEXT min_date = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-fldate < min_date THEN <fs_flight>-fldate ELSE min_date ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_earliest_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_min_group( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_min_group=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250105' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250110' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250108' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_earliest_flight_per_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Fluggesellschaften gruppiert werden.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_earliest).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_earliest-earliest_fldate exp = '20250101'
      msg = 'Frühestes Flugdatum für LH falsch.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_earliest).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_earliest-earliest_fldate exp = '20250108'
      msg = 'Frühestes Flugdatum für AA falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` mit einer bedingten Zuweisung (`COND`) innerhalb der Schleife ermöglicht es, komplexe Aggregationen wie das Finden des Minimums pro Gruppe in einer sehr funktionalen und lesbaren Weise zu implementieren. Dies ist ein modernes Muster für Datenaggregation in ABAP.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, MIN, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) und transformieren Sie diese in eine Map (Hash-Tabelle), wobei der Schlüssel die Fluggesellschaft und der Wert eine Liste der Flugnummern für diese Gesellschaft ist. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_tab_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,

    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

      WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line

      IMPORTING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_connids_map.
    rt_carrier_connids_map = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                        table_line = VALUE #( FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer SORTED TABLE existiert, ohne die gesamte Zeile zu lesen. Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` in Kombination mit `WITH KEY` oder `BINARY SEARCH` für effiziente Existenzprüfungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_no_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
      WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_sorted_flights TYPE tt_sorted_flights.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_no_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
                                 ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD flight_exists.
    READ TABLE mt_sorted_flights TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_exists_false FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists_true.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_no_fields( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_exists
      msg = 'Flug LH 0400 sollte existieren.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_exists_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_no_fields( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( cond = lv_exists
      msg = 'Flug XX 9999 sollte nicht existieren.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` ist die effizienteste Methode, um die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, da keine Daten in einen Arbeitsbereich kopiert werden müssen. Bei Sorted Tables ist dies in Kombination mit `WITH KEY` besonders schnell, da der binäre Suchalgorithmus genutzt wird.
keywords: READ TABLE, TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS, Sorted Tables, Existenzprüfung, Performance, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur mit teilweise übereinstimmenden Feldern, wobei `CONV` für die Typanpassung innerhalb von `CORRESPONDING` verwendet wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit der `MAPPING`-Option und `CONV` für individuelle Feldkonvertierungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             value  TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             key    TYPE i,
             data   TYPE string,
             sum    TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS convert_source_to_target
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_source_to_target.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING key = CONV i( is_source-id DEFAULT 0 )
                                                    data = is_source-value
                                                    sum = CONV p( is_source-amount DEFAULT 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_with_defaults FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_structure( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_conv_structure=>ty_source_data(
      id = '123'

      amount = '123.45'
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->convert_source_to_target( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-key exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-data exp = 'Testdaten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-sum exp = '123.45' ).

  METHOD test_conversion_with_defaults.

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_conv_structure=>ty_source_data(
      id = 'ABC'
      value = 'Fehlerhafte Daten'
      amount = 'XYZ'
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->convert_source_to_target( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-key exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-data exp = 'Fehlerhafte Daten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-sum exp = '0.00' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING` in Kombination mit `CONV` und `DEFAULT` innerhalb der `MAPPING`-Option. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Strukturkonvertierung, bei der individuelle Feldkonvertierungen und Fehlerbehandlung direkt im Ausdruck definiert werden können, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und modernisiert.
keywords: CONV, CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Conversion, MAPPING, DEFAULT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von Zahlen, die als Strings in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert sind, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `CONV`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `CONV`-Ausdruck im `NEXT`-Teil.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_string_table TYPE TABLE OF string.

    METHODS calculate_sum_of_string_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE ty_string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_string_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR lv_number_string IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + CONV decfloat16( lv_number_string DEFAULT 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_sum_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_valid_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_conv_reduce_sum=>ty_string_table(
      ( '10.5' ) ( '20' ) ( '5.5' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_string_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '36.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_mixed_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_conv_reduce_sum=>ty_string_table(
      ( '100' ) ( 'ABC' ) ( '50' ) ( 'XYZ' ) ( '25' )
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_conv_reduce_sum=>ty_string_table(
    ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_string_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '0.0' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `REDUCE` und `CONV` für eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation. `REDUCE` iteriert über die interne Tabelle, während `CONV` jeden String-Eintrag in eine Zahl konvertiert. Die `DEFAULT`-Option in `CONV` sorgt für Robustheit bei ungültigen String-Eingaben, was zu sehr expressivem und fehlerresistentem Code führt.
keywords: CONV, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math, String

CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_table_viewer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS display_dynamic_table IMPORTING it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_ecl_dynamic_table_viewer IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD display_dynamic_table. DATA(lo_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox( ). lo_viewer->create_viewer( ). DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data )->get_table_line_type( ) ). DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ). DATA(lv_header_rows) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR IN lt_components NEXT s = s && `` && -name && `` ). DATA(lv_table_rows) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR IN it_data NEXT s = s && | { REDUCE string( INIT cell_s = `` FOR IN lt_components NEXT cell_s = cell_s && | { CONV string( -(-name) ) } | ) } | ). DATA(lv_html) = | Dynamische Tabellenanzeige

Dynamische Tabellendaten

{ lv_header_rows } { lv_table_rows }
|. lo_viewer->display_html( lv_html ). lo_viewer->set_title( 'Dynamische Tabelle im ECL Viewer' ). lo_viewer->show_viewer( ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die dynamisch eine andere Klasse instanziiert und eine Methode dieser Instanz aufruft. Verwenden Sie dabei den `REF TO`-Operator und den `NEW`-Operator für die Inline-Instanziierung.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.

    " Dynamische Instanziierung einer lokalen Klasse
    TRY.
        lo_object = NEW zcl_helper_class( ).
        CALL METHOD lo_object->('SAY_HELLO') EXPORTING iv_name = 'Welt'.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call).
        out->write( |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf: { lx_dyn_call->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS say_hello IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_class IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie Polymorphismus mithilfe eines Interfaces und `REF TO`. Erstellen Sie zwei Klassen, die das Interface implementieren, und verarbeiten Sie Instanzen beider Klassen über eine Referenz auf das Interface in einer Schleife.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und lassen Sie zwei Klassen dieses implementieren. Verwenden Sie dann eine Tabelle von Interface-Referenzen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.1415926535'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape.

    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_square( iv_side = '4' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '10' ) TO lt_shapes.

    LOOP AT lt_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      out->write( |Fläche: { lo_shape->get_area( ) }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area( ) exp = '3.1415926535' msg = 'Kreisfläche falsch' ).

    DATA(lo_square) = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = '2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_square->zif_shape~get_area( ) exp = '4' msg = 'Quadratfläche falsch' ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    " Direkter Test des Outputs ist hier schwierig, daher nur Instanziierung und Methodenaufruf prüfen.
    lo_processor->if_oo_adt_classrun~main( cl_abap_unit_test_output=>get_out( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' " Dummy-Assertion
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Durch die Verwendung eines Interfaces (`zif_shape`) können verschiedene Klassen (`zcl_circle`, `zcl_square`) über eine gemeinsame Referenz (`REF TO zif_shape`) angesprochen werden. Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`) und `REF TO` um den Typ einer beliebigen Variablen zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und die Attribute des zurückgegebenen Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hallo ABAP',
          lv_int    TYPE i VALUE 123,
          lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Typ von lv_string ermitteln
    DATA(lo_typedescr_string) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lv_string ).
    out->write( |Typ von lv_string: { lo_typedescr_string->get_name( ) } ({ lo_typedescr_string->type_kind })| ).

    " Typ von lv_int ermitteln
    DATA(lo_typedescr_int) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lv_int ).
    out->write( |Typ von lv_int: { lo_typedescr_int->get_name( ) } ({ lo_typedescr_int->type_kind })| ).

    " Typ von lt_sflight ermitteln
    DATA(lo_typedescr_table) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflight ).
    out->write( |Typ von lt_sflight: { lo_typedescr_table->get_name( ) } ({ lo_typedescr_table->type_kind })| ).

    " Bei Tabellen kann man auch den Zeilentyp ermitteln
    IF lo_typedescr_table->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
      DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr_table ).
      DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
      out->write( |  Zeilentyp von lt_sflight: { lo_line_descr->get_name( ) } ({ lo_line_descr->type_kind })| ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_describe FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_describe.
    DATA: lv_test_string TYPE string VALUE 'Test',
          lv_test_int    TYPE i VALUE 42.

    DATA(lo_descr_str) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lv_test_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_descr_str->get_name( ) exp = 'STRING' msg = 'String-Typ falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_descr_str->type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string msg = 'String-Typekind falsch' ).

    DATA(lo_descr_int) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lv_test_int ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_descr_int->get_name( ) exp = 'I' msg = 'Integer-Typ falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_descr_int->type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int msg = 'Integer-Typekind falsch' ).

    DATA: lt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_descr_table) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_test_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_descr_table->type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table msg = 'Tabellen-Typekind falsch' ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr_table ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_name( ) exp = 'I' msg = 'Tabellen-Zeilentyp falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Runtime Type Information (RTTI) über die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, um den Typ von Variablen zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. `describe_by_data` nimmt eine Datenreferenz entgegen (implizit durch die Variable, die übergeben wird) und liefert ein Typbeschreibungsobjekt zurück. `CAST` wird verwendet, um spezifischere Typinformationen (z.B. für Tabellen) zu erhalten. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) sind hier ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, REF TO, Dynamische Typanalyse, CAST

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in einem `CL_GUI_ALV_GRID` an, das in einem `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` eingebettet ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Klasse mit einer Methode, die einen String als `REF TO` übergibt und diesen String modifiziert. Zeigen Sie, dass die Änderung außerhalb der Methode sichtbar ist.

CLASS zcl_string_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

CLASS zcl_string_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Originaler Text'.
    out->write( |Vorher: { lv_original_string }| ).

    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_helper_modifier( ).
    lo_modifier->modify_string( CHANGING cv_text = lv_original_string ).

    out->write( |Nachher: { lv_original_string }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_string CHANGING cv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_string.
    cv_text = cv_text && ' - modifiziert!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Typnamen erzeugt und mit Daten füllt. Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` mit `CASTING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>GET_TABLE_DESCR` und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lr_table TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_line  TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

    " Dynamische Erzeugung einer Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Tabelle mit Daten füllen
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @<lt_table> UP TO 5 ROWS.
      out->write( |Dynamisch erzeugte Tabelle vom Typ SFLIGHT mit { lines( <lt_table> ) } Zeilen gefüllt.| ).

      " Erste Zeile ausgeben
      READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        out->write( |Erste Zeile: { <ls_line> }| ). " Ausgabe des gesamten Zeileninhalts
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lr_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lt_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> )->get_name( ) exp = 'STANDARD TABLE OF SFLIGHT' msg = 'Falscher Tabellentyp' ).

    " Test, ob Daten eingefügt werden können
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @<lt_table> UP TO 1 ROWS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 1 msg = 'Tabelle nicht gefüllt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Objektinstanz auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Verwenden Sie `REF TO` und `CALL METHOD` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `ABAP_PARMBIND_TAB` für die Parameterübergabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_object) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lv_method_name) = 'PROCESS_DATA'.
    DATA(lv_input_value) = 'Dynamischer Aufruf'.
    DATA(lv_output_result) = ''.

    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    " Parameter für IMPORTING
    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_input_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    " Parameter für EXPORTING
    CLEAR ls_parameter.
    ls_parameter-name = 'EV_RESULT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_output_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(lv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
        out->write( |Methode '{ lv_method_name }' erfolgreich aufgerufen.| ).
        out->write( |Ergebnis: { lv_output_result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call).
        out->write( |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf: { lx_dyn_call->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING iv_input  TYPE string
      EXPORTING ev_result TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    ev_result = |Verarbeitet: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lv_method) = 'PROCESS_DATA'.
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Testwert'.
    DATA(lv_output) = ''.

    DATA: lt_params TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_param  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_param-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_input INTO ls_param-value.
    APPEND ls_param TO lt_params.

    CLEAR ls_param.
    ls_param-name = 'EV_RESULT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_output INTO ls_param-value.
    APPEND ls_param TO lt_params.

    CALL METHOD lo_target->(lv_method) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_params.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'Verarbeitet: Testwert' msg = 'Dynamischer Methodenaufruf fehlgeschlagen' ).

    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lv_method) = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'.

    CALL METHOD lo_target->(lv_method) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_params.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf in ABAP, ein mächtiges Feature für generische Frameworks. Der Methodenname wird zur Laufzeit in einer Variablen gehalten. Parameter werden über eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `ABAP_PARMBIND_TAB` übergeben, wobei `GET REFERENCE OF` verwendet wird, um Referenzen auf die tatsächlichen Daten zu erhalten. `REF TO` ist hier implizit durch die Referenz auf das Objekt und die Datenreferenzen in der Parameter-Tabelle. `NEW` und Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne Syntaxelemente.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Programm, das dynamisch einen `CL_GUI_ALV_GRID` in einem `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` erzeugt und dessen Feldkatalog zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer internen Tabelle generiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LVC_S_FCAT` für den Feldkatalog und `CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE` zur dynamischen Erzeugung der ALV-Struktur.
solution:
REPORT z_gui_alv_dynamic_fcat.

DATA: go_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_alv_grid         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

DATA: gt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CALL SCREEN 100.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Module  STATUS_0100  OUTPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.
  SET PF-STATUS 'MAIN100'.
  SET TITLEBAR 'ALV_DYNAMIC_FCAT'.

  IF go_custom_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT go_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = go_custom_container.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @gt_data UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA: lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA(lv_col_pos) = 1.

    " Dynamischen Feldkatalog generieren
    LOOP AT cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' )->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat(
        fieldname = ls_comp-name
        coltext   = ls_comp-name
        col_pos   = lv_col_pos
      ) TO lt_fcat.
      lv_col_pos = lv_col_pos + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    CALL METHOD go_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      CHANGING
        it_outtab       = gt_data.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0100  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.

  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

CLASS zcl_ref_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

CLASS zcl_ref_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lo_object_bound TYPE REF TO zcl_ref_checker,
          lo_object_unbound TYPE REF TO zcl_ref_checker.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_object_bound.

    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_helper_checker( ).

    out->write( |Prüfung gebundene Referenz: { lo_checker->is_ref_bound( lo_object_bound ) }| ).
    out->write( |Prüfung ungebundene Referenz: { lo_checker->is_ref_bound( lo_object_unbound ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_ref_bound
      IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_bound) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_ref_bound.
    IF io_object IS BOUND.
      rv_is_bound = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_bound = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_test_object) = NEW zcl_ref_checker( ).

DATA: go_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,

CALL SCREEN 100.

MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.

      text  = 'Mein Button'

    go_toolbar->set_button_state(
      fcode = 'BUTTON1'
      state = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_enabled

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0100  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.
  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'BUTTON1'.
      MESSAGE 'Button 1 geklickt!' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Objektreferenzen (`REF TO object`) entgegennimmt und für jedes Objekt eine spezifische Methode aufruft, falls diese Methode im Objekt existiert (dynamischer Methodenaufruf mit RTTI).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR=>GET_METHOD_TYPE` und `CALL METHOD` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lt_objects TYPE TABLE OF REF TO object.

    APPEND NEW zcl_object_with_method( ) TO lt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_object_without_method( ) TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_helper_generic_caller( ).
    lo_caller->call_method_if_exists( it_objects = lt_objects iv_method_name = 'DO_SOMETHING' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_with_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS do_something.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_with_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD do_something.
    cl_demo_output=>display( 'zcl_object_with_method: DO_SOMETHING aufgerufen!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_without_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " Keine do_something Methode
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_without_method IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_generic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_if_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_objects     TYPE TABLE OF REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_generic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_if_exists.
    LOOP AT it_objects INTO DATA(lo_object).
      DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( lo_object ).
      DATA(lv_class_name) = lo_class_descr->get_name( ).

      TRY.
          " Prüfen, ob die Methode existiert
          lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

          " Methode dynamisch aufrufen
          CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name).
          cl_demo_output=>display( |Methode '{ iv_method_name }' in Klasse '{ lv_class_name }' aufgerufen.| ).
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call).
          cl_demo_output=>display( |Methode '{ iv_method_name }' existiert nicht oder Fehler in Klasse '{ lv_class_name }'.| ).
        CATCH cx_sy_clas_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_descr_error).
          cl_demo_output=>display( |Fehler bei der Klassenbeschreibung für '{ lv_class_name }': { lx_descr_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_exists.
    DATA: lt_test_objects TYPE TABLE OF REF TO object.
    APPEND NEW zcl_object_with_method( ) TO lt_test_objects.

    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_helper_generic_caller( ).
    " Der Test prüft, ob keine Dumps auftreten und die Logik korrekt durchläuft.
    " Direkte Output-Prüfung ist hier schwierig.
    lo_caller->call_method_if_exists( it_objects = lt_test_objects iv_method_name = 'DO_SOMETHING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_not_exists.
    DATA: lt_test_objects TYPE TABLE OF REF TO object.
    APPEND NEW zcl_object_without_method( ) TO lt_test_objects.

    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_helper_generic_caller( ).
    " Erwartet, dass keine Exception geworfen wird, sondern der Catch-Block erreicht wird.
    lo_caller->call_method_if_exists( it_objects = lt_test_objects iv_method_name = 'DO_SOMETHING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REF TO object` mit RTTI (`CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR`) und dynamischen Methodenaufrufen, um eine generische Verarbeitung von Objekten zu ermöglichen. Die Methode `get_method_type` wird verwendet, um die Existenz einer Methode zu prüfen, bevor `CALL METHOD` dynamisch aufgerufen wird. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks, die mit unbekannten Objekttypen interagieren müssen. `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke fangen Laufzeitfehler ab. `NEW` und Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne ABAP-Syntax.

Instructions: Erstelle eine einfache XLSX-Datei mit Daten aus der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle. Die Datei soll die Spalten CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE und PRICE enthalten.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_basic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_basic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. "Limit for demo

    DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx_document->add_new_worksheet( 'SFLIGHTS Data' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).

    " Add data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).

      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine XLSX-Datei mit zwei Arbeitsblättern. Das erste Blatt soll Daten aus SFLIGHTS enthalten, das zweite Blatt eine einfache Liste von Zahlen.
hint: Rufe `add_new_worksheet` mehrmals auf, um verschiedene Arbeitsblätter zu erstellen und zu befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multi_sheet_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).

    " Worksheet 1: SFLIGHTS Data
    DATA(lo_worksheet1) = lo_xlsx_document->add_new_worksheet( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    DATA(lv_row1) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lv_row1 = lv_row1 + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Worksheet 2: Numbers
    DATA(lo_worksheet2) = lo_xlsx_document->add_new_worksheet( 'Numbers' ).
    lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Number' ).
    DATA(lv_row2) = 2.
    DO 5 TIMES.
      lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = sy-index ).
      lv_row2 = lv_row2 + 1.
    ENDDO.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_styling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_styled_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_styling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_styled_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx_document->add_new_worksheet( 'Styled SFLIGHTS' ).

    " Define header format (bold)
    DATA(lo_font_bold) = NEW cl_xlsx_font( ).
    lo_font_bold->set_bold( abap_true ).
    DATA(lo_format_header) = NEW cl_xlsx_cell_format( ).
    lo_format_header->set_font( lo_font_bold ).

    " Define currency format
    DATA(lo_format_currency) = NEW cl_xlsx_cell_format( ).
    lo_format_currency->set_number_format( '"$"#,##0.00' ). " Example format, adjust as needed

    " Add header row with bold format
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_format = lo_format_header ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_format = lo_format_header ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_format = lo_format_header ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_format = lo_format_header ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Currency' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_format = lo_format_header ).

    " Add data rows with currency format for price
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).n      lo_worksheet->set_cell_format( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_format = lo_format_currency ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mische die Einträge einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHTS) zufällig.
hint: Erstelle eine temporäre Tabelle mit Zufallszahlen und sortiere die Originaltabelle danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_sflights IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    DATA: lt_temp_shuffle TYPE TABLE OF struct_shuffle_helper WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_shuffle_helper,
             random_key TYPE i,
             sflight_data TYPE sflight,
           END OF struct_shuffle_helper.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 1000000 ).

    lt_temp_shuffle = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( ),
                                  sflight_data = ls_sflight ) ).

    SORT lt_temp_shuffle BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_temp IN lt_temp_shuffle
                                    ( ls_temp-sflight_data ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA: lt_original_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_original_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sflights) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Shuffled table size mismatch' ).
    " It's hard to assert true randomness, but we can check if it's not identical (with high probability)
    IF lines( lt_original_sflights ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sflights exp = lt_original_sflights msg = 'Table was not shuffled (might happen rarely by chance)' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eine Tabelle zufällig zu mischen, wird eine Hilfstabelle erstellt, die jeden Originaleintrag zusammen mit einer zufälligen Zahl speichert. Durch das Sortieren dieser Hilfstabelle nach der Zufallszahl wird die Reihenfolge der Originaleinträge effektiv gemischt. Anschließend werden die gemischten Daten in die Ergebnistabelle übertragen. Dies nutzt moderne `FOR`-Ausdrücke für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
keywords: RANDOM, cl_abap_random_int, Internal Tables, Shuffle, SORT, VALUE, FOR

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sorted_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_note ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Check if sorted (implicit by type, but can be verified)
    DATA lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA lv_prev_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table is not sorted by CARRID' act = ( ls_flight-carrid GE lv_prev_carrid ) ).
        IF ls_flight-carrid EQ lv_prev_carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table is not sorted by CONNID' act = ( ls_flight-connid GE lv_prev_connid ) ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_line

        cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight (
      carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
      price    = ls_sflight-price,
      currency = ls_sflight-currency
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_flight_data.
    TRY.
        rs_flight = mt_flights[ KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines spezifischen Fluges (Fluggesellschaft 'AA', Flugnummer '0017') in einer sortierten Tabelle auf 500.00.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` oder `MODIFY TABLE` mit dem Tabellenausdruck.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_line.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft sowie den durchschnittlichen Preis für jede Gruppe. Nutzen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle als Quelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight (
      carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
      price    = ls_sflight-price,
      currency = ls_sflight-currency
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lv_total_price TYPE sflight-price.

    LOOP AT mt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 FOR <member> IN GROUP ( sum + <member>-price ) ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                      avg_price = lv_total_price / GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Summary table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_summary ) ).

    " Example: Check for 'LH' flights
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_group=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH flight count should be positive' act = ( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH average price should be positive' act = ( ls_lh_summary-avg_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " Example: Check for 'AA' flights
    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_group=>ty_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_aa_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'AA flight count should be positive' act = ( ls_aa_summary-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'AA average price should be positive' act = ( ls_aa_summary-avg_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung in Verbindung mit `GROUP SIZE` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator bietet eine leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ist wesentlich flexibler und lesbarer als ältere Ansätze mit `AT NEW` oder manuellen Schleifen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, GROUP BY, REDUCE, GROUP SIZE, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Generiere eine Zufallszahl (Integer) zwischen zwei gegebenen Ganzzahlen (inklusive).

solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_int_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_integer
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
      RETURNING

  METHOD get_random_integer.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    rv_random_integer = iv_min + trunc( lv_float * ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_int_gen( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_rand >= lv_min AND lv_rand <= lv_max ) msg = 'Zufallszahl sollte im definierten Bereich liegen' ).

    " Test a few times to increase confidence

        io_shape TYPE REF TO lif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_type_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE lcl_circle THEN
        rv_result = 'Verarbeite Kreis'.
      WHEN TYPE lcl_square THEN
        rv_result = 'Verarbeite Quadrat'.
      WHEN OTHERS THEN

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_type_processor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_circle exp = 'Verarbeite Kreis' msg = 'Kreis sollte korrekt verarbeitet werden' ).

    DATA(lo_square) = NEW lcl_square( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_square exp = 'Verarbeite Quadrat' msg = 'Quadrat sollte korrekt verarbeitet werden' ).

Instructions: Wähle einen zufälligen Eintrag aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Ermittle die Anzahl der Zeilen und generiere einen zufälligen Index, um auf den Eintrag zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_sflight_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_sflight_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_num_rows) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = trunc( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_num_rows ) + 1.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektiere Flüge aus `sflights` und füge eine Spalte hinzu, die den Status des Fluges basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH' ist 'Preferred', 'UA' ist 'Standard', andere sind 'Other') anzeigt.
hint: Verwende den `CASE`-Ausdruck direkt im `SELECT`-Statement (ABAP SQL).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_case_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE carrid
             WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Preferred'
             WHEN 'UA' THEN 'Standard'
             ELSE 'Other'
           END AS status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_case_select( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'Es sollten Flüge zurückgegeben werden' ).

    " Check some specific cases
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_ua_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_other_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      CASE ls_flight-carrid.
        WHEN 'LH'.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Preferred' msg = 'LH Status falsch' ).
          lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
        WHEN 'UA'.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Standard' msg = 'UA Status falsch' ).
          lv_ua_count = lv_ua_count + 1.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-status exp = 'Other' msg = 'Other Status falsch' ).
          lv_other_count = lv_other_count + 1.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_lh_count > 0 OR lv_ua_count > 0 OR lv_other_count > 0 ) msg = 'Mindestens ein Status sollte gefunden werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ermöglicht die dynamische Berechnung von Spaltenwerten basierend auf Bedingungen direkt in der Datenbankabfrage, was die Datenverarbeitung effizienter macht, da weniger Daten an den Applikationsserver übertragen werden müssen und die Logik näher an den Daten liegt.
