Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Betrag von einer Quellwährung in eine Zielwährung unter Berücksichtigung eines Wechselkurses. Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` und `COND` für die Behandlung von Null-Wechselkursen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` für die Multiplikation und `COND` zur Vermeidung einer Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_currency_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount       TYPE s_price
        iv_exchange_rate TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_amount) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_currency_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_currency.
    rv_converted_amount = CALCULATE iv_amount * COND decfloat16(
                                      WHEN iv_exchange_rate IS INITIAL OR iv_exchange_rate = 0 THEN 1 " Avoid division by zero, or handle as error
                                      ELSE iv_exchange_rate
                                    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_currency FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_currency.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_currency_conv( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_currency( iv_amount = 100 iv_exchange_rate = '1.2' ) exp = 120 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_currency( iv_amount = 50 iv_exchange_rate = '0.8' ) exp = 40 ).
    " Test with zero exchange rate (should return original amount as per solution logic)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_currency( iv_amount = 100 iv_exchange_rate = '0' ) exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->convert_currency( iv_amount = 100 iv_exchange_rate = '' ) exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `CALCULATE` für eine Währungsumrechnung, wobei der `COND`-Ausdruck verwendet wird, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden, falls der Wechselkurs nicht gültig ist. Dies ist eine robuste und moderne Art, Berechnungen durchzuführen, die potenzielle Fehlerquellen direkt im Ausdruck abfangen.
keywords: CALCULATE, COND, Currency, Math, Error Handling

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`). Für jeden Flug soll ein 'Risikolevel' ('Niedrig', 'Mittel', 'Hoch') basierend auf der Flugdauer und dem Preis zugewiesen werden. Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `CASE`-Ausdrücke oder `CASE` innerhalb von `FOR`.

             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fltime      TYPE s_fltime,
             price       TYPE s_price,
             risk_level  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_risk.
    TYPES tt_flight_risk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_risk WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_risk_levels
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_risks) TYPE tt_flight_risk.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cas_nested_risk IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_risk_levels.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fltime, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flight_risks = VALUE tt_flight_risk(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid     = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid     = ls_flight-connid,
          fltime     = ls_flight-fltime,
          price      = ls_flight-price,
          risk_level = CASE
                         WHEN ls_flight-fltime > 400 THEN 'Hoch' " Long flights are high risk
                         WHEN ls_flight-fltime > 200 THEN " Medium flights
                           CASE
                             WHEN ls_flight-price > 800 THEN 'Hoch'
                             ELSE 'Mittel'
                           END
                         ELSE " Short flights
                           CASE
                             WHEN ls_flight-price > 500 THEN 'Mittel'
                             ELSE 'Niedrig'
                           END
                       END
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_risk_levels FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_risk_levels.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cas_nested_risk( ).
    DATA(lt_risks) = lo_cut->get_flight_risk_levels( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flight risks should not be empty' act = lines( lt_risks ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).

    " Test specific risk levels (assuming data exists)
    DATA(lv_high_risk_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_medium_risk_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_low_risk_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_risks INTO DATA(ls_risk).
      CASE ls_risk-risk_level.
        WHEN 'Hoch'.
          lv_high_risk_count = lv_high_risk_count + 1.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'High risk logic check' act = ( ls_risk-fltime > 400 OR ( ls_risk-fltime > 200 AND ls_risk-price > 800 ) ) ).
        WHEN 'Mittel'.
          lv_medium_risk_count = lv_medium_risk_count + 1.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Medium risk logic check' act = ( ( ls_risk-fltime > 200 AND ls_risk-fltime <= 400 AND ls_risk-price <= 800 ) OR ( ls_risk-fltime <= 200 AND ls_risk-price > 500 ) ) ).
        WHEN 'Niedrig'.
          lv_low_risk_count = lv_low_risk_count + 1.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Low risk logic check' act = ( ls_risk-fltime <= 200 AND ls_risk-price <= 500 ) ).
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should have some high risk flights' act = ( lv_high_risk_count > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should have some medium risk flights' act = ( lv_medium_risk_count > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should have some low risk flights' act = ( lv_low_risk_count > 0 ) ).

CLASS zcl_cal_string_prefix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_prefixed_string_length

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Berechnung basierend auf einem übergebenen Operator durch. Die Berechnung soll zwei Zahlen verknüpfen. Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` und `CASE` für die Operatorauswahl.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CALCULATE` mit einem `CASE`-Ausdruck, um den Operator dynamisch zu wählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_dynamic_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_dynamic_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand1 TYPE decfloat34
        iv_operand2 TYPE decfloat34
        iv_operator TYPE string " e.g., '+', '-', '*', '/'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_dynamic_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_dynamic_calculation.
    rv_result = CALCULATE
                  CASE iv_operator
                    WHEN '+' THEN iv_operand1 + iv_operand2
                    WHEN '-' THEN iv_operand1 - iv_operand2
                    WHEN '*' THEN iv_operand1 * iv_operand2
                    WHEN '/' THEN COND decfloat34(
                                      WHEN iv_operand2 = 0 THEN 0 " Handle division by zero
                                      ELSE iv_operand1 / iv_operand2
                                    )
                    ELSE 0 " Default for unknown operator
                  END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_perform_dynamic_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_perform_dynamic_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_dynamic_op( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_calculation( 10 5 '+' ) exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_calculation( 10 5 '-' ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_calculation( 10 5 '*' ) exp = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_calculation( 10 5 '/' ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_calculation( 10 0 '/' ) exp = 0 ). " Division by zero handling
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_calculation( 10 5 '^' ) exp = 0 ). " Unknown operator
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine dynamische Berechnung, bei der der Operator zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Die Kombination von `CALCULATE` und `CASE` ermöglicht es, die entsprechende arithmetische Operation kompakt und sicher auszuwählen. Die zusätzliche Verwendung von `COND` innerhalb des `CASE` für die Division durch Null zeigt eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung direkt im Ausdruck.
keywords: CALCULATE, CASE, Dynamic Programming, Math, Conditional Logic

INTERFACE zif_processor.
  METHODS process IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    rv_output = |Processor A: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor_b IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_output = |Processor B: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_processor_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_processor.
    ro_processor = CASE iv_type
                     WHEN 'A' THEN NEW zcl_processor_a( )
                     WHEN 'B' THEN NEW zcl_processor_b( )

                   END.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen. Für jede Zahl soll der Wert quadriert werden, wenn sie gerade ist, und verdreifacht, wenn sie ungerade ist. Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `VALUE`, `CALCULATE` und `COND` für die bedingte Transformation.

CLASS zcl_cal_transform_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_transform_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_numbers.
    rt_transformed_numbers = VALUE #( FOR lv_num IN it_numbers
                                      ( CALCULATE COND i(
                                          WHEN lv_num MOD 2 = 0 THEN lv_num * lv_num
                                          ELSE lv_num * 3
                                        ) )
                                    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 9 ) ( 16 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_numbers( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

    DATA(lt_input_empty) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lt_result_empty) = lo_cut->transform_numbers( lt_input_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result_empty ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es zeigt, wie man eine interne Tabelle in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung transformieren kann, indem man für jedes Element eine bedingte Berechnung durchführt. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und moderner Ansatz, der die Notwendigkeit expliziter `LOOP`- und `IF`-Anweisungen eliminiert und den Code extrem kompakt und lesbar macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Uhrzeiten in Sekunden.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Zeiten in Sekunden seit Mitternacht und subtrahieren Sie diese.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_time_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_time1 TYPE tims
        iv_time2 TYPE tims
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_difference_in_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_time_difference.
    DATA(lv_seconds1) = ( iv_time1(2) * 3600 ) + ( iv_time1+2(2) * 60 ) + iv_time1+4(2).
    DATA(lv_seconds2) = ( iv_time2(2) * 3600 ) + ( iv_time2+2(2) * 60 ) + iv_time2+4(2).
    rv_difference_in_seconds = lv_seconds2 - lv_seconds1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_time_difference( ).
    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_cut->calculate_time_difference( iv_time1 = '100000' iv_time2 = '100030' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 30 msg = '30 Sekunden Differenz' ).

    lv_diff = lo_cut->calculate_time_difference( iv_time1 = '100000' iv_time2 = '095900' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = -60 msg = '-60 Sekunden Differenz' ).

    lv_diff = lo_cut->calculate_time_difference( iv_time1 = '235959' iv_time2 = '000000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = -86399 msg = 'Tageswechsel Differenz' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung bei der Codepage-Konvertierung, wenn ungültige Zeichen oder eine falsche Kodierung angegeben werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encod
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = iv_encoding ).
        lo_conv->read(
          EXPORTING
            input  = iv_xstring
          IMPORTING
            result = rv_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Loggen, Standardwert zurückgeben oder Fehlermeldung ausgeben
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_string = 'FEHLER BEI KONVERTIERUNG'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) TYPE xstring VALUE 'FF'. " Ungültiges Byte für viele Kodierungen

    " Test mit ungültiger Kodierung
    DATA(lv_result_invalid_enc) = lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
      iv_xstring  = lv_invalid_xstring
      iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_invalid_enc exp = 'FEHLER BEI KONVERTIERUNG' msg = 'Fehler bei ungültiger Kodierung abgefangen' ).

    " Test mit gültiger Konvertierung
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Valid String'.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING input = lv_original_string IMPORTING result = lv_utf8_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_result_valid_enc) = lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
      iv_xstring  = lv_utf8_xstring
      iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_valid_enc exp = lv_original_string msg = 'Gültige Konvertierung erfolgreich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Codepage-Konvertierung kann fehlschlagen, wenn die Eingabedaten nicht der angegebenen Kodierung entsprechen. Dies verhindert Programmabbrüche und ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Reaktion auf fehlerhafte externe Daten.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen ABAP-String in ein XSTRING mit UTF-16 Big Endian Kodierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create()` mit 'UTF-16BE' und `cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_to_utf16be DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_utf16be_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf16be_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_to_utf16be IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_utf16be_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-16BE'
      endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big
    ).
    lo_conv->write(
      EXPORTING
        input  = iv_string
      IMPORTING
        result = rv_utf16be_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_to_utf16be FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_to_utf16be.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_to_utf16be( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hello World mit UTF-16BE'.
    DATA(lv_utf16be_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        lv_utf16be_xstring = lo_cut->convert_string_to_utf16be_xstring( lv_original_string ).

        " Zur Überprüfung: Konvertierung zurück mit cl_abap_conv_in_ce
        DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-16BE'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big
        ).
        DATA(lv_converted_back_string) TYPE string.
        lo_conv_in->read(
          EXPORTING
            input  = lv_utf16be_xstring
          IMPORTING
            result = lv_converted_back_string
        ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_back_string exp = lv_original_string msg = 'String zu UTF-16BE XSTRING und zurück' ).
    CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Codepage-Konvertierung um die explizite Angabe der Byte-Reihenfolge (Endianness). `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` ermöglicht es, Daten für Systeme vorzubereiten, die UTF-16 mit Big Endian erwarten, was für die Interoperabilität mit bestimmten Plattformen oder Protokollen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: Codepage, UTF-16, Big Endian, XSTRING, Conversion, cl_abap_conv_out_ce

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency

      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_sflights pretty_print = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit einer einfachen Schleife, die 100.000 Iterationen durchführt und dabei eine Variable inkrementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds` vor und nach der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_measure_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_loop_time
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_microseconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_measure_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_loop_time.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_counter    TYPE i.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    DO 100000 TIMES.
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
    ENDDO.

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    rv_microseconds = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_runtime) = lo_cut->measure_loop_time( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance einer `LOOP AT ... WHERE`-Anweisung mit einem `FILTER`-Ausdruck für das Filtern einer großen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` für die Messung und `FILTER` für den modernen Ansatz. Erstellen Sie eine große Testtabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_compare_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_filter_performance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE BEGIN OF ty_runtimes,
                                  loop_at_where TYPE i,
                                  filter_exp    TYPE i,
                                END OF ty_runtimes.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS create_large_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_large_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_compare_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_large_table.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      ls_data-id = sy-index.
      ls_data-text = |Text { sy-index }|.
      APPEND ls_data TO rt_large_table.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_filter_performance.
    DATA: lt_large_table TYPE tt_data,
          lt_filtered_loop TYPE tt_data,
          lt_filtered_filter TYPE tt_data,
          lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i.

    lt_large_table = create_large_table( ).

    " Measure LOOP AT ... WHERE
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    LOOP AT lt_large_table INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE id MOD 100 = 0.
      APPEND ls_entry TO lt_filtered_loop.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-loop_at_where = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure FILTER expression
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lt_filtered_filter = FILTER #( lt_large_table WHERE id MOD 100 = 0 ).
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-filter_exp = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_compare_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_runtime_compare_filter( ).
    DATA(ls_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_filter_performance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LOOP AT WHERE runtime > 0' act = ( ls_runtimes-loop_at_where > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'FILTER runtime > 0' act = ( ls_runtimes-filter_exp > 0 ) ).

    " Optional: Assert that FILTER is faster, but this can vary based on system load
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'FILTER should be faster than LOOP AT WHERE' act = ( ls_runtimes-filter_exp < ls_runtimes-loop_at_where ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance zweier gängiger Filter-Methoden für interne Tabellen: die traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE`-Anweisung und den modernen `FILTER`-Ausdruck. `cl_abap_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Ausführungszeiten zu messen. `FILTER` ist oft performanter und bietet eine prägnantere Syntax.
keywords: Runtime, performance, FILTER, internal table, cl_abap_runtime, LOOP AT WHERE

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights` mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('AA') und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit nur Flugnummer (`connid`) und Abflugort (`cityfrom`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_info.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_spfli    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    SELECT * FROM spfli INTO TABLE @lt_spfli FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @lt_sflights-carrid AND connid = @lt_sflights-connid.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                               LET ls_spfli = lt_spfli[ KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = ls_sflight-carrid AND connid = ls_sflight-connid ] IN
                               ( connid = ls_sflight-connid, cityfrom = ls_spfli-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_map FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_map.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_info( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry CONNID should be 0017' act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry CITYFROM should be NEW YORK' act = lt_result[1]-cityfrom exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Transformation von internen Tabellen. Zuerst wird die `sflights`-Tabelle gefiltert, dann wird für jede gefilterte Zeile eine neue Struktur erstellt, wobei `spfli` für den Abflugort herangezogen wird. Die `LET`-Anweisung verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei der Suche in `lt_spfli`.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, sflights, spfli, map, transform

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Statusnachricht. Wenn der Status 'OK' ist, soll die Nachricht 'Vorgang erfolgreich: <Wert>' lauten. Bei 'ERROR' soll sie 'Fehler aufgetreten: <Wert>' sein. Andernfalls 'Unbekannter Status: <Wert>'.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und den `COND`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_template_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE string
        iv_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_message.
    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status = 'OK'    THEN |Vorgang erfolgreich: { iv_value }|

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Summenvariable und `sflights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_create_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen dynamischen `SELECT`-Aufruf auf die Tabelle `sflights` durch, bei dem die `WHERE`-Klausel und die ausgewählten Felder zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE (lv_where_clause) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result)` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für die dynamische Feldliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_clause TYPE string
        it_fields       TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_dynamic_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA: lv_field_list TYPE string,
          lt_sflights   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_struct> TYPE ANY STRUCTURE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " Build dynamic field list
    LOOP AT it_fields INTO DATA(lv_field).
      IF lv_field_list IS INITIAL.
        lv_field_list = lv_field.
      ELSE.
        lv_field_list = lv_field_list && `,` && lv_field.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Dynamic SELECT
    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_field_list)
          FROM sflights
          WHERE (iv_where_clause)
          INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Convert generic sflights table to dynamic result structure
          lr_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ).
          lr_struct_descr ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

          LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_struct>.
            LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                APPEND VALUE ty_dynamic_data( field_name = ls_component-name field_value = |{ <fs_field> }| ) TO rt_result.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_osql_error).
        " Handle dynamic SQL error
        APPEND VALUE ty_dynamic_data( field_name = 'ERROR' field_value = lx_osql_error->get_text( ) ) TO rt_result.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `CARRID = 'LH' AND CONNID = '0400'`.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_select( iv_where_clause = lv_where it_fields = lt_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_initial ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should be LH' act = lt_result[1]-field_value exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CONNID should be 0400' act = lt_result[2]-field_value exp = '0400' ).

    " Test with invalid WHERE clause
    lv_where = `INVALID_FIELD = 'X'`.
    lt_result = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_select( iv_where_clause = lv_where it_fields = lt_fields ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should handle invalid WHERE clause' act = lt_result[1]-field_value exp = 'ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die mächtige Fähigkeit von ABAP, SQL-Abfragen zur Laufzeit dynamisch zu konstruieren. Die `SELECT (lv_field_list) ... WHERE (iv_where_clause)`-Syntax erlaubt es, sowohl die ausgewählten Felder als auch die `WHERE`-Bedingung als Strings zu übergeben. Die Ergebnisse werden dann in einer generischen internen Tabelle verarbeitet und in eine benutzerdefinierte Struktur umgewandelt, um die dynamischen Felder darzustellen. Fehlerbehandlung mit `CX_SY_DYNAMIC_OSQL_ERROR` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SELECT, WHERE clause, dynamic SQL, sflights, RTTI, CX_SY_DYNAMIC_OSQL_ERROR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit `VALUE` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, die aus einer anderen Tabelle abgeleitet und transformiert werden, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... ) )` und `COND` für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_value_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
             flag  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_original_data.
    TYPES tt_original_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_data,
             new_id    TYPE i,
             status    TYPE string,
             calc_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_transformed_data.
    TYPES tt_transformed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_data
      IMPORTING
        it_original_data TYPE tt_original_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE tt_transformed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_value_for_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_original IN it_original_data
                                   ( new_id     = ls_original-id * 10,
                                     status     = COND string( WHEN ls_original-flag = abap_true THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' ),
                                     calc_value = COND i( WHEN ls_original-value > 100 THEN ls_original-value / 2 ELSE ls_original-value * 2 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_value_for_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_itab_value_for_cond=>tt_original_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 50 flag = abap_true )
      ( id = 2 value = 200 flag = abap_false )
      ( id = 3 value = 10 flag = abap_true )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_data( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 3 entries' act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry new_id incorrect' act = lt_transformed[1]-new_id exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry status incorrect' act = lt_transformed[1]-status exp = 'ACTIVE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry calc_value incorrect' act = lt_transformed[1]-calc_value exp = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry new_id incorrect' act = lt_transformed[2]-new_id exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry status incorrect' act = lt_transformed[2]-status exp = 'INACTIVE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry calc_value incorrect' act = lt_transformed[2]-calc_value exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `COND` zur Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Mit `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... ) )` kann eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer bestehenden Tabelle in einer einzigen Zeile deklariert und gefüllt werden. `COND` ermöglicht dabei bedingte Zuweisungen für einzelne Felder, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, COND, transform, map, functional programming

Instructions: Summiere den Preis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwende den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Preise zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge in SFLIGHT und die Summe ist größer als 0.
    " Ein genauerer Test würde die Daten in SFLIGHT mocken oder vorab prüfen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total price should not be initial' act = lv_total_price exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Hier wird der `sum`-Wert initialisiert und in jedem Schleifendurchlauf um den `price` des aktuellen Fluges erhöht.

Instructions: Konkateniere alle Städtenamen der Abflugorte aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Doppelte Städtenamen sollen nur einmal vorkommen.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einer Hash-Tabelle oder `FOR` und `CONDENSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_cities_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_cities_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_cities_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_cities_string = REDUCE string(
        INIT result = ``
             unique_cities = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF s_city FROM ()
                                 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( NOT line_exists( unique_cities[ flight-cityfrom ] ) )
        NEXT unique_cities = VALUE #( BASE unique_cities ( flight-cityfrom ) )
             result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN flight-cityfrom ELSE result && ', ' && flight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_unique_cities_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_cities_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_cities( ).
    DATA(lv_cities) = lo_cut->get_unique_cities_string( ).

    " Überprüfen, ob der String nicht leer ist und Kommas enthält (wenn mehrere Städte vorhanden sind)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Cities string should not be initial' act = lv_cities exp = '' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not ).
    " Beispiel für eine erwartete Ausgabe (abhängig von den Daten in SFLIGHT)
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cities exp = 'FRANKFURT, NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE`, um eine Liste eindeutiger Städtenamen zu sammeln und diese dann zu einem durch Kommas getrennten String zu konkatenieren. Die `HASHED TABLE` `unique_cities` stellt sicher, dass jeder Städtename nur einmal verarbeitet wird. `COND` wird verwendet, um das erste Element ohne vorangehendes Komma hinzuzufügen.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` und eine `HASHED TABLE` zur Speicherung der bereits gezählten Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_count_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_carriers_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carriers_count.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
             unique_carriers = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF s_carr_id FROM ()
                                 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( NOT line_exists( unique_carriers[ flight-carrid ] ) )
        NEXT unique_carriers = VALUE #( BASE unique_carriers ( flight-carrid ) )
             count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Nur wenn ein `CARRID` noch nicht in der `unique_carriers`-Tabelle existiert, wird er hinzugefügt und der Zähler (`count`) inkrementiert.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Gruppiere die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechne für jede Fluggesellschaft die Summe der Preise. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit `CARRID` und der `TOTAL_PRICE` sein.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price,
           tt_carrier_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_price_for_carrier) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                                  FOR group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                  NEXT sum = sum + group_flight-price ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_price( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     total_price = lv_total_price_for_carrier ) TO rt_grouped_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_grouped_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_grouped_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_prices) = lo_cut->get_grouped_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Grouped prices table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_grouped_prices ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ein Eintrag existiert
    READ TABLE lt_grouped_prices WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_price).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH total price should not be initial' act = ls_lh_price-total_price exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator. Zuerst werden die Flüge nach `CARRID` gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird dann `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Summe der Preise für diese spezifische Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen. Das Ergebnis wird in einer neuen internen Tabelle gesammelt.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Loop

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sum_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_combine_datfm_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sum_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_filter_date) = '20000101'.
    DATA(lv_filter_price) = 500.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights
                                                         WHERE fldate > lv_filter_date AND price > lv_filter_price )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Zahl als Eingabe nimmt. Wenn die Zahl negativ ist, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und definieren Sie eine lokale Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_positive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      check_number IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
                   RAISING   cx_z_negative_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_positive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_number.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_negative_number
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_z_negative_number=>negative_value
          value  = iv_number.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_negative_number DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF negative_value,
        msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG', " Replace with actual message class
        msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '001',
        attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'VALUE',
        attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr4 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
      END OF negative_value.
    DATA value TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_negative_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->value = value.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = negative_value.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive.
    zcl_check_positive=>check_number( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " No exception, so just assert initial
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative.
    DATA(lv_caught_value) = 0.
    TRY.
        zcl_check_positive=>check_number( -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_z_negative_number was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_z_negative_number INTO DATA(lx_neg).
        lv_caught_value = lx_neg->value.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_caught_value exp = -5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `RAISING` in der Methodensignatur und die Definition einer eigenen Ausnahme `cx_z_negative_number` ermöglicht eine klare Fehlerbehandlung und Kommunikation von Problemen. Die Ausnahme kann zusätzliche Informationen (hier `value`) transportieren.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Custom Exception, Exception Handling, Class-Methods

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige Struktur und den Namen eines ihrer Komponentenfelder als String erhält. Die Methode soll den Wert dieses Komponentenfeldes als String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any
        iv_component TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_component_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <fs_component>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_component FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_component RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_component.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_component( ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_structure = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Hello' ).

    lv_value = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_structure = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_component.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Test' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_component( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_component_value( is_structure = ls_data iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_assign_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Exception caught as expected
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit, was in generischen Programmen oder bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten sehr nützlich ist. Die Ausnahmebehandlung stellt sicher, dass ungültige Komponentennamen abgefangen werden.
keywords: ASSIGN COMPONENT, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Structure Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Fluggesellschaft und eine Flugnummer erhält. Suchen Sie in der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach dem entsprechenden Eintrag. Wenn kein Eintrag gefunden wird, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    CLASS-METHODS:
      get_flight_data
        IMPORTING
          iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
          iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data
        RAISING
          cx_z_flight_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_flight_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_z_flight_not_found=>flight_not_exist
          carrid = iv_carrid
          connid = iv_connid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_flight_not_found DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF flight_not_exist,
        msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG', " Replace with actual message class
        msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '002',
        attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'CARRID',
        attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'CONNID',
        attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr4 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
      END OF flight_not_exist.
    DATA carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_flight_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->carrid = carrid.
    me->connid = connid.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = flight_not_exist.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    " Assuming 'AA' and '0017' exist in SFLIGHT for testing purposes
    DATA(ls_flight) = zcl_flight_finder=>get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lv_caught_carrid) = ''.
    DATA(lv_caught_connid) = ''.
    TRY.
        zcl_flight_finder=>get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_z_flight_not_found was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_z_flight_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        lv_caught_carrid = lx_not_found->carrid.
        lv_caught_connid = lx_not_found->connid.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_caught_carrid exp = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_caught_connid exp = '9999' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode demonstriert die Verwendung von `SELECT SINGLE` mit Inline-Deklaration (`@`) und die Auslösung einer spezifischen Ausnahme, wenn keine Daten gefunden werden. Dies ist eine saubere Art, Fehlerzustände zu signalisieren, anstatt `sy-subrc` zu prüfen.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, SELECT SINGLE, Data Not Found, Database Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und einen Index erhält. Die Methode soll die Zeile am angegebenen Index als Field-Symbol zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN itab[index] TO <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_row
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE any TABLE
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_row>) TYPE any
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_row.
    ASSIGN it_table[ iv_index ] TO <fs_row>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_index_out_of_bounds.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_index FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_index RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_index.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_string_table( ( 'First' ) ( 'Second' ) ( 'Third' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_access( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lo_cut->get_table_row( it_table = lt_data iv_index = 2 ) TO <fs_row>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_row> exp = 'Second' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_index.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_string_table( ( 'Only one' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_access( ).

    TRY.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN lo_cut->get_table_row( it_table = lt_data iv_index = 5 ) TO <fs_row>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_assign_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Exception caught as expected
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der direkte Zugriff auf eine Tabellenzeile über `itab[index]` und die Zuweisung an ein Field-Symbol ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um mit internen Tabellen zu arbeiten, insbesondere wenn der Typ der Tabelle zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, Dynamic Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen dividiert. Wenn der Divisor Null ist, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Prüfen Sie den Divisor vor der Division und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      divide IMPORTING iv_dividend TYPE i
                     iv_divisor  TYPE i
             RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
             RAISING   cx_z_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_z_division_by_zero=>divisor_is_zero
          dividend = iv_dividend.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_division_by_zero DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF divisor_is_zero,
        msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG', " Replace with actual message class
        msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '003',
        attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'DIVIDEND',
        attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr4 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
      END OF divisor_is_zero.
    DATA dividend TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        dividend TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->dividend = dividend.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = divisor_is_zero.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_division.
    DATA(lv_result) = zcl_safe_division=>divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lv_caught_dividend) = 0.
    TRY.
        zcl_safe_division=>divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_z_division_by_zero was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_z_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        lv_caught_dividend = lx_zero->dividend.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_caught_dividend exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine explizite Prüfung auf Division durch Null und das Auslösen einer spezifischen Ausnahme ist sicherer und klarer als das Verlassen auf Laufzeitfehler. Die Ausnahme transportiert den Dividenden für eine bessere Fehleranalyse.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Division by Zero, Custom Exception, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die zwei beliebige Datenobjekte (Quell- und Zielobjekt) erhält. Kopieren Sie den Inhalt des Quellobjekts in das Zielobjekt, auch wenn die Typen nicht direkt kompatibel sind, aber eine Konvertierung möglich ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` für beide Objekte und dann die Zuweisung zwischen den Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_data_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      copy_data
        IMPORTING
          ir_source TYPE REF TO data
          ir_target TYPE REF TO data
        RAISING
          cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_data_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source->* TO <fs_source>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_reference_not_valid.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN ir_target->* TO <fs_target>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_reference_not_valid.
    ENDIF.

    " Attempt to copy data. This will raise a CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR if types are incompatible.
    TRY.
        <fs_target> = <fs_source>.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_type_conflict
            previous = lx_conv.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compatible_copy FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_incompatible_copy RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compatible_copy.
    DATA: lv_source TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',
          lv_target TYPE string.
    DATA: lr_source TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_target TYPE REF TO data.

    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source INTO lr_source.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_target INTO lr_target.

    zcl_generic_data_copy=>copy_data( ir_source = lr_source ir_target = lr_target ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_target exp = 'Hello' ).

    DATA: lv_source_i TYPE i VALUE 123,
          lv_target_s TYPE string.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source_i INTO lr_source.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_target_s INTO lr_target.
    zcl_generic_data_copy=>copy_data( ir_source = lr_source ir_target = lr_target ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_target_s exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_incompatible_copy.
    DATA: lv_source TYPE string VALUE 'ABC',
          lv_target TYPE i.
    DATA: lr_source TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_target TYPE REF TO data.

    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source INTO lr_source.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_target INTO lr_target.

    TRY.
        zcl_generic_data_copy=>copy_data( ir_source = lr_source ir_target = lr_target ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_assign_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_error->previous ). " Check if conversion error is nested
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `REF TO data` und `ASSIGN <ref>->* TO <fs>` ermöglicht die typlose Übergabe und Bearbeitung von Datenobjekten. Dies ist mächtig für generische Frameworks. Die innere `TRY...CATCH` Block fängt Konvertierungsfehler ab und kapselt sie in eine `cx_sy_assign_error` für eine konsistente Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: ASSIGN, REF TO data, Field Symbols, Generic Programming, Data Copy

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, deren Konstruktor eine Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein ungültiger Parameter übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISING` in der Konstruktordefinition und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` im Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_validated_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_z_invalid_id.
    METHODS get_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validated_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF iv_id IS INITIAL OR STRLEN( iv_id ) < 3.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_invalid_id
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_z_invalid_id=>id_too_short
          id      = iv_id.
    ENDIF.
    mv_id = iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_id.
    rv_id = mv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_invalid_id DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF id_too_short,
        msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG', " Replace with actual message class
        msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '004',
        attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'ID',
        attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr4 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
      END OF id_too_short.
    DATA id TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        id TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_invalid_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->id = id.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = id_too_short.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_id RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_id.
    DATA(lo_obj) = NEW zcl_validated_object( 'ABC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj->get_id( ) exp = 'ABC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_id.
    DATA(lv_caught_id) = ''.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_obj) = NEW zcl_validated_object( 'AB' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_z_invalid_id was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_z_invalid_id INTO DATA(lx_invalid).
        lv_caught_id = lx_invalid->id.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_caught_id exp = 'AB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Auslösen von Ausnahmen im Konstruktor ist eine bewährte Methode, um die Erstellung ungültiger Objekte zu verhindern. Dies stellt sicher, dass ein Objekt immer in einem gültigen Zustand ist, nachdem es erfolgreich instanziiert wurde.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Constructor, Object Orientation, Validation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen als String erhält. Die Methode soll alle Zeilen zurückgeben, bei denen das angegebene Feld einen nicht-initialen Wert hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS_LINE>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <FS_LINE> TO <FS_FIELD>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_non_initial
      IMPORTING
        it_table    TYPE any TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_non_initial.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_type_conflict.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA rt_filtered_table LIKE it_table.
    ASSIGN rt_filtered_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_filtered_table>).

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_component_not_found.
      ENDIF.

      IF <fs_field> IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_filtered_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_invalid_field RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_success.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE ty_data_tab(
      ( id = 1 name = 'A' value = 'X' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'B' value = '' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'C' value = 'Y' )
      ( id = 4 name = 'D' value = '' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_dynamic_field( ).

Wenn eine Fluggesellschaft nicht existiert, soll eine spezifische Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, aber die Verarbeitung der anderen Fluggesellschaften fortgesetzt werden.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count,
           ty_flight_count_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_error_info,
           ty_error_info_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_error_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS:
      get_flight_counts
        IMPORTING
          it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
        EXPORTING
          et_flight_counts TYPE ty_flight_count_tab
          et_errors        TYPE ty_error_info_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    LOOP AT it_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      TRY.
          SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_count).
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_flight_not_found
              EXPORTING
                textid = cx_z_flight_not_found=>flight_not_exist
                carrid = lv_carrid.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = lv_carrid count = lv_count ) TO et_flight_counts.
        CATCH cx_z_flight_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
          APPEND VALUE ty_error_info( carrid = lv_carrid message = lx_not_found->get_text( ) ) TO et_errors.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_flight_not_found DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF flight_not_exist,
        msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZMSG', " Replace with actual message class
        msgno TYPE symsgno VALUE '002',
        attr1 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'CARRID',
        attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
        attr4 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',
      END OF flight_not_exist.
    DATA carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cx_z_flight_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->carrid = carrid.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = flight_not_exist.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und eine Liste von Feldnamen erhält. Die Methode soll eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die nur die angegebenen Felder enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS project_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
        it_field_names  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_projected_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_fields.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_table> TYPE any TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_table> TYPE any TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_type_conflict.
    ENDIF.

    IF it_source_table IS INITIAL.
      " Handle empty table case, create empty table of generic type
      CREATE DATA rr_projected_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get type of source table line
    DATA(lr_source_line_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table>[1] ).
    DATA(lt_components) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lr_source_line_type )->get_components( ).

    " Build new structure type for projected table
    DATA lt_new_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = lv_field_name.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_component_not_found.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_new_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lr_new_struct_type) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_new_components ).
    DATA(lr_new_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lr_new_struct_type ).

    CREATE DATA rr_projected_table TYPE HANDLE lr_new_table_type.
    ASSIGN rr_projected_table->* TO <fs_projected_table>.

    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_projected_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_new_struct_type.
      ASSIGN lr_projected_line->* TO <fs_projected_line>.

      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Should not happen due to earlier check
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_projected_field>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Should not happen
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        <fs_projected_field> = <fs_source_field>.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_projected_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen erhält. Die Methode soll den Wert des angegebenen Feldes in allen Zeilen auf einen neuen Wert setzen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_field_in_table
      IMPORTING
        ct_table      TYPE any TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE any
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_type_conflict.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_component_not_found.
      ENDIF.

      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = lx_conv->textid
              previous = lx_conv.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen erhält. Die Methode soll den maximalen Wert dieses Feldes zurückgeben. Das Feld muss numerisch sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS_LINE>`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <FS_FIELD>` und `GET REFERENCE OF` für den Vergleich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_max_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_value
      IMPORTING
        it_table      TYPE any TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        cx_z_table_empty.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_max_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_type_conflict.
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_table> IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_table_empty
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_z_table_empty=>table_is_empty.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_first_iteration) = abap_true.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_component_not_found.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lr_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> ).
      IF lr_type_descr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num
         AND lr_type_descr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed
         AND lr_type_descr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float
         AND lr_type_descr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>not_numeric.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_first_iteration = abap_true.
        rv_max_value = <fs_field>.
        lv_first_iteration = abap_false.
      ELSE.
        IF <fs_field> > rv_max_value.
          rv_max_value = <fs_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Fluggesellschaft und eine Flugnummer erhält. Die Methode soll versuchen, den Preis des Fluges aus `SFLIGHT` zu lesen. Wenn der Preis nicht numerisch ist (was in `SFLIGHT` unwahrscheinlich ist, aber zur Demonstration), soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und eine `TRY...CATCH` Block für die Zuweisung, um `CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      get_flight_price
        IMPORTING
          iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
          iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price
        RAISING
          cx_z_flight_not_found
          cx_sy_conversion_no_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_z_flight_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_z_flight_not_found=>flight_not_exist
          carrid = iv_carrid
          connid = iv_connid.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        rv_price = ls_sflight-price.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_no_number
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_conv->textid
            previous = lx_conv.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
