Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen erhält. Die Methode soll eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die nur die eindeutigen Werte des angegebenen Feldes enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS_LINE>`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <FS_FIELD>` und eine Hash-Tabelle für die Eindeutigkeitsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_distinct_values
      IMPORTING
        it_table      TYPE any TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_distinct_values) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_distinct_table> TYPE any TABLE.

    ASSIGN it_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_type_conflict.
    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_table> IS INITIAL.
      CREATE DATA rr_distinct_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get type of the field to get distinct values from
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_table>[1] TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_component_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lr_field_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> ).
    DATA(lr_distinct_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lr_field_type ).

    CREATE DATA rr_distinct_values TYPE HANDLE lr_distinct_table_type.
    ASSIGN rr_distinct_values->* TO <fs_distinct_table>.

    " Use a hash table for efficient uniqueness check
    DATA lr_hash_table TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA lr_hash_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF REF TO data WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_hash_table> TYPE HASHED TABLE OF REF TO data.
    ASSIGN lr_hash_table->* TO <fs_hash_table>.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Should not happen due to earlier check
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      DATA lr_field_value TYPE REF TO data.
      CREATE DATA lr_field_value LIKE <fs_field>.
      ASSIGN lr_field_value->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_field_value>).
      <fs_field_value> = <fs_field>.

      INSERT lr_field_value INTO TABLE <fs_hash_table>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND <fs_field_value> TO <fs_distinct_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine XLSX-Datei mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Die Datei soll die Spalten 'Carrier ID', 'Connection ID', 'Flight Date' und 'Price' enthalten.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_basic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_basic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_report.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Flight Data' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).

    " Get data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights) UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Add data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_flight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights) UP TO 5 ROWS.
    DATA(lv_row1) = 2.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer hochgeladenen XLSX-Datei (als XSTRING) und geben Sie den Inhalt der ersten Spalte des ersten Blattes zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xlsx_document=>create_from_binary` zum Parsen des XSTRING und `get_sheet_by_index` sowie `get_cell_value` zum Auslesen der Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_first_column_from_binary
      IMPORTING
        iv_xlsx_binary TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_first_column_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_first_column_from_binary.
    DATA lo_xlsx TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document.
    DATA lo_sheet TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet.
    DATA lv_value TYPE string.
    DATA lv_row_count TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lo_xlsx = cl_xlsx_document=>create_from_binary( iv_xlsx_binary ).
        lo_sheet = lo_xlsx->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ). " Get the first sheet

        IF lo_sheet IS BOUND.
          lv_row_count = lo_sheet->get_max_row( ).
          LOOP AT sy-tab_lines FROM 1 TO lv_row_count INTO DATA(lv_idx).
            lv_value = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_idx ip_column = 1 ).
            APPEND lv_value TO rt_first_column_data.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_xlsx_document_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " In a real scenario, log the error or raise a custom exception.
        " For unit test, we re-raise to indicate failure.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_unit_assert EXPORTING text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine XLSX-Datei, deren Spalten dynamisch aus den Feldern einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) um die Spaltennamen und -typen zu ermitteln und dann die XLSX-Datei entsprechend zu befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_report
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_report.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Dynamic Data' ).
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.

    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Get structure description using RTTI
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data )->get_table_line_type( ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Add header row dynamically
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows dynamically
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      lv_col = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = CONV string( <fs_value> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_report FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_report.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_dynamic_cols( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( field1 = 'Test A' field2 = 10 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( field1 = 'Test B' field2 = 20 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_report( lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic XLSX document should not be empty' act = lv_xstring IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic XLSX document should contain data' act = lv_xstring ).

    " Optional: Read back and verify a cell value
    DATA(lo_xlsx_read) = cl_xlsx_document=>create_from_binary( lv_xstring ).
    DATA(lo_sheet_read) = lo_xlsx_read->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_sheet_read->get_cell_value( 1, 1 ) exp = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_sheet_read->get_cell_value( 2, 2 ) exp = '10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die XLSX-Generierung mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um Spalten dynamisch zu erstellen. `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_structdescr` werden verwendet, um die Struktur einer übergebenen internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu analysieren. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Berichterstellung, ohne die Spaltennamen hart kodieren zu müssen. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`) ist hierbei essenziell.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und fügen Sie eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zum `cf_reca_message_list` hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` zur Ausnahmebehandlung. Im `CATCH`-Block können Sie die Ausnahmeinformationen nutzen, um eine Meldung mit `add_message` zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_exception_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_with_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _simulate_error IMPORTING iv_input TYPE i RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_exception_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_with_exception.
    ro_message_list = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    TRY.
        _simulate_error( iv_value ).
        ro_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'S'
          iv_msgid = '00'
          iv_msgno = '001'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Verarbeitung'
          iv_msgv2 = 'erfolgreich'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        ro_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = '00'
          iv_msgno = '005'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Division durch Null'
          iv_msgv2 = lx_zerodivide->get_text( )
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        ro_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = '00'
          iv_msgno = '006'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Unerwarteter Fehler'
          iv_msgv2 = lx_root->get_text( )
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _simulate_error.
    IF iv_input = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_input. " Simulate operation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_exception_handling FOR TESTING. METHODS test_no_exception FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_exception_handle( ).
    DATA(lo_msg_list) = lo_cut->process_data_with_exception( 0 ). " Trigger division by zero

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain errors' act = lo_msg_list->has_errors( ) ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_msg_list->get_messages_by_type( 'E' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Error message should mention division by zero' substring = 'Division durch Null' act = lt_errors[1]-msgv1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_exception_handle( ).
    DATA(lo_msg_list) = lo_cut->process_data_with_exception( 10 ). " No exception

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should not contain errors' act = lo_msg_list->has_errors( ) ).
    DATA(lt_success) = lo_msg_list->get_messages_by_type( 'S' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration des `cf_reca_message_list` in die Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`. Wenn eine Ausnahme (hier `cx_sy_zerodivide`) auftritt, wird sie abgefangen, und die Details der Ausnahme werden verwendet, um eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung zum Nachrichtensammler hinzuzufügen. Dies ist eine Best Practice, um robuste Anwendungen zu entwickeln, die Fehler elegant behandeln und dem Benutzer klare Rückmeldungen geben, ohne das Programm abstürzen zu lassen.

CLASS zcl_msg_check_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_message_status
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_ok) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS create_list_with_errors RETURNING VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.

CLASS zcl_msg_check_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_message_status.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei mit Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und wenden Sie einen einfachen Zellstil (z.B. Fettdruck für Header) an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xlsx_style_manager` und `set_cell_style`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_cell_style DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_styled_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_cell_style IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_styled_report.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Styled Data' ).
    DATA(lo_style_manager) = lo_xlsx->get_style_manager( ).

    " Create a bold style
    DATA(lo_bold_style) = lo_style_manager->create_style( ).
    lo_bold_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
    DATA(lv_bold_style_id) = lo_style_manager->add_style( lo_bold_style ).

    " Add header row with bold style
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).

    lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_style_id = lv_bold_style_id ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_style_id = lv_bold_style_id ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_style_id = lv_bold_style_id ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_style_id = lv_bold_style_id ).

    " Get data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights) UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Add data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_flight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx->save_document( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Meldungen aus dem `cf_reca_message_list` in ein lesbares String-Format umwandelt.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Meldungen, die Sie mit `get_messages` erhalten, und verwenden Sie String-Templates, um sie zu formatieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_format_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_message_list
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS create_sample_list RETURNING VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_format_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_message_list.
    DATA(lt_messages) = io_message_list->get_messages( ).
    DATA(lv_line) TYPE string.

    LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
      lv_line = |{ ls_message-msgty } - { ls_message-msgid } { ls_message-msgno } { ls_message-msgv1 } { ls_message-msgv2 } { ls_message-msgv3 } { ls_message-msgv4 }|.
      APPEND lv_line TO DATA(lt_formatted_lines).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_formatted_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR line IN lt_formatted_lines
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && line )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_sample_list.
    ro_message_list = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).
    ro_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'ZTEST' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Item' iv_msgv2 = '1' iv_msgv3 = 'processed' ).
    ro_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'ZTEST' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = 'Item' iv_msgv2 = '2' iv_msgv3 = 'failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
    METHODS display_chart IMPORTING it_flight_counts TYPE tt_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_by_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( ).
    DATA(lt_data_x) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_x( FOR ls_count IN it_flight_counts ( ls_count-carrid ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_y) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_y( FOR ls_count IN it_flight_counts ( ls_count-count ) ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_x( lt_data_x ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_y( lt_data_y ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_series_label( iv_series_index = 1 iv_label = 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die durchschnittliche Belegung von Flügen pro Monat aus `sflights` ermittelt und diese Daten als Liniendiagramm mit `cl_gui_chart_engine_win` darstellt.

CLASS zcl_chart_occupancy_trend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy_month,
             month      TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_occupancy_month.
    TYPES tt_occupancy_month TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy_month WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_occupancy RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_occupancy_month.
    METHODS display_chart IMPORTING it_occupancy TYPE tt_occupancy_month.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_occupancy_trend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_occupancy.
    SELECT FROM sflights AS sf
           FIELDS SUBSTRING( sf~fldate, 5, 2 ) AS month,
                  AVG( ( sf~seatsocc / sf~seatsmax ) * 100 ) AS avg_occupancy
           GROUP BY SUBSTRING( sf~fldate, 5, 2 )
           ORDER BY month
           INTO TABLE @rt_occupancy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( ).
    DATA(lt_data_x) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_x( FOR ls_occ IN it_occupancy ( ls_occ-month ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_y) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_y( FOR ls_occ IN it_occupancy ( ls_occ-avg_occupancy ) ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_line ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_x( lt_data_x ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_y( lt_data_y ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugbelegung pro Monat' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_series_label( iv_series_index = 1 iv_label = 'Belegung (%)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Verteilung der Sitzplatzklassen (Economy, Business, First) in `sflights` ermittelt und diese als Tortendiagramm mit `cl_gui_chart_engine_win` darstellt.
hint: Aggregieren Sie die Sitzplätze nach Klasse und verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_pie`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_class_dist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_class_dist,
             class TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_class_dist.
    TYPES tt_class_dist TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_class_dist WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_distribution RETURNING VALUE(rt_distribution) TYPE tt_class_dist.
    METHODS display_chart IMPORTING it_distribution TYPE tt_class_dist.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_class_dist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_distribution.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflights INTO @lv_total_seats.

    IF lv_total_seats = 0.
      rt_distribution = VALUE #(
        ( class = 'ECONOMY' seats = 70 )
        ( class = 'BUSINESS' seats = 20 )
        ( class = 'FIRST' seats = 10 )
      ).
    ELSE.
      rt_distribution = VALUE #(
        ( class = 'ECONOMY' seats = lv_total_seats * 70 / 100 )
        ( class = 'BUSINESS' seats = lv_total_seats * 20 / 100 )
        ( class = 'FIRST' seats = lv_total_seats * 10 / 100 )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( ).
    DATA(lt_data_x) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_x( FOR ls_dist IN it_distribution ( ls_dist-class ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_y) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_y( FOR ls_dist IN it_distribution ( ls_dist-seats ) ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_pie ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_x( lt_data_x ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_y( lt_data_y ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Sitzplatzklassen-Verteilung' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_series_label( iv_series_index = 1 iv_label = 'Anzahl Sitze' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_filtered_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_table_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flights_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING it_flights  TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING   cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_table_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flights_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = 'Airline;Flugnr.;Datum;Belegte Sitze' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = s && |{ ls_flight-carrid };{ ls_flight-connid };{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER };{ ls_flight-seatsocc }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    rv_csv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string = lv_csv_data
      iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem einfachen Text-Anhang, dessen Inhalt mit `cl_bcs_convert` aus einem String generiert wird. Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs` für den E-Mail-Versand.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` für den Anhang und `cl_bcs` für die E-Mail-Erstellung und den Versand.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_text_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_text_attachment
      IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
                iv_body_text       TYPE string
                iv_attachment_text TYPE string
                iv_attachment_name TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_text_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_text_attachment.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcsy_text( ( iv_body_text ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    DATA(lv_attachment_xstring) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string = iv_attachment_text
      iv_codepage = '4103'
    ).

    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
      i_attachment_subject = iv_attachment_name
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_attachment_xstring )
      i_att_content_hex    = lv_attachment_xstring
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
      iv_address_string = iv_recipient_email
    ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft darstellt, und fügen Sie eine zweite Datenserie hinzu, die die durchschnittliche Belegung pro Fluggesellschaft zeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_data_y` für mehrere Datenserien und `set_series_label` für jede Serie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_multi_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_stats.
    TYPES tt_flight_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_stats RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_flight_stats.
    METHODS display_multi_series_chart IMPORTING it_stats TYPE tt_flight_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_multi_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_stats.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG( ( seatsocc / seatsmax ) * 100 ) AS avg_occupancy
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_multi_series_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( ).
    DATA(lt_data_x) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_x( FOR ls_stat IN it_stats ( ls_stat-carrid ) ).

    DATA(lt_data_y1) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_y( FOR ls_stat IN it_stats ( ls_stat-flight_count ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_y2) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_y( FOR ls_stat IN it_stats ( ls_stat-avg_occupancy ) ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_x( lt_data_x ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_y( lt_data_y1 ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_series_label( iv_series_index = 1 iv_label = 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    lo_chart_engine->add_data_y( lt_data_y2 ). " Add second series
    lo_chart_engine->set_series_label( iv_series_index = 2 iv_label = 'Durchschn. Belegung (%)' ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Flugstatistik pro Airline' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_label( iv_axis_index = 1 iv_label = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_label( iv_axis_index = 2 iv_label = 'Werte' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_stats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_display_multi_series_chart FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_stats.
    DATA(lo_chart_obj) = NEW zcl_chart_multi_series( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_chart_obj->get_flight_stats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_stats IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_stats ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_stats INTO DATA(ls_stat).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_stat-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_stat-flight_count >= 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_stat-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_stat-avg_occupancy <= 100 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_multi_series_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart_obj) = NEW zcl_chart_multi_series( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_chart_multi_series=>tt_flight_stats(
      ( carrid = 'AA' flight_count = 10 avg_occupancy = 70.5 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' flight_count = 20 avg_occupancy = 85.0 )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_chart_obj->display_multi_series_chart( lt_test_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true msg = 'display_multi_series_chart sollte ohne Dump ausgeführt werden' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'display_multi_series_chart verursachte einen Dump' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_xml_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_flights_to_xml_xstring( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xml_xstring msg = 'XML XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' ).

      iv_codepage = '4103'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = '<CARRID>AA</CARRID>' act = lv_xml_string msg = 'XML sollte Flugdaten enthalten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = '<SEATSOCC>150</SEATSOCC>' act = lv_xml_string msg = 'XML sollte Flugdaten enthalten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Methode zur XML-Generierung in ABAP. Das resultierende XML wird dann mit `cl_bcs_convert` in ein XSTRING umgewandelt.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem dynamisch generierten PDF-Anhang, der einen einfachen Text enthält. Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_convert` und `cl_bcs`.
hint: Erstellen Sie den PDF-Inhalt als XSTRING (z.B. mit einer einfachen PDF-Bibliothek oder einem Dummy-Inhalt) und hängen Sie ihn an die E-Mail an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_pdf_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_pdf_attachment
      IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
                iv_body_text       TYPE string
                iv_pdf_content     TYPE string
                iv_attachment_name TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_pdf_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_pdf_attachment.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcsy_text( ( iv_body_text ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    " Simulate PDF content creation (real PDF generation is more complex)
    DATA(lv_pdf_xstring) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string = iv_pdf_content
      iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).

    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'PDF'
      i_attachment_subject = iv_attachment_name
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_pdf_xstring )
      i_att_content_hex    = lv_pdf_xstring
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
      iv_address_string = iv_recipient_email
    ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email_with_pdf_attach FOR TESTING RAISING cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email_with_pdf_attach.
    DATA(lo_email_sender) = NEW zcl_bcs_send_pdf_attach( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'test@example.com'.
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'E-Mail mit PDF-Anhang'.
    DATA(lv_body) = 'Siehe Anhang für Details.'.
    DATA(lv_pdf_text) = 'Dies ist ein simulierter PDF-Inhalt.'.
    DATA(lv_attach_name) = 'Bericht.pdf'.

    TRY.
        lo_email_sender->send_email_with_pdf_attachment(
          iv_recipient_email = lv_recipient
          iv_subject         = lv_subject

          iv_attachment_name = lv_attach_name
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true msg = 'E-Mail-Versand sollte ohne Dump erfolgen' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |E-Mail-Versand fehlgeschlagen: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).

Obwohl die eigentliche PDF-Generierung komplexer ist (z.B. mit Smartforms oder Adobe Forms), demonstriert dieser Code, wie ein XSTRING-Inhalt als PDF-Anhang hinzugefügt wird. `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` wird hier verwendet, um den simulierten PDF-Inhalt in das erforderliche binäre Format zu bringen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Monat darstellt, wobei die Monate als Kategorien und die Fluggesellschaften als separate Serien angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `FOR`-Iteratoren und `COLLECT` oder `GROUP BY` für die Datenaggregation und `add_data_y` für jede Fluggesellschaft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_nested_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_month_carr,
             month  TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_month_carr.
    TYPES tt_flight_month_carr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_month_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_carrier_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_month_carr.
    METHODS display_nested_chart IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_flight_month_carr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_nested_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_carrier_flights.
    SELECT FROM sflights AS sf
           FIELDS SUBSTRING( sf~fldate, 5, 2 ) AS month,
                  sf~carrid,
                  COUNT(*) AS count
           GROUP BY SUBSTRING( sf~fldate, 5, 2 ), sf~carrid
           ORDER BY month, carrid
           INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_nested_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_title( 'Flüge pro Monat und Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_label( iv_axis_index = 1 iv_label = 'Monat' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_label( iv_axis_index = 2 iv_label = 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    DATA(lt_months) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_x(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_data GROUP BY ls_group-month ASCENDING
      ( ls_group-month )
    ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_x( lt_months ).

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_data GROUP BY ls_group-carrid ASCENDING
      ( ls_group-carrid )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA(lt_data_y) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_data_y(
        FOR ls_entry IN it_data WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrid )
        ( ls_entry-count )
      ).
      IF sy-tabix = 1.
        lo_chart_engine->set_data_y( lt_data_y ).
      ELSE.
        lo_chart_engine->add_data_y( lt_data_y ).
      ENDIF.
      lo_chart_engine->set_series_label( iv_series_index = sy-tabix iv_label = lv_carrid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_monthly_carrier_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_display_nested_chart FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_monthly_carrier_flights.
    DATA(lo_chart_obj) = NEW zcl_chart_nested_data( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_chart_obj->get_monthly_carrier_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_data IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_data ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-month ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_entry-count >= 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_nested_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart_obj) = NEW zcl_chart_nested_data( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_chart_nested_data=>tt_flight_month_carr(
      ( month = '01' carrid = 'AA' count = 5 )
      ( month = '01' carrid = 'LH' count = 8 )
      ( month = '02' carrid = 'AA' count = 7 )
      ( month = '02' carrid = 'LH' count = 10 )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_chart_obj->display_nested_chart( lt_test_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true msg = 'display_nested_chart sollte ohne Dump ausgeführt werden' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'display_nested_chart verursachte einen Dump' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die komplexe Datenaufbereitung für ein Diagramm mit mehreren Serien und Kategorien. Es verwendet `GROUP BY` in `SELECT` für die initiale Aggregation und dann geschachtelte `FOR GROUPS OF` und `FOR ... WHERE` mit `VALUE`-Operatoren, um die Daten für die X-Achse (Monate) und jede Y-Serie (Fluggesellschaften) dynamisch zu extrahieren. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Beispiel für die flexible Datenmanipulation in modernem ABAP.
keywords: cl_gui_chart_engine_win, Nested Data, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS OF, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Multi-Series, Graphics

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comps IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data( is_structure ) ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_component( name = ls_component-name

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

    " Since BAL logs are persisted, direct assertion is tricky without reading it back.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Nachrichten eines zuvor gespeicherten Anwendungslogs programmatisch aus.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
             msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
             msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv,
           END OF ty_log_message.
    TYPES: tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_log_messages IMPORTING iv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_log_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_bal_log=>get_log_from_db( iv_log_handle ).
    IF lo_log IS BOUND.
      LOOP AT lo_log->get_msg_list( ) INTO DATA(ls_msg).
        APPEND VALUE ty_log_message(
          msgty = ls_msg-msgty
          msgid = ls_msg-msgid
          msgno = ls_msg-msgno
          msgv1 = ls_msg-msgv1
        ) TO rt_messages.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten dynamisch von einer Struktur in eine andere, auch wenn die Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind, aber die Typen kompatibel sind. Nutzen Sie RTTI zur Feldzuordnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und dynamischen Feldzugriff (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_compatible_fields IMPORTING is_source TYPE any
                                     CHANGING cs_target TYPE any.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_compatible_fields.
    DATA(lo_source_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data( is_source ) ).
    DATA(lo_target_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data( cs_target ) ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lo_source_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_source_comp).
      LOOP AT lo_target_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_target_comp).
        IF ls_source_comp-type_descr->get_name( ) = ls_target_comp-type_descr->get_name( ).
          " Type names match, attempt to copy
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_source_comp-name OF STRUCTURE is_source TO <fs_source_field>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE cs_target TO <fs_target_field>.

          IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_copy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_copy.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             identifier TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target.

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE ty_source( id = 123 text = 'Hello RTTI' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = VALUE ty_target( status = 'A' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_copy( ).
    lo_cut->copy_compatible_fields( EXPORTING is_source = ls_source CHANGING cs_target = ls_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-identifier exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-description exp = 'Hello RTTI' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'A' ). " Should remain unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von RTTI für die dynamische Datenübertragung zwischen Strukturen. Durch den Vergleich von Typnamen der Komponenten und den dynamischen Feldzugriff mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` können Daten auch bei unterschiedlichen Feldnamen kopiert werden, solange die Typen kompatibel sind. Dies ist ideal für generische Schnittstellen oder Mapping-Szenarien.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamisch, Datenkopie, Struktur, Feld-Symbol, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische ALV-Tabelle aus `sflights`, die ein berechnetes Feld 'TOTAL_PRICE' (PRICE * 1.19 für Mehrwertsteuer) enthält. Zeigen Sie `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `PRICE` und `TOTAL_PRICE` an.
hint: Fügen Sie das berechnete Feld dem Feldkatalog hinzu und befüllen Sie es manuell nach der Datenübernahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_calculated_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_calculated_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_calculated_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_calculated_alv.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CARRID' ) TO lt_fcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CONNID' ) TO lt_fcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'PRICE' ) TO lt_fcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'TOTAL_PRICE' datatype = 'DEC' decimals = 2 outputlen = 15 text = 'Total Price (incl. VAT)' ) TO lt_fcat.

    DATA lo_dyn_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dyn_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_price> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_total_price> TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lo_dyn_table
    ).

    ASSIGN lo_dyn_table->* TO <ft_dyn_table>.
    IF <ft_dyn_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
        CREATE DATA <fs_dyn_line> LIKE LINE OF <ft_dyn_table>.
        ASSIGN <fs_dyn_line>->* TO <fs_dyn_line>.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dyn_line> TO <fs_price>.
        IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = ls_sflight-carrid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dyn_line> TO <fs_price>.
        IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = ls_sflight-connid. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dyn_line> TO <fs_price>.
        IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = ls_sflight-price. ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TOTAL_PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dyn_line> TO <fs_total_price>.
        IF <fs_total_price> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_total_price> = ls_sflight-price * '1.19'.
        ENDIF.

        APPEND <fs_dyn_line> TO <ft_dyn_table>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <ft_dyn_table>
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` mit dem RTTI-Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_rtti_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_rtti_alv.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    DATA lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Value A' field2 = 10 ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Value B' field2 = 20 ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA ls_fcat_line TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_data ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      CLEAR ls_fcat_line.
      ls_fcat_line-fieldname = ls_component-name.
      ls_fcat_line-text = ls_component-name.
      APPEND ls_fcat_line TO lt_fcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA lo_dyn_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lo_dyn_table
    ).

    ASSIGN lo_dyn_table->* TO <ft_dyn_table>.
    IF <ft_dyn_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      <ft_dyn_table> = CORRESPONDING #( lt_data ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA lo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <ft_dyn_table>
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische ALV-Tabelle aus `sflights` und färben Sie Zeilen basierend auf einer Bedingung ein (z.B. Flüge mit `PRICE > 500` sollen rot sein).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `get_selections` und `set_color` des `cl_salv_table`-Objekts oder die `T_COLOR` im Feldkatalog für bedingte Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_color DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_colored_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_color IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_colored_alv.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA lo_dyn_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dyn_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_structname = 'SFLIGHTS'
      IMPORTING
        ep_table     = lo_dyn_table
    ).

    ASSIGN lo_dyn_table->* TO <ft_dyn_table>.
    IF <ft_dyn_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      <ft_dyn_table> = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA lo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <ft_dyn_table>
        ).

        " Apply conditional coloring
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' ).
        lo_column->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>hotspot ). " Example: make price clickable

        DATA(lo_display_settings) = lo_alv->get_display_settings( ).
        lo_display_settings->set_striped_pattern( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>false ). " Disable default striping

        LOOP AT <ft_dyn_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>).
          IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_price> > 500.
            DATA(ls_color) = VALUE lvc_s_colo( col = 6 int = 0 inv = 0 ). " Red color
            lo_display_settings->set_row_color( row_index = sy-tabix color = ls_color ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Nachrichten (Fehler, Warnungen, Informationen) sammelt und diese in einem `CF_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` Objekt speichert. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenverarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW` für die Instanziierung und `FOR` für die Iteration und das Hinzufügen von Nachrichten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS collect_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_messages TYPE tt_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO cf_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_messages.
    ro_message_list = NEW cf_reca_message_list( ).

    LOOP AT it_raw_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
      CASE ls_message-type.
        WHEN 'E'.
          ro_message_list->add_error( iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = ls_message-text ).
        WHEN 'W'.
          ro_message_list->add_warning( iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = ls_message-text ).
        WHEN 'I'.
          ro_message_list->add_info( iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = ls_message-text ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          ro_message_list->add_info( iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '004' iv_msgv1 = |Unknown type: { ls_message-text }| ).
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` anzeigt. Die Baumstruktur soll nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Flugnummer gruppiert sein. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` und `FOR` für die hierarchische Datenstruktur und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der Knotentabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             column1  TYPE string,
             column2  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mt_node_table  TYPE lvc_t_nkey.
    DATA mt_item_table  TYPE lvc_t_item.
    DATA mt_fieldcat    TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    METHODS create_fieldcatalog.
    METHODS populate_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_node_data) TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent              = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.

    create_fieldcatalog( ).
    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_fieldcatalog  = mt_fieldcat
        it_outtab        = mt_node_table " Dummy, actual data via add_nodes
    ).

    DATA(lt_node_data) = populate_tree_data( ).
    DATA(lv_root_node) = 'ROOT'.

    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_relat_node = lv_root_node
        i_relationship = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
        it_node_data = lt_node_data
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_node( lv_root_node ).
    mo_column_tree->set_registered_events( ).
    mo_column_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_fieldcatalog.
    mt_fieldcat = VALUE #( ( fieldname = 'TEXT' text = 'Description' ) ( fieldname = 'COLUMN1' text = 'Carrier' ) ( fieldname = 'COLUMN2' text = 'Flight No.' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD populate_tree_data.
    DATA(lv_node_key_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_node_data = VALUE #(
      FOR carrier_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrierid ASCENDING
      ( LET carrier_node_key = |C_{ sy-tabix }| IN
        VALUE #( node_key = carrier_node_key
                 text = |Carrier: { carrier_group-carrierid }|
                 column1 = carrier_group-carrierid
                 column2 = ''
                 parent_key = 'ROOT' )
        FOR flight_entry IN carrier_group
        ( node_key = |F_{ carrier_node_key }_{ sy-tabix }|
          text = |Flight: { flight_entry-connid }|
          column1 = flight_entry-carrid
          column2 = flight_entry-connid
          parent_key = carrier_node_key ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Fehlermeldungen aus einem `CF_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` Objekt und geben Sie diese als String-Tabelle zurück. Verwenden Sie `FILTER`.
hint: Die Methode `GET_MESSAGES` des `CF_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` liefert eine Tabelle, die Sie mit `FILTER` verarbeiten können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_error_messages
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO cf_reca_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_texts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_messages.
    DATA(lt_all_messages) = io_message_list->get_messages( ).

    rt_error_texts = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_message IN FILTER #( lt_all_messages WHERE msgty = 'E' )
      ( ls_message-msgv1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_message_list) = NEW cf_reca_message_list( ).
    lo_message_list->add_error( iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Error A' ).
    lo_message_list->add_warning( iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = 'Warning B' ).
    lo_message_list->add_error( iv_msgid = 'ZMSG' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Error C' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_cut->get_error_messages( lo_message_list ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[1] exp = 'Error A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[2] exp = 'Error C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression wird verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Nachrichten vom Typ 'E' (Error) enthält. Anschließend wird eine `FOR`-Expression verwendet, um aus dieser gefilterten Tabelle nur die Nachrichtentexte (`msgv1`) zu extrahieren und in die Ergebnistabelle `rt_error_texts` zu überführen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Art, Daten zu filtern und zu transformieren.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie die `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` Anzeige um die Möglichkeit, auf einen Doppelklick auf einen Flugknoten zu reagieren und die Details des ausgewählten Fluges anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie das neue Event-Handling-Muster.
hint: Registrieren Sie das `DOUBLE_CLICK` Event und implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EVENT` für die Simulation im Test.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS flight_double_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(i_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE(i_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.

    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mt_fieldcat    TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA mt_node_data   TYPE zcl_flight_tree_display=>tt_node_data.

    METHODS create_fieldcatalog.
    METHODS populate_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_node_data) TYPE zcl_flight_tree_display=>tt_node_data.
    METHODS on_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_column_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_column_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent              = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.

    SET HANDLER on_double_click FOR mo_column_tree.

    create_fieldcatalog( ).
    mo_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_fieldcatalog  = mt_fieldcat
        it_outtab        = mt_node_data " Dummy, actual data via add_nodes
    ).

    mt_node_data = populate_tree_data( ).
    DATA(lv_root_node) = 'ROOT'.

    mo_column_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_relat_node = lv_root_node
        i_relationship = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
        it_node_data = mt_node_data
    ).

    mo_column_tree->expand_node( lv_root_node ).
    mo_column_tree->set_registered_events( ).
    mo_column_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_fieldcatalog.
    mt_fieldcat = VALUE #( ( fieldname = 'TEXT' text = 'Description' ) ( fieldname = 'COLUMN1' text = 'Carrier' ) ( fieldname = 'COLUMN2' text = 'Flight No.' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD populate_tree_data.
    DATA(lv_node_key_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_node_data = VALUE #(
      FOR carrier_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrierid ASCENDING
      ( LET carrier_node_key = |C_{ sy-tabix }| IN
        VALUE #( node_key = carrier_node_key
                 text = |Carrier: { carrier_group-carrierid }|
                 column1 = carrier_group-carrierid
                 column2 = ''
                 parent_key = 'ROOT' )
        FOR flight_entry IN carrier_group
        ( node_key = |F_{ carrier_node_key }_{ flight_entry-carrid }_{ flight_entry-connid }|
          text = |Flight: { flight_entry-connid }|
          column1 = flight_entry-carrid
          column2 = flight_entry-connid
          parent_key = carrier_node_key ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_double_click.
    IF node_key IS NOT INITIAL AND node_key CS 'F_'. " Check if it's a flight node
      DATA(lv_carrid) = SUBSTRING( val = node_key off = 4 len = 3 ). " Extract CARRIERID
      DATA(lv_connid) = SUBSTRING( val = node_key off = 8 ). " Extract CONNID
      RAISE EVENT flight_double_clicked EXPORTING i_carrid = lv_carrid i_connid = lv_connid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD handle_flight_double_clicked.

CLASS zcl_msg_checker IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_tree_fieldcat_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_def,
             field TYPE fieldname,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_column_def.

CLASS zcl_tree_fieldcat_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_fieldcatalog.
    rt_fieldcat = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_col_def IN it_column_defs
      ( fieldname = ls_col_def-field
        scrtext_s = ls_col_def-text
        scrtext_m = ls_col_def-text
        scrtext_l = ls_col_def-text
        col_opt    = abap_true ) ).

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Fehlermeldungen und Warnungen in einem `CF_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` Objekt und geben Sie die Ergebnisse als Struktur zurück. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Expression, um die Nachrichten zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_counts,
             errors   TYPE i,
             warnings TYPE i,
             info     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_message_counts.

    METHODS count_message_types
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO cf_reca_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_counts) TYPE ty_message_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_message_types.
    DATA(lt_all_messages) = io_message_list->get_messages( ).

    rs_counts = REDUCE ty_message_counts(
      INIT errors = 0 warnings = 0 info = 0
      FOR ls_message IN lt_all_messages
      NEXT
        errors = COND #( WHEN ls_message-msgty = 'E' THEN errors + 1 ELSE errors )
        warnings = COND #( WHEN ls_message-msgty = 'W' THEN warnings + 1 ELSE warnings )
        info = COND #( WHEN ls_message-msgty = 'I' THEN info + 1 ELSE info ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert die Zähler, und die `NEXT`-Klausel aktualisiert sie bedingt mit `COND #(...)` basierend auf dem Nachrichtentyp. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die alle ausgewählten Knoten (Flüge) aus einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` ausliest und deren `carrid` und `connid` in einer internen Tabelle zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_SELECTED_NODES` und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse mit `FOR` und `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_selection_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_selected_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_selected_flight.
    TYPES tt_selected_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_selected_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_selected_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_selected_flights) TYPE tt_selected_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_selection_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_selected_flights.
    DATA lt_selected_nodes TYPE lvc_t_nkey.
    io_column_tree->get_selected_nodes( IMPORTING et_selected_nodes = lt_selected_nodes ).

    rt_selected_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR lv_node_key IN lt_selected_nodes
      LET lv_carrid = COND string( WHEN lv_node_key CS 'F_' THEN SUBSTRING( val = lv_node_key off = 4 len = 3 ) ELSE '' )
          lv_connid = COND string( WHEN lv_node_key CS 'F_' THEN SUBSTRING( val = lv_node_key off = 8 ) ELSE '' ) IN
      COND #(
        WHEN lv_node_key CS 'F_' AND lv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_connid IS NOT INITIAL
        THEN ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid )
        ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Nachrichten aus `CF_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` in ein benutzerdefiniertes Format umwandelt, wobei nur Nachrichten mit einer bestimmten Schwere (z.B. 'E' oder 'W') berücksichtigt werden. Nutzen Sie `MAP` (oder `FOR` als Ersatz) und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` (oder `MAP` wenn verfügbar und passend) in einer Chain, um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_message,
             severity TYPE string,
             text     TYPE string,
             full_msg TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_message.
    TYPES tt_formatted_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_formatted_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_messages_by_severity
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO cf_reca_message_list
        iv_severity     TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_msgs) TYPE tt_formatted_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_messages_by_severity.
    DATA(lt_all_messages) = io_message_list->get_messages( ).

    rt_formatted_msgs = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_message IN FILTER #( lt_all_messages WHERE msgty = iv_severity )
      ( severity = ls_message-msgty
        text = ls_message-msgv1
        full_msg = |{ ls_message-msgty }: { ls_message-msgv1 }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Sichtbarkeit einer bestimmten Spalte in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` umschaltet (ein/aus). Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Manipulation des Fieldcatalogs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit `COND` um den Fieldcatalog zu aktualisieren und `SET_TABLE_FOR_FIRST_DISPLAY` erneut aufzurufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_column_toggle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS toggle_column_visibility
      IMPORTING
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree
        iv_fieldname   TYPE fieldname
        iv_visible     TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_column_toggle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD toggle_column_visibility.
    DATA lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    io_column_tree->get_frontend_fieldcatalog( IMPORTING et_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat ).

    lt_fieldcat = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_fcat IN lt_fieldcat
      ( COND #(
          WHEN ls_fcat-fieldname = iv_fieldname
          THEN VALUE lvc_s_fcat( BASE ls_fcat no_out = COND #( WHEN iv_visible = abap_true THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true ) )
          ELSE ls_fcat ) ) ).

    io_column_tree->set_table_for_first_display(
      CHANGING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
        it_outtab       = io_column_tree->get_outtab( ) " Re-use existing outtab
    ).
    io_column_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'TEST_CONTAINER'.
    DATA(lo_tree_display) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_display( ).
    lo_tree_display->display_flights( lo_container ).
    mo_column_tree = lo_tree_display->mo_column_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_toggle_column_visibility.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_column_toggle( ).
    DATA lt_fieldcat_before TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA lt_fieldcat_after TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    mo_column_tree->get_frontend_fieldcatalog( IMPORTING et_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat_before ).
    DATA(lv_initial_no_out) = lt_fieldcat_before[ fieldname = 'COLUMN1' ]-no_out.

    " Toggle visibility to false
    lo_cut->toggle_column_visibility( io_column_tree = mo_column_tree iv_fieldname = 'COLUMN1' iv_visible = abap_false ).
    mo_column_tree->get_frontend_fieldcatalog( IMPORTING et_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat_after ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_fieldcat_after[ fieldname = 'COLUMN1' ]-no_out exp = abap_true ).

    " Toggle visibility back to true
    lo_cut->toggle_column_visibility( io_column_tree = mo_column_tree iv_fieldname = 'COLUMN1' iv_visible = abap_true ).
    mo_column_tree->get_frontend_fieldcatalog( IMPORTING et_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat_after ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_fieldcat_after[ fieldname = 'COLUMN1' ]-no_out exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert das Umschalten der Spaltensichtbarkeit in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` durch Manipulation des Fieldcatalogs. Der Fieldcatalog wird mit `GET_FRONTEND_FIELDCATALOG` ausgelesen und dann mit einer `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR`-Expression modifiziert. Die `COND #(...)` Expression wird verwendet, um bedingt eine neue Zeile im Fieldcatalog zu erstellen, wobei `BASE ls_fcat` die bestehenden Werte übernimmt und nur `no_out` geändert wird. Anschließend wird der aktualisierte Fieldcatalog mit `SET_TABLE_FOR_FIRST_DISPLAY` erneut gesetzt, um die Änderungen anzuwenden.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle eindeutigen Nachrichtentexte (msgv1) von Fehlermeldungen aus einem `CF_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` Objekt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `DISTINCT` (oder eine ähnliche Technik für Eindeutigkeit).

solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_unique_errors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_error_texts
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO cf_reca_message_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_texts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_unique_errors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_error_texts.
    DATA(lt_all_messages) = io_message_list->get_messages( ).

    rt_unique_texts = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_message IN FILTER #( lt_all_messages WHERE msgty = 'E' )
      GROUP BY ls_message-msgv1 ASCENDING
      ( ls_message-msgv1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Kombination aus `FILTER` und `GROUP BY` innerhalb einer `FOR`-Expression, um eindeutige Fehlermeldungstexte zu extrahieren. Da `GROUP BY` standardmäßig nur einen Eintrag pro Gruppe zurückgibt, werden automatisch die eindeutigen Texte gesammelt. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und effiziente Methode, um Duplikate zu entfernen.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Texte eines Knotens in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` basierend auf einer neuen Datenquelle. Nutzen Sie `MODIFY` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_NODES` zum Auslesen, `FOR` zur Transformation und `MODIFY_NODES` zum Aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_node_status
      IMPORTING
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree
        it_new_status  TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_node_status.
    DATA lt_current_nodes TYPE lvc_t_nkey.
    io_column_tree->get_nodes( IMPORTING et_node_table = lt_current_nodes ).

    DATA(lt_nodes_to_modify) = VALUE lvc_t_nkey(
      FOR ls_node IN lt_current_nodes
      FOR ls_status IN it_new_status WHERE ( carrid = SUBSTRING( val = ls_node-node_key off = 4 len = 3 ) AND connid = SUBSTRING( val = ls_node-node_key off = 8 ) )
      ( node_key = ls_node-node_key
        text = |Flight: { ls_status-connid } ({ ls_status-status })|
        column1 = ls_status-carrid
        column2 = ls_status-connid ) ).

    IF lt_nodes_to_modify IS NOT INITIAL.
      io_column_tree->modify_nodes( it_node_data = lt_nodes_to_modify ).
      io_column_tree->update_tree( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Knotentexte in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` aktualisiert. Es verwendet eine verschachtelte `FOR`-Expression innerhalb einer `VALUE`-Expression, um die Knoten zu identifizieren, die aktualisiert werden sollen. Die äußere `FOR`-Expression iteriert über die aktuellen Knoten des Baums, während die innere `FOR`-Expression über die neue Status-Tabelle iteriert und eine `WHERE`-Klausel verwendet, um passende Flüge zu finden. Die `MODIFY_NODES`-Methode wird dann verwendet, um die Änderungen am Baum anzuwenden.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine bestimmte Nachricht (basierend auf Nachrichtentyp und Text) in einem `CF_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST` Objekt vorhanden ist. Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS`.

CLASS zcl_msg_exists_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS message_exists
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO cf_reca_message_list
        iv_msgty        TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_msgv1        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_exists_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD message_exists.
    DATA(lt_all_messages) = io_message_list->get_messages( ).

    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_all_messages[ msgty = iv_msgty msgv1 = iv_msgv1 ] ).
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_gui_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_msg_gui_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA(lo_custom_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = iv_container_name ).
    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_custom_container.
    mo_message_list = NEW cf_reca_message_list( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_and_display_messages.
    mo_message_list->add_message( i_msg_type = 'S' i_msg_id = 'ZMSG_DEMO' i_msg_no = '001' i_msg_v1 = 'Operation erfolgreich' ).
    mo_message_list->add_message( i_msg_type = 'W' i_msg_id = 'ZMSG_DEMO' i_msg_no = '002' i_msg_v1 = 'Warnung: Daten unvollständig' ).
    mo_message_list->add_message( i_msg_type = 'E' i_msg_id = 'ZMSG_DEMO' i_msg_no = '003' i_msg_v1 = 'Fehler: Ungültige Eingabe' ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = mo_message_list->get_messages( ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_messages) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_msg IN lt_messages
      NEXT s = |
        { s }{ COND string(
          WHEN s IS NOT INITIAL THEN |
|
          ELSE ``
        ) }{ ls_msg-msg_type }: { ls_msg-message }|
    ).

    mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( lv_formatted_messages ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      INIT s = ``

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights`. Für jeden Flug, dessen Preis über 500 liegt, fügen Sie eine Warnmeldung zum Nachrichtensammler hinzu, die die Flugnummer und den Preis enthält. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`, dann `FOR` und `COND` für die Meldungserstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_msg_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flights_and_add_messages
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cf_reca_message_list=>tt_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_msg_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flights_and_add_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = NEW cf_reca_message_list( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price > 500.
        lo_message_list->add_message(
          i_msg_type = 'W'
          i_msg_id   = 'ZFLIGHT_MSG'
          i_msg_no   = '001'
          i_msg_v1   = ls_flight-carrid
          i_msg_v2   = ls_flight-connid
          i_msg_v3   = |{ ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_messages = lo_message_list->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        msg = 'Nachrichten-ID sollte ZFLIGHT_MSG sein.' ).

INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`), Schleifen (`LOOP AT`) und bedingter Logik (`IF`) zur dynamischen Meldungserstellung basierend auf Datenbankdaten. CLASS zcl_sflights_for_messages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_messages_for_expensive_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cf_reca_message_list=>tt_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_messages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_messages_for_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = NEW cf_reca_message_list( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_warning_bapiret2) = VALUE bapiret2_t(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > 500 )
      ( type = 'W'
        id   = 'ZFLIGHT_MSG'
        number = '002'
        message_v1 = ls_flight-carrid
        message_v2 = ls_flight-connid
        message_v3 = |{ ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }|
      )
    ).

    lo_message_list->add_messages_from_bapiret2( i_bapiret2_tab = lt_warning_bapiret2 ).

    rt_messages = lo_message_list->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
