Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Namen und Typen aller öffentlichen Instanzattribute einer gegebenen ABAP-Klasse zur Laufzeit. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Attributnamen und deren ABAP-Typen sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und die Methode `GET_ATTRIBUTES`. Iterieren Sie über die zurückgegebene Tabelle und extrahieren Sie die relevanten Informationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_instance_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attribute_info) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_unknown_descr_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_instance_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    rt_attribute_info = VALUE #( FOR <ls_attr> IN lt_attributes
                                 WHERE ( visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public AND is_static = abap_false )
                                 ( name = <ls_attr>-name,
                                   type = <ls_attr>-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_attributes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_attributes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_class_attrs( ).
    DATA(lt_attr_info) = lo_cut->get_public_instance_attributes( 'ZCL_RTTI_CLASS_ATTRS' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_attr_info ). "ZCL_RTTI_CLASS_ATTRS has no public instance attributes

    " Test with a class that has public attributes (e.g., CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT)
    DATA(lt_assert_attrs) = lo_cut->get_public_instance_attributes( 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_assert_attrs ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_assert_attrs ) exp = 0 ). " CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT has no public instance attributes, only static methods

    " Let's create a dummy class for testing
    DATA(lv_class_name) = 'ZCL_DUMMY_TEST_CLASS'.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT DATA(lo_dummy_class) TYPE (lv_class_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        " Class might not exist, create it dynamically for test
        DATA(lv_source) = 'CLASS ZCL_DUMMY_TEST_CLASS DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. DATA: mv_value TYPE i. METHODS: get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i. ENDCLASS. CLASS ZCL_DUMMY_TEST_CLASS IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_value. rv_value = mv_value. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.'.
        cl_abap_unit_test_utility=>create_program_and_class( i_program_name = 'Z_TEST_PROG_DUMMY' i_class_name = lv_class_name i_source = lv_source ).
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lt_dummy_attrs) = lo_cut->get_public_instance_attributes( lv_class_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_dummy_attrs ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_dummy_attrs ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_dummy_attrs[ 1 ]-name exp = 'MV_VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_dummy_attrs[ 1 ]-type exp = 'I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklarationen, `VALUE #(...)` für die Konstruktion interner Tabellen und `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` für die Filterung und Transformation von Daten. Dies macht den Code kompakt, lesbar und effizient, da keine expliziten `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen benötigt werden.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR, Attribute, Laufzeit, Dynamisch, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die vollständige Vererbungshierarchie einer gegebenen ABAP-Klasse, beginnend mit der Klasse selbst bis zur Wurzelklasse (z.B. `OBJECT`). Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit den Namen der Klassen in aufsteigender Hierarchie sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und die Methode `GET_SUPER_CLASS` in einer Schleife, bis keine Superklasse mehr gefunden wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_class_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_unknown_descr_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_hierarchy.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lo_current_descr) = CAST cl_abap_objectdescr( lo_class_descr ).

    WHILE lo_current_descr IS BOUND.
      INSERT lo_current_descr->get_relative_name( ) INTO TABLE rt_hierarchy.
      TRY.
          lo_current_descr = lo_current_descr->get_super_class( ).
        CATCH cx_sy_unknown_descr_type.
          " No super class found, end of hierarchy
          CLEAR lo_current_descr.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Reverse the order to get hierarchy from base to derived
    SORT rt_hierarchy BY table_line DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Rufen Sie anschließend eine Methode dieser Instanz dynamisch auf und geben Sie das Ergebnis zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (lv_class_name)` und `CALL METHOD` mit `(lv_method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_instance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_call_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE clike
        iv_method_name TYPE clike
        iv_param_value TYPE i OPTIONAL " Example for a single integer parameter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error
        cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_instance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lv_result_int TYPE i.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    " Prepare parameters for dynamic method call
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
      INSERT VALUE abap_parmbind( name = 'IV_INPUT' kind = abap_parm_input value = REF #( iv_param_value ) ) INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    " Prepare return value for dynamic method call
    DATA lt_return_value TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    INSERT VALUE abap_parmbind( name = 'RV_OUTPUT' kind = abap_parm_returning value = REF #( lv_result_int ) ) INTO TABLE lt_return_value.

    CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
      RECEIVING PARAMETER-TABLE lt_return_value.

    rv_result = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' of class '{ iv_class_name }' returned: { lv_result_int }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein gegebenes Datenobjekt vom Typ einer bestimmten Klasse ist oder von dieser erbt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_type_inheritance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_type_or_subclass_of
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref     TYPE REF TO data
        iv_class_name   TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_related) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_unknown_descr_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_type_inheritance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_type_or_subclass_of.
    DATA(lo_data_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data_ref ).

    IF lo_data_descr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_oref.
      DATA(lo_object_descr) = CAST cl_abap_objectdescr( lo_data_descr ).
      DATA(lo_target_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).

      IF lo_object_descr->get_relative_name( ) = iv_class_name OR
         lo_object_descr->is_subclass_of( lo_target_class_descr ) = abap_true.
        rv_is_related = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine grundlegende Cache-Prüfung für einen simulierten Enterprise Search Connector durch und geben Sie den Status zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` und die Methode `CHECK_CACHE`. Da `S_ESH_ENG_CACHE` ein Strukturtyp ist, simulieren Sie die Eingabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_status,
             connector_id TYPE string,
             status       TYPE string,
             message      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_cache_status.

    METHODS perform_cache_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_connector_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status) TYPE ty_cache_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_cache_check.
    DATA ls_esh_cache_input TYPE s_esh_eng_cache.
    ls_esh_cache_input-connector_id = iv_connector_id.
    " Simulate other relevant fields if necessary for a real scenario

    DATA(lo_cache_checker) = NEW cl_esh_ca_check( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cache_checker->check_cache( EXPORTING is_esh_eng_cache = ls_esh_cache_input ).

    rs_status-connector_id = iv_connector_id.
    IF lt_messages IS INITIAL.
      rs_status-status = 'OK'.
      rs_status-message = 'Cache is consistent.'.
    ELSE.
      rs_status-status = 'ERROR'.
      " Concatenate messages for simplicity
      rs_status-message = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR <ls_msg> IN lt_messages NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <ls_msg>-message ELSE s && |; | && <ls_msg>-message ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_check_basic( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-connector_id exp = 'TEST_CONNECTOR_OK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status exp = 'OK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-message exp = 'Cache is consistent.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cache_with_errors.
    " This test is conceptual as CL_ESH_CA_CHECK->CHECK_CACHE is a real method
    " and its behavior cannot be easily mocked without advanced test doubles.
    " For a real test, one would need to set up an ESH environment or mock the class.
    " Here, we simulate an error by assuming a specific connector ID would trigger an error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_check_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->perform_cache_check( 'TEST_CONNECTOR_ERROR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-connector_id exp = 'TEST_CONNECTOR_ERROR' ).

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_check_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_multi_cache_check.
    DATA(lo_cache_checker) = NEW cl_esh_ca_check( ).

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR lv_connector_id IN it_connector_ids
                            LET ls_esh_cache_input = VALUE s_esh_eng_cache( connector_id = lv_connector_id )
                                lt_messages = lo_cache_checker->check_cache( EXPORTING is_esh_eng_cache = ls_esh_cache_input )

                            IN
                            ( connector_id = lv_connector_id,
                              status       = lv_status,
                              message      = lv_message ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Da `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` keine direkten Zeitstempel für Cache-Einträge liefert, simulieren Sie dies durch eine Annahme. Nutzen Sie moderne Datum/Zeit-Funktionen.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS monitor_cache_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_connector_id TYPE string
        iv_last_update  TYPE timestampl OPTIONAL " Simulated last update timestamp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD monitor_cache_age.
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
    DATA(lv_threshold_days) = 7.
    DATA(lv_threshold_seconds) = lv_threshold_days * 24 * 60 * 60.

    DATA(lv_simulated_last_update) = COND timestampl( WHEN iv_last_update IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_last_update ELSE cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_current_timestamp iv_secs = - ( lv_threshold_seconds + 1 ) ) ).

    DATA(lv_age_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract( iv_tstmp1 = lv_current_timestamp iv_tstmp2 = lv_simulated_last_update ).

    IF lv_age_seconds > lv_threshold_seconds.
      rv_status_message = |WARNING: Cache for connector { iv_connector_id } is considered outdated. Last update: { lv_simulated_last_update } (Age: { lv_age_seconds } seconds).|.
    ELSE.
      rv_status_message = |Cache for connector { iv_connector_id } is up-to-date. Last update: { lv_simulated_last_update } (Age: { lv_age_seconds } seconds).|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_read_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attribute_value
      IMPORTING
        io_object       TYPE REF TO object
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error
        cx_sy_unknown_descr_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_read_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_value.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lt_attributes TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>tt_attribute_descr.
    DATA lv_attribute_exists TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    lt_attributes = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr) WHERE name = iv_attribute_name AND visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public AND is_static = abap_false.
      lv_attribute_exists = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_attribute_exists = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Attribute '{ iv_attribute_name }' not found or not public instance attribute in class '{ lo_class_descr->get_relative_name( ) }'|.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN (io_object->*)-("iv_attribute_name") TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Failed to assign attribute '{ iv_attribute_name }'|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Enterprise Search Connector-IDs akzeptiert und für jeden Connector eine simulierte Cache-Auffrischung durchführt. Geben Sie eine Zusammenfassung der Ergebnisse zurück.
hint: Simulieren Sie die Auffrischung und verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die Ergebnisaggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_refresh_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_refresh_result,
             connector_id TYPE string,
             success      TYPE abap_bool,
             message      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_refresh_result.
    TYPES tt_refresh_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_refresh_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS refresh_caches_and_summarize
      IMPORTING
        it_connector_ids TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_refresh_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD refresh_caches_and_summarize.
    DATA lt_results TYPE tt_refresh_results.

    LOOP AT it_connector_ids INTO DATA(lv_connector_id).
      DATA ls_result TYPE ty_refresh_result.
      ls_result-connector_id = lv_connector_id.

      " Simulate cache refresh logic
      IF lv_connector_id CS 'FAIL'. " Simulate failure for connectors containing 'FAIL'
        ls_result-success = abap_false.
        ls_result-message = |Simulated failure for { lv_connector_id }|.
      ELSE.
        ls_result-success = abap_true.
        ls_result-message = |Simulated success for { lv_connector_id }|.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_result TO lt_results.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_successful_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <ls_res> IN lt_results WHERE ( success = abap_true ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    DATA(lv_failed_count) = lines( lt_results ) - lv_successful_count.

    rs_summary = |Cache refresh summary: { lv_successful_count } successful, { lv_failed_count } failed. | &&
                 REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR <ls_res> IN lt_results
                                WHERE ( success = abap_false )
                                NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <ls_res>-message ELSE s && |; | && <ls_res>-message ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts (z.B. interne Tabelle, Struktur, Elementartyp) zur Laufzeit ermittelt und eine detaillierte Beschreibung zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und die verschiedenen Unterklassen von `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` (z.B. `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS inspect_data_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD inspect_data_type.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data_ref ).

    CASE lo_type_descr->kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_elem.
        DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( lo_type_descr ).
        rv_description = |Elementartyp: { lo_elem_descr->get_relative_name( ) }, Länge: { lo_elem_descr->length }, Dezimalstellen: { lo_elem_descr->decimals }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_struct.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_type_descr ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
        rv_description = |Struktur: { lo_struct_descr->get_relative_name( ) }, Komponenten: { lines( lt_components ) }|.
        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
          rv_description = rv_description && |\n  - { ls_comp}-name ({ ls_comp}-type_descr->get_relative_name( ))|.
        ENDLOOP.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_type_descr ).
        rv_description = |Interne Tabelle: { lo_table_descr->get_relative_name( ) }, Zeilentyp: { lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_relative_name( ) }, Tabellentyp: { lo_table_descr->table_kind }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = |Unbekannter Typ: { lo_type_descr->get_relative_name( ) } (Kind: { lo_type_descr->kind })|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein gegebenes Datenobjekt eine interne Tabelle ist und ob diese Tabelle leer ist.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_empty_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_empty_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_empty) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_empty_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data_ref ).

    IF lo_type_descr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table.
      DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_type_descr ).
      " Check if the table is empty using LINES()
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
      ASSIGN ir_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lines( <fs_table> ) = 0.
        rv_is_empty = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flugdaten für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum starten. Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und filtern Sie die Driving Table vorab mit einem `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` um die Driving Table zu reduzieren, bevor Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_date,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             min_fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_carrier_date.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_date WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_dates TYPE tt_carrier_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    IF it_carrier_dates IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Filter the driving table for valid dates before using FOR ALL ENTRIES
    DATA(lt_filtered_carriers) = FILTER zcl_fae_filter=>tt_carrier_dates
      FROM it_carrier_dates
      WHERE min_fldate IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF lt_filtered_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_filtered_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @lt_filtered_carriers-carrid
        AND fldate >= @lt_filtered_carriers-min_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

          cond = ( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_today )
          msg = 'LH flight date should be today or later'
        ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Should return empty table for empty input'

  METHOD test_no_valid_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_dates) = VALUE zcl_fae_filter=>tt_carrier_dates(

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus und transformieren Sie die Ergebnisse sofort in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer angepassten Struktur, die nur `carrid`, `connid` und eine berechnete `available_seats` enthält. Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und den `VALUE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und direkter Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrier_id      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id   TYPE s_conn_id,
             available_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES: tt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw_flight IN lt_raw_flights
      ( carrier_id      = ls_raw_flight-carrid
        connection_id   = ls_raw_flight-connid

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft, um die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und anschließend `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` um den Status basierend auf dem Vergleich des Flugdatums mit dem aktuellen Datum zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES: tt_flights_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE tt_flights_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_flights_with_status = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw_flight IN lt_raw_flights
      ( carrid = ls_raw_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_raw_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_raw_flight-fldate
        status = COND string(
          WHEN ls_raw_flight-fldate < lv_today THEN 'Vergangen'
          WHEN ls_raw_flight-fldate = lv_today THEN 'Heute'
          WHEN ls_raw_flight-fldate > lv_today THEN 'Zukünftig'
          ELSE 'Unbekannt' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle diese Flüge. Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine einzelne Summe aus einer internen Tabelle zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights

      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers_with_name
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers_with_name-carrid.

CLASS zcl_flight_object DEFINITION PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_object IMPLEMENTATION.

    me->connid = iv_connid.

CLASS zcl_fae_new_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_objects) TYPE tt_flight_objects.

CLASS zcl_fae_new_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_objects.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    rt_flight_objects = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw_flight IN lt_raw_flights
      ( NEW zcl_flight_object(
          iv_carrid = ls_raw_flight-carrid

CLASS zcl_fae_join_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_name,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_with_name.
    TYPES: tt_flights_with_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_name) TYPE tt_flights_with_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_join_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carrier_names)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    rt_flights_with_name = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw_flight IN lt_raw_flights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_raw_flight ) 
        carrname = lt_carrier_names[ KEY primary_key carrid = ls_raw_flight-carrid ]-carrname OPTIONAL ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus und demonstrieren Sie eine moderne Fehlerbehandlung, falls keine Daten gefunden werden oder die Eingabetabelle leer ist. Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und `TRY...CATCH` für Table Expressions.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` um Fehler bei `Table Expressions` abzufangen, wenn ein Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_robust
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_robust.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Eingabetabelle der Fluggesellschaften ist leer.'.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    IF rt_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Keine Flüge für die angegebenen Fluggesellschaften gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.

    " Beispiel für Fehlerbehandlung bei Table Expressions (hier nicht direkt FAE-bezogen, aber gute Praxis)
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_first_carrid) = rt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Dies sollte hier nicht passieren, da rt_flights nicht initial ist
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Interner Fehler: Erster Flug nicht gefunden.'.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus und verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln und die Ergebnisse in einer einzigen Anweisung zu aggregieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` in einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_for_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_functional
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_for_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_functional.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = REDUCE i(
          INIT count = 0
          FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT count = count + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Driving Table für `FOR ALL ENTRIES` sortiert und Duplikate entfernt werden, um die Performance zu optimieren. Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` oder eine `SORTED TABLE` für die Driving Table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_optimized DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_optimized
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_optimized IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_optimized.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Optimierung: Driving Table sortieren und Duplikate entfernen
    DATA(lt_optimized_carriers) = it_carriers.
    SORT lt_optimized_carriers BY carrid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_optimized_carriers COMPARING carrid.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_optimized_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @lt_optimized_carriers-carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' ) " Duplicate

    DATA(lt_flights_before_opt) = lo_cut->get_flights_optimized( lt_carriers ).

    " The actual assertion here is that the method runs without error and returns data.
    " The optimization itself is internal and hard to assert directly without mocking DB calls.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften aus und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen enthält. Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... WHERE` innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Ausdrucks, um die Ergebnisse zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_for_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_available,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             available_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_available.
    TYPES: tt_flights_available TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_available WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_min_available_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
        iv_min_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_available) TYPE tt_flights_available.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_for_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_min_available_seats.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.

    rt_flights_available = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw_flight IN lt_raw_flights
      LET lv_available = ls_raw_flight-seatsmax - ls_raw_flight-seatsocc IN
      WHERE lv_available >= iv_min_seats
      ( carrid = ls_raw_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_raw_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_raw_flight-fldate
        available_seats = lv_available )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_where FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_match_criteria FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_for_where( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_for_where=>tt_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_min_seats) = 100.
    DATA(lt_flights_available) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_available_seats( it_carriers = lt_carriers iv_min_seats = lv_min_seats ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights_available )
      msg = 'Should find flights with at least 100 available seats for LH'
      exp = 0
      tolerance = 0
      operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-greater_equal
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights_available INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        cond = ( ls_flight-available_seats >= lv_min_seats )
        msg = 'Available seats should meet minimum criteria'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_for_where( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_for_where=>tt_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_available) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_available_seats( it_carriers = lt_carriers iv_min_seats = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights_available )
      msg = 'Should return empty table for empty input'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_match_criteria.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_for_where( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_fae_for_where=>tt_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_min_seats) = 99999. " Very high number, unlikely to match
    DATA(lt_flights_available) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_min_available_seats( it_carriers = lt_carriers iv_min_seats = lv_min_seats ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights_available )
      msg = 'Should return empty table if no flights match criteria'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `FOR ALL ENTRIES` in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, der eine `WHERE`-Klausel enthält. Dies ermöglicht es, die aus der Datenbank abgerufenen Daten direkt während der Transformation in eine neue interne Tabelle zu filtern. Die `LET`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um eine Zwischenvariable für die Berechnung der verfügbaren Sitze zu definieren, was den Code lesbarer macht. Dies ist ein sehr effizientes und modernes Muster für die In-Memory-Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, FOR, WHERE, LET, Data Filtering, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für jede Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_group_by_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             passmax  TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflights-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_summary.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_passengers_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_passenger_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                           ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                             total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP ( sum = sum + <member>-passmax ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             fldate  TYPE sflights-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflights-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             key     TYPE ty_flight_key,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_detail,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_key.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflights GROUP BY carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                  ( key = VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid )
                                    flights = VALUE tt_flight_detail( FOR <member> IN GROUP ( CORRESPONDING #( <member> ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_having_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.

CLASS zcl_sql_having_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_many_flights.

      HAVING COUNT( * ) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Feldnamen. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY (field_name) ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflights-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflights-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             group_members TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_group_field TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_group_key> TYPE any.

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( key_field = ls_flight-(iv_group_field) ) ASCENDING
                                  ( group_key = CONV string( ls_flight-(iv_group_field) )
                                    group_members = VALUE tt_flight_data( FOR <member> IN GROUP ( <member> ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_grouping FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_group_by=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'NYC' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'NYC' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'MUC' cityto = 'LAX' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'LAX' )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_grouped_by_carrid) = lo_cut->group_flights_dynamically( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_group_field = 'CARRID' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped_by_carrid ) exp = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped_by_carrid[ group_key = 'AA' ]-group_members[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRA' ).

        DATA(lt_grouped_by_cityfrom) = lo_cut->group_flights_dynamically( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_group_field = 'CITYFROM' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped_by_cityfrom ) exp = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped_by_cityfrom[ group_key = 'MUC' ]-group_members[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Dynamic grouping failed unexpectedly.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_group_by=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'NYC' )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->group_flights_dynamically( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_group_field = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_table_error for invalid field.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for invalid field.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50+ ermöglicht dynamische Gruppierungsschlüssel in `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` durch die Verwendung von Klammern `(field_name)`. Dies ist besonders nützlich für flexible Berichte oder Analysen, bei denen das Gruppierungskriterium zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Der `CONV string(...)` Ausdruck wird verwendet, um den dynamisch ermittelten Schlüssel in einen String für die Ausgabe zu konvertieren.

Instructions: Füge einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein. Stelle sicher, dass der Datensatz eindeutig ist und behandle mögliche Fehler.
hint: Verwende `INSERT sflights FROM @DATA(wa_sflight)` und `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_SQL_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.

CLASS zcl_insert_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

    IF iv_carrid IS INITIAL OR iv_connid IS INITIAL OR iv_fldate IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input EXPORTING iv_value = 0. " Reusing custom exception
    ENDIF.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate price = iv_price currency = 'EUR' ).

    TRY.
        INSERT sflights FROM @ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle duplicate key or other DB errors
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme werfen kann, und eine aufrufende Methode, die diese Ausnahme fängt und eine alternative Aktion ausführt.
hint: Nutze `RAISING` in der Methodendefinition und `TRY...CATCH` im aufrufenden Code.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_calculated) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_value.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input EXPORTING iv_value = iv_input.
    ENDIF.
    rv_calculated = iv_input * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_calculated) = calculate_value( iv_input = iv_value ).
        rv_result = |Calculation successful: { lv_calculated }|.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        rv_result = |Error: Invalid input { lx_invalid_input->mv_value }. Using default value 0.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_process_invalid_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_valid_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_data( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Valid calculation result' act = lv_result exp = 'Calculation successful: 10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_invalid_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_data( -3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Error handling result' act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Invalid input -3. Using default value 0.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die saubere Trennung von Logik und Fehlerbehandlung in objektorientierten Programmen. Die Methode `calculate_value` ist für die Berechnung zuständig und wirft bei ungültigen Eingaben eine Ausnahme. Die Methode `process_data` fängt diese Ausnahme und kann darauf reagieren, ohne die Logik von `calculate_value` zu beeinflussen. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, TRY CATCH, Object Orientation, RAISING

Instructions: Füge mehrere Flugdatensätze aus einer internen Tabelle in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein. Behandle dabei mögliche Fehler wie Duplikate.
hint: Verwende `INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sflights_bulk DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sflights_bulk IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights.
    TRY.
        INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @it_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
        rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Log error, but ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS should prevent termination for duplicates
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_inserted_count = 0.
    ENDTRY.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_multiple_successful FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_multiple_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_multiple_successful.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sflights_bulk( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate1) = sy-datum + 3.
    DATA(lv_fldate2) = sy-datum + 4.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0010' fldate = lv_fldate1 price = 300 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0010' fldate = lv_fldate2 price = 350 currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AZ' AND connid = '0010' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate1 OR fldate = lv_fldate2 ).
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_flights( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should insert 2 flights' act = lv_inserted exp = 2 ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_count) WHERE carrid = 'AZ' AND connid = '0010' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate1 OR fldate = lv_fldate2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '2 flights should exist in DB' act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AZ' AND connid = '0010' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate1 OR fldate = lv_fldate2 ).
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_multiple_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sflights_bulk( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate_dup) = sy-datum + 5.
    DATA(lv_fldate_new) = sy-datum + 6.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = lv_fldate_dup price = 400 currency = 'GBP' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = lv_fldate_new price = 450 currency = 'GBP' )
    ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'BA' AND connid = '0020' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate_dup OR fldate = lv_fldate_new ).
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    " Insert one record first to create a duplicate scenario
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = lv_fldate_dup price = 390 currency = 'GBP' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_flights( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should insert only 1 new flight (1 duplicate ignored)' act = lv_inserted exp = 1 ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_count) WHERE carrid = 'BA' AND connid = '0020' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate_dup OR fldate = lv_fldate_new ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '2 flights should exist in DB (original + 1 new)' act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'BA' AND connid = '0020' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate_dup OR fldate = lv_fldate_new ).
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, indem du eine bestehende Tabelle reduzierst und dabei neue Einträge generierst und einfügst, basierend auf einer Aggregation.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `INSERT` oder `APPEND` innerhalb des Reduktionsausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_and_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_raw_data,
           ty_raw_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_data,
             category TYPE string,
             total_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aggregated_data,
           ty_aggregated_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_data WITH UNIQUE KEY category.

    METHODS aggregate_data
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data TYPE ty_raw_data_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE ty_aggregated_data_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_and_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_data.
    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE ty_aggregated_data_tt(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_aggregated_data_tt( )
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ category = ls_raw-category ] ) IN
      result = COND #( WHEN lv_index IS NOT INITIAL
                       THEN VALUE ty_aggregated_data_tt( result
                                 ( category = ls_raw-category total_value = result[ lv_index ]-total_value + ls_raw-value ) )
                       ELSE VALUE ty_aggregated_data_tt( result
                                 ( category = ls_raw-category total_value = ls_raw-value ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Werfe eine Ausnahme im Konstruktor einer Klasse, wenn ungültige Parameter übergeben werden, um die Erzeugung eines inkonsistenten Objekts zu verhindern.

CLASS zcl_object_with_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_name TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.

    DATA mv_id   TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_with_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF iv_id <= 0 OR iv_name IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input EXPORTING iv_value = iv_id.
    ENDIF.
    me->mv_id = iv_id.
    me->mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füge dynamisch eine Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwende `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Zeile und `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` mit Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_dynamic_row
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type TYPE string " Name des Tabellentyps, z.B. 'SFLIGHTS_T'
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid     TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
        iv_fldate     TYPE s_date OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_dynamic_row.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data        TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_table       TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        lr_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type ).
        lr_line_descr  ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_table>.

        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_line_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <ls_line>.

        " Dynamisches Füllen der Zeile
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = iv_carrid. ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = iv_connid. ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_fldate> = iv_fldate. ENDIF.

        " Dynamisches Einfügen in die Tabelle
        INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_assign_error cx_sy_table_line_not_found INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input EXPORTING iv_value = 0. " Reusing custom exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende den `COND`-Ausdruck, um eine Ausnahme bedingt zu werfen, basierend auf einer einfachen Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_cond_throw_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_throw_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_value.
    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN iv_value < 0
      THEN THROW zcx_invalid_input( iv_value = iv_value )
      ELSE |Value is { iv_value }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutze `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` in einem `VALUE #` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_filtered_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id       TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data,
           ty_source_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id       TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_data,
           ty_target_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_insert
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE ty_source_data_tt
        iv_category    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE ty_target_data_tt.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION` für eine Ausnahme, die nach der Behandlung fortgesetzt werden kann, und demonstriere die Fortsetzung.
hint: Definiere eine Ausnahme als `RESUMABLE` und verwende `RESUME` nach dem `CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.

    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE #( msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' msgno = '003' attr1 = 'MV_VALUE' ). " Nachricht 003: 'Resumable Fehler bei Wert &1.'
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_list
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_list.
    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      TRY.
          IF lv_value < 0.
            RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_error EXPORTING iv_value = lv_value.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND |Processed: { lv_value }| TO rt_results.
        CATCH zcx_resumable_error INTO DATA(lx_resumable_error).
          APPEND |Error (resumable): { lx_resumable_error->mv_value }| TO rt_results.
          RESUME.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_resumable_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resumable_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      ( 10 ) ( -1 ) ( 20 ) ( -2 ) ( 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_list( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total results count' act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 1' act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Processed: 10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 2 (error)' act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Error (resumable): -1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 3' act = lt_results[ 3 ] exp = 'Processed: 20' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 4 (error)' act = lt_results[ 4 ] exp = 'Error (resumable): -2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result 5' act = lt_results[ 5 ] exp = 'Processed: 30' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION` ist eine spezielle Form der Ausnahmebehandlung, die es ermöglicht, die Programmausführung nach dem Fangen einer Ausnahme fortzusetzen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Schleifen, wo Fehler in einzelnen Iterationen behandelt werden können, ohne die gesamte Schleife abzubrechen. Die `RESUME`-Anweisung im `CATCH`-Block signalisiert die Fortsetzung.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, RESUMABLE, RESUME, Error Handling, Loop Processing

Instructions: Füge Datensätze in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein, die aus einer internen Tabelle stammen, aber nur, wenn sie bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen, unter Verwendung von `INSERT` und `FOR` mit `COND`.
hint: Kombiniere `INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE ... )` mit `FOR` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_conditionally DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_candidate,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_flight_candidate,
           ty_flight_candidate_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_candidate WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_qualified_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_candidates TYPE ty_flight_candidate_tt
        iv_min_price  TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_conditionally IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_qualified_flights.
    TRY.
        INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @(
          VALUE sflights_tt(
            FOR ls_candidate IN it_candidates
            WHERE ( price >= iv_min_price AND carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND connid IS NOT INITIAL AND fldate IS NOT INITIAL )
            ( carrid   = ls_candidate-carrid
              connid   = ls_candidate-connid
              fldate   = ls_candidate-fldate
              price    = ls_candidate-price
              currency = ls_candidate-currency ) )
        ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
        rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_inserted_count = 0.
    ENDTRY.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_qualified FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_no_qualified FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_qualified.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_conditionally( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate1) = sy-datum + 8.
    DATA(lv_fldate2) = sy-datum + 9.
    DATA(lv_fldate3) = sy-datum + 10.

    DATA(lt_candidates) = lo_cut->ty_flight_candidate_tt(
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' fldate = lv_fldate1 price = 150 currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' fldate = lv_fldate2 price = 90  currency = 'USD' ) " Too cheap
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' fldate = lv_fldate3 price = 200 currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'DL' AND connid = '0030' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate1 OR fldate = lv_fldate2 OR fldate = lv_fldate3 ).
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_qualified_flights( it_candidates = lt_candidates iv_min_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should insert 2 qualified flights' act = lv_inserted exp = 2 ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_count) WHERE carrid = 'DL' AND connid = '0030' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate1 OR fldate = lv_fldate3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '2 flights should exist in DB' act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'DL' AND connid = '0030' AND ( fldate = lv_fldate1 OR fldate = lv_fldate2 OR fldate = lv_fldate3 ).
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_no_qualified.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_conditionally( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate1) = sy-datum + 11.

    DATA(lt_candidates) = lo_cut->ty_flight_candidate_tt(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0040' fldate = lv_fldate1 price = 50 currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'UA' AND connid = '0040' AND fldate = lv_fldate1.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_qualified_flights( it_candidates = lt_candidates iv_min_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should insert 0 flights' act = lv_inserted exp = 0 ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_count) WHERE carrid = 'UA' AND connid = '0040' AND fldate = lv_fldate1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '0 flights should exist in DB' act = lv_count exp = 0 ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'UA' AND connid = '0040' AND fldate = lv_fldate1.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Zeilentyp und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_line_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                              p_line_type = ir_line_type_descr
                              p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                              p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE ir_line_type_descr.
      ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line_data>).

      IF <fs_line_data> IS ASSIGNED.
        TRY.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line_data> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line_data> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
            IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_field1> = 'Value A'.
              <fs_field2> = 1.
              APPEND <fs_line_data> TO <lt_table>.

              <fs_field1> = 'Value B'.
              <fs_field2> = 2.
              APPEND <fs_line_data> TO <lt_table>.
            ENDIF.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
            " Handle error if component not found
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Mittels `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name` wird ein Struktur-Deskriptor für den Zeilentyp ermittelt. Dieser wird dann an `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` übergeben, um einen Tabellen-Deskriptor zu erzeugen. Schließlich wird mit `CREATE DATA` eine Tabelle des dynamisch definierten Typs instanziiert. Die Befüllung erfolgt über Field-Symbols, was eine flexible Manipulation der dynamischen Daten ermöglicht.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei beliebige Datentypen zur Laufzeit, um festzustellen, ob sie identisch sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data` und den Vergleich von Referenzen oder `get_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_types_identical
      IMPORTING
        iv_data1 TYPE any
        iv_data2 TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_identical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_types_identical.
    DATA(lo_descr1) = cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data1 ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data2 ).

    IF lo_descr1 = lo_descr2.
      rv_identical = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      IF lo_descr1->get_name( ) = lo_descr2->get_name( ).
        rv_identical = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_identical = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_var1) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_var2) TYPE i.

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_compare( ).
    DATA: lv_char10 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
          lv_char20 TYPE c LENGTH 20.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->are_types_identical( iv_data1 = lv_char10 iv_data2 = lv_char20 ) ).
    DATA: lv_char10_b TYPE c LENGTH 10.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI die Identität von Datentypen überprüft. Die Methode `describe_by_data` liefert Referenzen auf Typdeskriptoren. Ein direkter Vergleich dieser Referenzen (`lo_descr1 = lo_descr2`) ist die effizienteste Methode, um festzustellen, ob es sich um exakt denselben Typdeskriptor handelt. Ein zusätzlicher Vergleich der Typnamen (`get_name()`) kann in Szenarien nützlich sein, in denen Typen zwar denselben Namen haben, aber aus unterschiedlichen Kontexten stammen und daher unterschiedliche Deskriptor-Referenzen besitzen könnten.
keywords: RTTI, Typvergleich, cl_abap_datadescr, Referenzvergleich, abap_bool

Instructions: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für ein Ereignis des `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` Controls.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für die Event-Registrierung. Definieren Sie eine lokale Klasse als Event-Handler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3dviewer_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS model_loaded EXPORTING VALUE(i_model_path) TYPE string.

    METHODS register_event_handler
      IMPORTING
        io_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.

    METHODS simulate_event
      IMPORTING
        io_3d_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer
        iv_model_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_event_handler.
    " Lokale Klasse für den Event-Handler
    CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS handle_model_loaded FOR EVENT model_loaded OF zcl_3dviewer_event_handler
          IMPORTING i_model_path.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD handle_model_loaded.
        " Hier würde die Logik zur Verarbeitung des Events stehen
        " z.B. eine Statusmeldung anzeigen
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Model '{ i_model_path }' wurde geladen.| ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_event_receiver) = NEW lcl_event_receiver( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_event_receiver->handle_model_loaded FOR me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_event.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde das Event vom Control selbst gefeuert.
    " Hier simulieren wir es für Testzwecke.
    RAISE EVENT model_loaded EXPORTING i_model_path = iv_model_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_3d_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer( parent = lo_container ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dviewer_event_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_model_path) = 'test_model.obj'.

    lo_cut->register_event_handler( lo_3d_viewer ).

    " Da cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer keine öffentlichen Events für Unit Tests bietet,
    " simulieren wir das Event über die eigene Klasse.
    lo_cut->simulate_event( io_3d_viewer = lo_3d_viewer iv_model_path = lv_model_path ).

    " Eine direkte Assert-Prüfung des Event-Handlings ist schwierig.
    " Man müsste z.B. cl_demo_output mocken oder eine globale Variable setzen.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, dass der Aufruf ohne Fehler durchläuft.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Registrierung eines Event-Handlers für ein benutzerdefiniertes Ereignis. Obwohl `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` eigene Events hat, wird hier ein internes Event (`model_loaded`) verwendet, um das Prinzip der Event-Registrierung mit `SET HANDLER` und einer lokalen Event-Handler-Klasse zu demonstrieren. Die Methode `simulate_event` dient dazu, das Ereignis für Testzwecke manuell auszulösen. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der ereignisgesteuerten Programmierung in ABAP.
