Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine Klasse eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert, und rufen Sie dynamisch eine Schnittstellenmethode auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name`, `get_interfaces` und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_unit_assert.

    METHODS check_and_call_interface
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_call_interface.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_interfaces) = lo_class_descr->get_interfaces( ).

    DATA(lv_implements_interface) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_interfaces INTO DATA(ls_interface) WHERE name = iv_interface_name.
      lv_implements_interface = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_implements_interface = abap_true.
      DATA(lo_object) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_object( )->create_object_dynamically( iv_class_name ).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lo_interface> TYPE REF TO if_abap_unit_assert.
      ASSIGN lo_object TO <lo_interface>.

      IF <lo_interface> IS BOUND.
        DATA(lv_full_method_name) = |{ iv_interface_name }~{ iv_method_name }|.
        TRY.
            CALL METHOD <lo_interface>->(lv_full_method_name).
            rv_success = abap_true.
          CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING previous = lx_dyn_call_error.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_interface_check_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_create_object_error.
    METHODS test_interface_check_fail FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_check_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_interface_check( ).
    DATA(lv_class) = 'ZCL_RTTI_INTERFACE_CHECK'.
    DATA(lv_interface) = 'IF_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT'.
    DATA(lv_method) = 'ASSERT_INITIAL'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->check_and_call_interface(
      iv_class_name = lv_class
      iv_interface_name = lv_interface
      iv_method_name = lv_method
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_interface_check_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_interface_check( ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen ABAP-String, der Umlaute enthält, in die Codepage UTF-8, um ihn für eine externe REST-API vorzubereiten. Die Ausgabe soll als XSTRING erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und die Methode `create` mit der Zielcodepage 'UTF-8'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_utf8_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_utf8_xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-8'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write(
          EXPORTING
            data = iv_input_string
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_utf8_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder Exception werfen
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) in eine CSV-formatierte XSTRING-Ausgabe, wobei die Daten in der Codepage 'ISO-8859-1' (Latin-1) vorliegen sollen. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenverarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die String-Formatierung und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die Codepage-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_sflights_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_sflights_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_csv.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    " Header-Zeile
    lv_csv_string = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Datenzeilen mit REDUCE und String Templates
    lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string && REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR wa IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = s && |
        { wa-carrid };{ wa-connid };{ wa-fldate };{ wa-price };{ wa-currency }|
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write(
          EXPORTING
            data = lv_csv_string
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_csv_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Enterprise Search (ESH) Konnektoren, deren Cache nicht aktuell ist, und geben Sie deren IDs in einer internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_esh_ca_check` und die Methode `get_all_connector_ids` in Kombination mit `is_connector_cache_up_to_date`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_outdated_caches DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_outdated_connector_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_outdated_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_outdated_caches IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_outdated_connector_ids.
    DATA: lo_esh_cache_check TYPE REF TO cl_esh_ca_check.
    DATA: lt_all_connector_ids TYPE string_table.

    TRY.
        lo_esh_cache_check = NEW cl_esh_ca_check( ).
        lt_all_connector_ids = lo_esh_cache_check->get_all_connector_ids( ).

        LOOP AT lt_all_connector_ids INTO DATA(lv_connector_id).
          IF lo_esh_cache_check->is_connector_cache_up_to_date( lv_connector_id ) = abap_false.
            APPEND lv_connector_id TO rt_outdated_ids.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        MESSAGE lx_esh_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_outdated_ids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_outdated_ids.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_esh_outdated_caches( ).

    " Da wir den Zustand des ESH-Systems nicht kontrollieren können, ist ein direkter Test schwierig.
    " Wir können jedoch sicherstellen, dass die Methode ohne Dump läuft und eine Tabelle zurückgibt.
    DATA(lt_outdated) = lo_checker->get_outdated_connector_ids( ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Tabelle initial ist (wenn keine Konnektoren gefunden oder alle aktuell sind)
    " oder ob sie Einträge enthält.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_outdated
      msg = 'Es sollten keine veralteten Caches gefunden werden (Mock-Verhalten oder Systemzustand)' ).

    " Für einen echten Test müsste man den ESH-Service mocken, um spezifische Ergebnisse zu simulieren.
    " Beispiel: Mocken von get_all_connector_ids und is_connector_cache_up_to_date
    " DATA(lt_mock_connectors) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CONN_A' ) ( 'CONN_B' ) ).
    " lo_esh_cache_check->get_all_connector_ids( ) = lt_mock_connectors.
    " lo_esh_cache_check->is_connector_cache_up_to_date( 'CONN_A' ) = abap_false.
    " lo_esh_cache_check->is_connector_cache_up_to_date( 'CONN_B' ) = abap_true.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_outdated ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man alle verfügbaren ESH-Konnektoren abrufen und dann iterativ deren Cache-Status überprüfen kann. Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT` über die von `get_all_connector_ids` zurückgegebene Tabelle ist eine effiziente Methode, um alle Konnektoren zu verarbeiten und die nicht aktuellen zu identifizieren.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen binären XSTRING, der Daten in der Codepage 'UTF-16BE' enthält, in einen ABAP-String (System-Codepage).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` für die Konvertierung von extern nach intern. Obwohl der Fokus auf `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` liegt, ist `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` die korrekte Klasse für diese Richtung. Für die Demonstration von `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` wird der XSTRING zuerst mit dieser Klasse erzeugt.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf16be_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

  METHOD test_convert_utf16be.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_utf16be_string( ).

    " 1. Erzeuge UTF-16BE XSTRING mit cl_abap_conv_out_ce

Anschließend wird `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` genutzt, um diesen XSTRING wieder in einen ABAP-String zurückzuwandeln. Dies ist typisch für Szenarien, in denen Daten in einem bestimmten Format empfangen und verarbeitet werden müssen.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in einen JSON-String und konvertieren Sie diesen JSON-String anschließend in die Codepage 'UTF-16LE' als XSTRING für die Übertragung an ein externes System.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_json_serializer` für die JSON-Serialisierung und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die Codepage-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_to_utf16le DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             flag TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS serialize_and_convert
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf16le_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_to_utf16le IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_and_convert.
    DATA: lv_json_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = is_data
            pretty_print = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_string
        ).

        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write(
          EXPORTING
            data = lv_json_string
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_utf16le_xstring
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_json_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_json_to_utf16le FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_json_to_utf16le.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_json_to_utf16le( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_json_to_utf16le=>ty_data(
      id   = 123
      name = `Beispielname mit Umlauten: ÄÖÜ`
      flag = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lx_result) = lo_converter->serialize_and_convert( ls_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_result
      msg = 'Ergebnis XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Deserialisierung und Konvertierung zurück zur Überprüfung
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-16LE' endian = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little ).
    DATA(lv_json_back) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING buffer = lx_result IMPORTING data = lv_json_back ).

    DATA(ls_data_back) TYPE zcl_json_to_utf16le=>ty_data.
    cl_abap_json_parser=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = lv_json_back
      RECEIVING
        data = ls_data_back
    ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob der Cache eines ESH-Konnektors älter als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Stunden ist. Geben Sie 'X' zurück, wenn er veraltet ist, ansonsten ' '.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_esh_ca_check` und die Methode `get_connector_cache_timestamp` in Kombination mit Datums-/Zeitberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_age_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_connector_cache_older_than
      IMPORTING
        iv_connector_id TYPE string
        iv_hours        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_older) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_age_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_connector_cache_older_than.
    DATA: lo_esh_cache_check TYPE REF TO cl_esh_ca_check.
    DATA: lv_cache_timestamp TYPE timestampl.
    DATA: lv_current_timestamp TYPE timestampl.
    DATA: lv_diff_seconds TYPE i.

    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_current_timestamp.

    TRY.
        lo_esh_cache_check = NEW cl_esh_ca_check( ).
        lv_cache_timestamp = lo_esh_cache_check->get_connector_cache_timestamp(
          iv_connector_id = iv_connector_id
        ).

        IF lv_cache_timestamp IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_diff_seconds = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
            tstmp1 = lv_current_timestamp
            tstmp2 = lv_cache_timestamp
          ).
          IF lv_diff_seconds > ( iv_hours * 3600 ).
            rv_is_older = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            rv_is_older = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          " Cache-Timestamp nicht gefunden, als veraltet betrachten oder Fehler
          rv_is_older = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        MESSAGE lx_esh_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
        rv_is_older = abap_true. " Bei Fehler als veraltet betrachten
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cache_age FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cache_age.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_age_check( ).
    DATA(lv_connector_id) = 'SOME_ESH_CONNECTOR'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch einen gültigen/ungültigen Konnektor für Tests

    " Mocken des cl_esh_ca_check für kontrollierte Testergebnisse
    DATA: lo_mock_esh_check TYPE REF TO cl_esh_ca_check.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_esh_check.

    " Setze einen Timestamp in der Vergangenheit (z.B. 10 Stunden alt)
    DATA(lv_past_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_past_timestamp.
    lv_past_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      tstmp1 = lv_past_timestamp
      seconds = 10 * 3600 " 10 Stunden in Sekunden
    ).

    " Hier müsste man lo_mock_esh_check->get_connector_cache_timestamp( ) mocken
    " um lv_past_timestamp zurückzugeben. Da ABAP Unit keine direkten Mocks erlaubt,
    " ist dies ein konzeptioneller Test.

    " Testfall 1: Cache ist älter als 5 Stunden (sollte true sein)
    DATA(lv_is_older_true) = lo_checker->is_connector_cache_older_than( iv_connector_id = lv_connector_id iv_hours = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_is_older_true
      msg = 'Cache sollte als nicht älter als 5 Stunden erkannt werden (ohne Mocking)' ).

    " Testfall 2: Cache ist nicht älter als 15 Stunden (sollte false sein)
    DATA(lv_is_older_false) = lo_checker->is_connector_cache_older_than( iv_connector_id = lv_connector_id iv_hours = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_is_older_false
      msg = 'Cache sollte als nicht älter als 15 Stunden erkannt werden (ohne Mocking)' ).

    " Hinweis: Für aussagekräftige Tests von Zeitabhängigkeiten ist Mocking oder eine Testumgebung mit kontrollierbaren Timestamps unerlässlich.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Mit `cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract` wird die Differenz zur aktuellen Zeit berechnet und so festgestellt, ob der Cache eine bestimmte Altersgrenze überschritten hat. Dies ist wichtig für die proaktive Überwachung der Datenaktualität in Enterprise Search.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in einen binären XSTRING unter Verwendung einer spezifischen Codepage (z.B. 'UTF-8') und Endian-Format (z.B. Big Endian).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und die Methode `write` mit einem `data` Parameter vom Typ `ANY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_serialize_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_complex_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             amount  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             created TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_complex_data.

    METHODS serialize_structure_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_complex_data
        iv_encoding TYPE string DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
        iv_endian   TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_serialized_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_serialize_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_structure_to_xstring.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_encoding
          endian   = iv_endian
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write(
          EXPORTING
            data = is_data " Hier wird die Struktur direkt übergeben
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_serialized_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_serialize_structure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_structure.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_serialize_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_serialize_to_xstring=>ty_complex_data(
      id      = 456
      name    = `Produktname mit Sonderzeichen`
      amount  = '123.45'
      created = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
                  iv_date = '20251129' iv_time = '103000' )
    ).

    DATA(lx_result_utf8) = lo_serializer->serialize_structure_to_xstring( ls_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_result_utf8
      msg = 'UTF-8 XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    DATA(lx_result_utf16le) = lo_serializer->serialize_structure_to_xstring(
      is_data = ls_test_data
      iv_encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
      iv_endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_result_utf16le
      msg = 'UTF-16LE XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Überprüfung durch Deserialisierung (erfordert cl_abap_conv_in_ce)
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' endian = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big ).
    DATA(ls_data_back) TYPE zcl_serialize_to_xstring=>ty_complex_data.
    lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING buffer = lx_result_utf8 IMPORTING data = ls_data_back ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data_back-id exp = ls_test_data-id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data_back-name exp = ls_test_data-name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data_back-amount exp = ls_test_data-amount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data_back-created exp = ls_test_data-created ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für die binäre Serialisierung von Daten in einem bestimmten Codepage- und Endian-Format, was für die Kommunikation mit Low-Level-Schnittstellen oder Dateiformaten nützlich ist.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob der Cache eines ESH-Konnektors überhaupt existiert (d.h. ob ein Timestamp abgerufen werden kann).

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_connector_id TYPE string

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD does_connector_cache_exist.
    DATA: lo_esh_cache_check TYPE REF TO cl_esh_ca_check.
    DATA: lv_cache_timestamp TYPE timestampl.

    TRY.
        lo_esh_cache_check = NEW cl_esh_ca_check( ).
        lv_cache_timestamp = lo_esh_cache_check->get_connector_cache_timestamp(
          iv_connector_id = iv_connector_id
        ).

        IF lv_cache_timestamp IS NOT INITIAL.
          rv_exists = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_exists = abap_false.

      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).

        MESSAGE lx_esh_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'. " Warnung statt Fehler

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von ESH-Konnektoren akzeptiert und für jeden Konnektor prüft, ob der Cache aktuell ist. Geben Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Konnektor-IDs und deren Status ('X' für aktuell, ' ' für nicht aktuell) zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` für die effiziente Verarbeitung der Liste und `cl_esh_ca_check`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_multi_cache_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connector_status,
             connector_id TYPE string,
             is_current   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_connector_status.
    TYPES tt_connector_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connector_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connectors_cache_status
      IMPORTING
        it_connector_ids TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_connector_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_multi_cache_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connectors_cache_status.
    DATA: lo_esh_cache_check TYPE REF TO cl_esh_ca_check.

    TRY.
        lo_esh_cache_check = NEW cl_esh_ca_check( ).

        rt_status = VALUE tt_connector_status(
          FOR lv_id IN it_connector_ids
          ( connector_id = lv_id,
            is_current   = COND abap_bool(
              WHEN lo_esh_cache_check->is_connector_cache_up_to_date( lv_id ) = abap_true THEN abap_true
              ELSE abap_false
            )
          )
        ).

      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        MESSAGE lx_esh_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
        " Bei Fehler alle als nicht aktuell markieren oder leere Tabelle zurückgeben
        CLEAR rt_status.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multi_cache_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_cache_status.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_esh_multi_cache_status( ).
    DATA(lt_test_connectors) = VALUE string_table(
      ( '0ES_PRODUCT' )
      ( '0ES_CUSTOMER' )

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_checker->get_connectors_cache_status( lt_test_connectors ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result
      msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Anzahl der Ergebnisse sollte der Anzahl der Eingaben entsprechen' ).

    " Überprüfung einzelner Einträge (abhängig vom Systemzustand ohne Mocking)
    DATA(ls_status_product) = lt_result[ connector_id = '0ES_PRODUCT' ].
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_status_product-is_current
    "   msg = '0ES_PRODUCT Cache sollte aktuell sein' ).

    DATA(ls_status_non_existent) = lt_result[ connector_id = 'NON_EXISTENT_CONNECTOR' ].

      msg = 'NON_EXISTENT_CONNECTOR Cache sollte nicht aktuell sein' ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in einen einzelnen XSTRING, wobei jeder String durch ein Linefeed getrennt und die gesamte Ausgabe in 'UTF-8' mit Little Endian codiert ist. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die String-Aggregation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der Strings und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die Codepage-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_string_table_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_table_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_xstring.
    DATA: lv_aggregated_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    lv_aggregated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR lv_line IN it_strings
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN lv_line
        ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && lv_line
      )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-8'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write(
          EXPORTING
            data = lv_aggregated_string
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_output_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von ESH-Konnektor-IDs, um nur diejenigen zu erhalten, deren Cache nicht aktuell ist und deren ID ein bestimmtes Präfix aufweist. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Selektion.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `cl_esh_ca_check` und String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_filtered_outdated DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_outdated_connectors
      IMPORTING
        it_all_connector_ids TYPE string_table
        iv_prefix            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_filtered_outdated IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_outdated_connectors.
    DATA: lo_esh_cache_check TYPE REF TO cl_esh_ca_check.

    TRY.
        lo_esh_cache_check = NEW cl_esh_ca_check( ).

        rt_filtered_ids = FILTER string_table(
          it_all_connector_ids
          WHERE ( 
            ( CONV abap_bool( lo_esh_cache_check->is_connector_cache_up_to_date( table_line ) = abap_false ) ) AND
            ( table_line CP |{ iv_prefix }*| ) 
          )
        ).

      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        MESSAGE lx_esh_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
        CLEAR rt_filtered_ids.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen, die Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) enthalten, in einen einzelnen XSTRING im JSON-Format, wobei der JSON-String in 'UTF-8' mit Little Endian codiert ist. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_json_serializer` und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce`.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die interne Tabelle direkt mit `cl_abap_json_serializer` und konvertieren Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_abap_conv_out_ce`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_json_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_json,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_json.
    TYPES tt_sflight_json TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_json WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_to_json_utf8
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_json_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_json_utf8.
    DATA: lv_json_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = it_sflights
            pretty_print = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_string
        ).

        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-8'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write(
          EXPORTING
            data = lv_json_string
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_json_xstring
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_json_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_sflights_json_utf8.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_sflights_json_utf8( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_sflights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_result
      msg = 'Ergebnis XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Überprüfung durch Deserialisierung und Konvertierung zurück
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' endian = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little ).
    DATA(lv_json_back) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING buffer = lx_result IMPORTING data = lv_json_back ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die alle ESH-Konnektoren auflistet und für jeden Konnektor den Status (aktuell/nicht aktuell) und den letzten Aktualisierungs-Timestamp zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Ergebnisaufbereitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_esh_ca_check` und die Methoden `get_all_connector_ids`, `is_connector_cache_up_to_date` und `get_connector_cache_timestamp`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_all_cache_details DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_detail,
             connector_id TYPE string,
             is_current   TYPE abap_bool,
             last_updated TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_detail.
    TYPES tt_cache_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cache_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_connector_cache_details
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_cache_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_all_cache_details IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_connector_cache_details.
    DATA: lo_esh_cache_check TYPE REF TO cl_esh_ca_check.
    DATA: lt_all_connector_ids TYPE string_table.

    TRY.
        lo_esh_cache_check = NEW cl_esh_ca_check( ).
        lt_all_connector_ids = lo_esh_cache_check->get_all_connector_ids( ).

        rt_details = VALUE tt_cache_detail(
          FOR lv_id IN lt_all_connector_ids
          ( connector_id = lv_id,
            is_current   = COND abap_bool(
              WHEN lo_esh_cache_check->is_connector_cache_up_to_date( lv_id ) = abap_true THEN abap_true
              ELSE abap_false
            ),
            last_updated = lo_esh_cache_check->get_connector_cache_timestamp( lv_id )
          )
        ).

      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        MESSAGE lx_esh_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
        CLEAR rt_details.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in der Ausnahmebehandlung, um sicherzustellen, dass eine Ressource (simuliert durch eine Statusvariable) immer zurückgesetzt wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, bevor der `CATCH`-Block erreicht wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_resource_status TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS process_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_resource.
    mv_resource_status = 'INITIALIZED'.
    rv_message = 'Verarbeitung erfolgreich'.

    TRY.
        " Simulate resource usage
        mv_resource_status = 'IN_USE'.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        mv_resource_status = 'FINISHED'.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler aufgetreten: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.

      CLEANUP.
        " This block is always executed if an exception occurs in TRY block
        mv_resource_status = 'CLEANED_UP'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_cleanup_on_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_cleanup( ).
    lo_cut->process_resource( iv_trigger_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_resource_status exp = 'FINISHED' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_on_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_cleanup( ).
    lo_cut->process_resource( iv_trigger_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_resource_status exp = 'CLEANED_UP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block ist entscheidend für die Ressourcensicherung. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, bevor die Kontrolle an den `CATCH`-Block übergeben wird. Dies stellt sicher, dass Ressourcen ordnungsgemäß freigegeben oder zurückgesetzt werden, selbst bei unerwarteten Fehlern. Im Erfolgsfall wird `CLEANUP` nicht durchlaufen.
keywords: TRY, CLEANUP, Exception, Resource Management, CX_ROOT

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` um alle Flugdaten (Airline ID, Connection ID, Flight Date) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` zu lesen und in einer internen Tabelle zu sammeln. Schließen Sie den Cursor nach der Verarbeitung.
hint: Denken Sie an `CLOSE CURSOR` nach der Verarbeitung. Verwenden Sie `FINAL(lv_cursor)` für die Cursor-Variable.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights.
    DATA: ls_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_data.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD FINAL(lv_cursor) FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
            FROM sflights.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights PACKAGE SIZE 100.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle SQL error, e.g., log it
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message=>default WITH lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_all_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_all_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ). " Initially, assume SFLIGHTS might be empty in test system

    " To make this test more robust, you might need to insert test data into SFLIGHTS
    " For demonstration, we just check if it's not initial if data exists.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die explizite Cursor-Verarbeitung mit `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`. Die Verwendung von `FINAL(lv_cursor)` ist eine moderne Inline-Deklaration für die Cursor-Variable. `PACKAGE SIZE` wird hier verwendet, um Daten in Blöcken zu lesen, was für große Datenmengen effizient ist. Der `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`-Block stellt sicher, dass der Cursor auch bei Fehlern geschlossen wird.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, SFLIGHTS, Database, PACKAGE SIZE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD` und seine Auswirkungen auf die Datenbanktransaktion. Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, führen Sie ein `COMMIT WORK` aus und versuchen Sie dann, weitere Daten zu fetchen, um zu zeigen, dass der Cursor offen bleibt.
hint: `WITH HOLD` hält den Cursor über einen `COMMIT WORK` hinweg offen. Verwenden Sie `sflights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_hold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_hold
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_hold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_hold.
    DATA: ls_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA: lv_cursor_id   TYPE cursor.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor_id FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
            FROM sflights
            ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

        " Fetch first package
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor_id INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights PACKAGE SIZE 2.

        " Perform a COMMIT WORK - cursor should remain open
        COMMIT WORK.

        " Fetch second package after COMMIT WORK
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor_id INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_more_flights) PACKAGE SIZE 2.
        APPEND LINES OF lt_more_flights TO rt_flights.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message=>default WITH lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor_id.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flights_with_hold FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_hold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_hold( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_hold( ).

    " This test assumes there are at least 4 entries in SFLIGHTS
    " for the two fetches of PACKAGE SIZE 2 to be meaningful.
    " In a real scenario, ensure test data exists.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) >= 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
      " Check if more than one package was fetched, implying WITH HOLD worked
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_flights ) >= 2 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD` ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen ein Cursor über mehrere `COMMIT WORK`-Anweisungen hinweg offen bleiben muss, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen in Batches, die Datenbank-Updates erfordern. Normalerweise würde ein `COMMIT WORK` alle offenen Cursor schließen. Hier wird gezeigt, dass der Cursor nach dem `COMMIT WORK` weiterhin Daten liefern kann.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, WITH HOLD, COMMIT WORK, Database Transaction, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 50 Zeilen zu verarbeiten. Zählen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verarbeiteten Pakete.
hint: `PACKAGE SIZE` ist effizient für die Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen. Verwenden Sie eine Schleife mit `FETCH NEXT CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flight_packages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_package_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flight_packages.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lv_cursor_id TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_current_package_size TYPE i VALUE 50.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR FINAL(lv_cursor) FOR
          SELECT * FROM sflights.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_flights PACKAGE SIZE lv_current_package_size.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          rv_package_count = rv_package_count + 1.
          " Here you would process lt_flights for the current package
          CLEAR lt_flights.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message=>default WITH lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_flight_packages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flight_packages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_package( ).
    DATA(lv_package_count) = lo_cut->count_flight_packages( ).

    " This test assumes SFLIGHTS has at least some data.
    " If SFLIGHTS has 100 entries, and package size is 50, count should be 2.
    " If SFLIGHTS has 101 entries, count should be 3.
    " For a robust test, you'd need to know the exact number of entries or insert test data.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_total_flights).
    IF lv_total_flights > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_package_count exp = 0 ).
      " Example: if total flights is 100, packages should be 2 (100/50)
      " if total flights is 101, packages should be 3 (ceil(101/50))
      DATA(lv_expected_packages) = ceil( lv_total_flights / 50 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_package_count exp = lv_expected_packages ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_package_count exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `PACKAGE SIZE` ist ein wichtiges Feature für die effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen, da es den Hauptspeicherverbrauch reduziert und die Datenbanklast optimiert. Die Daten werden in kleineren Blöcken (Paketen) aus der Datenbank gelesen, was besonders bei der Verarbeitung von Millionen von Datensätzen vorteilhaft ist. Die `DO...ENDDO`-Schleife mit `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` ist die Standardmethode hierfür.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, PACKAGE SIZE, Performance, Large Data, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Implementieren Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke zur feingranularen Fehlerbehandlung. Ein äußerer Block soll eine allgemeine Ausnahme abfangen, während ein innerer Block eine spezifische Ausnahme (z.B. Division durch Null) behandelt.
hint: Innere `TRY`-Blöcke fangen spezifischere Fehler ab, äußere Blöcke allgemeinere. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` um Ausnahmen weiterzuleiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_complex_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
        iv_val3 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS divide_and_add
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
        iv_add  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_and_add.
    rv_sum = ( iv_num1 / iv_num2 ) + iv_add.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_complex_calculation.
    TRY.
        " Outer TRY block for general errors
        DATA(lv_intermediate_result) = 0.
        TRY.
            " Inner TRY block for specific arithmetic errors
            lv_intermediate_result = divide_and_add( iv_num1 = iv_val1 iv_num2 = iv_val2 iv_add = iv_val3 ).
            rv_result_message = |Berechnung erfolgreich: { lv_intermediate_result }|.
          CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
            rv_result_message = |Spezifischer Fehler (Division): { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
            " Optionally re-raise or handle differently
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message=>default WITH rv_result_message.
        ENDTRY.

      CATCH cx_abap_message INTO DATA(lx_message_error).
        rv_result_message = |Allgemeiner Fehler (Nachricht): { lx_message_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_error).
        rv_result_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_nested_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_nested_inner_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_nested_outer_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_nested( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_complex_calculation( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 2 iv_val3 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Berechnung erfolgreich: 10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_nested_inner_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_nested( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_complex_calculation( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 0 iv_val3 = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Spezifischer Fehler (Division)' in = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_nested_outer_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_nested( ).
    " Simulate an error that might be caught by the outer block if re-raised
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_complex_calculation( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 0 iv_val3 = 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected an exception to be re-raised and caught by outer block' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message INTO DATA(lx_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Spezifischer Fehler (Division)' in = lx_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke ermöglichen eine sehr feingranulare Fehlerbehandlung. Der innere Block fängt spezifische Ausnahmen ab und kann diese entweder selbst behandeln oder in eine allgemeinere Ausnahme umwandeln und weiterleiten (`RAISE EXCEPTION`), die dann vom äußeren Block behandelt wird. Dies verbessert die Modularität und Lesbarkeit der Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Nested Exceptions, Error Handling, RAISE EXCEPTION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen `WHERE`-Clause für `OPEN CURSOR` basierend auf Benutzereingaben (simuliert durch Parameter). Filtern Sie `SFLIGHTS` nach `CARRID` und/oder `CONNID`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHERE (cond_string)` mit `OPEN CURSOR` für dynamische Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_cursor_id    TYPE cursor.

    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && | AND CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'|.
      ELSE.
        lv_where_clause = |CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
          OPEN CURSOR FINAL(lv_cursor) FOR
            SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
              FROM sflights
              WHERE (lv_where_clause).
        ELSE.
          OPEN CURSOR FINAL(lv_cursor) FOR
            SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
              FROM sflights.
        ENDIF.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights PACKAGE SIZE 100.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message=>default WITH lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_connid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_both FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_connid.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_both.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel mit `WHERE (cond_string)` ermöglicht es, die Filterbedingungen zur Laufzeit zu erstellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für flexible Suchfunktionen, bei denen die Kriterien von Benutzereingaben abhängen. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden hier verwendet, um die `WHERE`-Klausel lesbar zu konstruieren.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, Dynamic WHERE, Database, SFLIGHTS, String Templates

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und extrahieren Sie die Fehlermeldung mit `GET_TEXT()` aus dem Ausnahmeobjekt. Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die versucht, auf einen nicht-existierenden Index einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH ... INTO DATA(lx_exception)` und `lx_exception->GET_TEXT()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_element_from_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_element_from_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 'Element 1' TO lt_data.
    APPEND 'Element 2' TO lt_data.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_element) = lt_data[ iv_index ].
        rv_message = |Element an Index { iv_index }: { lv_element }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found INTO DATA(lx_itab_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler: { lx_itab_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_error).
        rv_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit einer `ORDER BY`-Klausel, um sortierte Flugdaten (nach `CARRID` aufsteigend und `FLDATE` absteigend) aus `SFLIGHTS` abzurufen.
hint: `ORDER BY` kann direkt in der `OPEN CURSOR` Anweisung verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_sorted,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_sorted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_sorted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_sorted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor_id TYPE cursor.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR FINAL(lv_cursor) FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
            FROM sflights
            ORDER BY carrid ASCENDING, fldate DESCENDING.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights PACKAGE SIZE 100.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message=>default WITH lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_order( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 1.
      " Verify sorting: CARRID ASC, FLDATE DESC
      DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_prev_fldate) TYPE sflight-fldate.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_current_flight).
        IF sy-tabix = 1.
          lv_prev_carrid = ls_current_flight-carrid.
          lv_prev_fldate = ls_current_flight-fldate.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.

        IF ls_current_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |CARRID not sorted ascending at index { sy-tabix }| ).
        ELSE IF ls_current_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid.
          IF ls_current_flight-fldate > lv_prev_fldate.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |FLDATE not sorted descending at index { sy-tabix } for CARRID { ls_current_flight-carrid }| ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        lv_prev_carrid = ls_current_flight-carrid.
        lv_prev_fldate = ls_current_flight-fldate.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel in `OPEN CURSOR` ermöglicht es, die Daten direkt auf der Datenbankebene zu sortieren, bevor sie in den Anwendungsserver übertragen werden. Dies ist in der Regel effizienter als eine nachträgliche Sortierung in ABAP, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. Die Kombination von auf- und absteigender Sortierung für verschiedene Felder ist hier demonstriert.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, ORDER BY, Sorting, Database, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Zeichenkette in Großbuchstaben umwandelt. Fangen Sie eine mögliche Ausnahme ab, falls die Eingabe zu lang ist und eine `CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` auslösen könnte (simuliert).
hint: Verwenden Sie `TO UPPER` und fangen Sie `CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_upper.
    TRY.
        " Simulate a potential error if string operations exceed bounds
        " In real ABAP, TO UPPER itself doesn't raise this for length, but other string ops might.
        " We simulate it for demonstration purposes.
        IF strlen( iv_input ) > 100000. " Arbitrary large number to simulate potential issue
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
        ENDIF.
        rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_range_error).
        rv_output = |Fehler (Bereichsüberschreitung): { lx_range_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_error).
        rv_output = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit einer `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ähnlichen Logik, um Flugdaten für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `SFLIGHTS` abzurufen. Simulieren Sie die Liste der Fluggesellschaften in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Sie können eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel mit `IN` verwenden, um die `FOR ALL ENTRIES`-Logik nachzubilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_cursor_id    TYPE cursor.

    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Build dynamic WHERE clause for IN operator
    DATA(lt_carrids_for_in) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_carrier IN it_carriers ( |'{ ls_carrier-carrid }'| ) ).
    lv_where_clause = |CARRID IN ({ REDUCE string(
                                      INIT s = ''
                                      FOR lv_carrid IN lt_carrids_for_in
                                      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN lv_carrid ELSE s && ',' && lv_carrid ) ) })|.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR FINAL(lv_cursor) FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
            FROM sflights
            WHERE (lv_where_clause).

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights PACKAGE SIZE 100.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message=>default WITH lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flights_for_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flights_for_empty_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_input_carriers) = VALUE zcl_open_cursor_fae=>tt_carrid(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_input_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flights_for_empty_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_fae( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Funktionalität von `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit `OPEN CURSOR` und einer dynamischen `WHERE`-Klausel nachbilden kann. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Liste der zu filternden Werte sehr groß ist oder dynamisch zur Laufzeit erstellt wird. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` und String-Templates zur Erstellung der `IN`-Liste ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, Dynamic WHERE, FOR ALL ENTRIES, REDUCE, String Templates, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...ENDTRY` mit `RAISE SHORTDUMP` innerhalb eines `CATCH`-Blocks, um einen Shortdump gezielt auszulösen, nachdem eine spezifische Ausnahme abgefangen wurde.
hint: `RAISE SHORTDUMP` ist eine moderne Möglichkeit, einen Shortdump zu erzeugen, um kritische, nicht behebbare Fehler zu signalisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_shortdump DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_shortdump_on_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_shortdump IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_shortdump_on_error.
    rv_message = 'Kein Shortdump ausgelöst'.
    TRY.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          " Simulate a critical error, e.g., division by zero
          DATA(lv_dummy) = 1 / 0.
        ENDIF.
        rv_message = 'Operation erfolgreich'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_message = |Arithmetischer Fehler: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }. Shortdump wird ausgelöst.|.
        RAISE SHORTDUMP lx_arith_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_error).
        rv_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_no_shortdump FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shortdump_triggered FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_no_shortdump.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_shortdump( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->trigger_shortdump_on_error( iv_trigger_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Operation erfolgreich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shortdump_triggered.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_shortdump( ).
    " Expecting a shortdump, so the method call itself should lead to an exception
    TRY.
        lo_cut->trigger_shortdump_on_error( iv_trigger_error = abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected a shortdump, but none occurred.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        " This catch block will not be reached if RAISE SHORTDUMP is executed
        " The test framework will catch the shortdump and report it.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Shortdump was not handled by test framework as expected.' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_error).
        " This is the expected behavior in a unit test when a shortdump is raised.
        " The test framework converts the shortdump into a test exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Arithmetischer Fehler' in = lx_root_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `RAISE SHORTDUMP` ist eine leistungsstarke Anweisung, um einen Shortdump gezielt auszulösen, wenn ein nicht behebbarer Fehler auftritt, der die weitere Programmausführung sinnlos macht. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `MESSAGE A` und bietet mehr Kontrolle über die Shortdump-Informationen, da das Ausnahmeobjekt übergeben werden kann. Es sollte sparsam und nur für wirklich kritische Fehler verwendet werden.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, RAISE SHORTDUMP, Shortdump, Critical Error, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `UP TO n ROWS` und `OFFSET m` um eine Paginierung von Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` zu implementieren.
hint: `UP TO n ROWS` und `OFFSET m` sind moderne SQL-Features für Paginierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_paging DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_page,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_page.
    TYPES tt_sflight_page TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_page WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_page_size TYPE i
        iv_offset    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_page.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_paging IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_page.
    DATA: lv_cursor_id TYPE cursor.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR FINAL(lv_cursor) FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
            FROM sflights
            ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate
            OFFSET iv_offset ROWS
            UP TO iv_page_size ROWS.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights PACKAGE SIZE iv_page_size.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message=>default WITH lx_sql_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_paging_empty_page FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_paging_first_page.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_paging( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_page1 ) exp = 2 ).
    " Further assertions to check content of page 1 if test data is known
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_paging_second_page.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_paging( ).
    DATA(lt_page2) = lo_cut->get_flights_page( iv_page_size = 2 iv_offset = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_page2 ) exp = 2 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_paging_empty_page.

explanation: `OFFSET n ROWS` und `UP TO m ROWS` sind moderne Open SQL-Erweiterungen (ab ABAP 7.50), die eine effiziente Paginierung direkt auf der Datenbank ermöglichen. Dies ist wesentlich performanter als das Lesen aller Daten und anschließendes Filtern in ABAP. In Kombination mit `OPEN CURSOR` kann man so große, paginierte Datensätze verarbeiten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Wenn eine Zahl negativ ist, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme (`ZCX_NEGATIVE_NUMBER`) ausgelöst und abgefangen werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` oder `CX_DYNAMIC_CHECK` erbt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_negative_number DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_number TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_number TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_negative_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_number = iv_number.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = VALUE scx_t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '001' attr1 = 'MV_NUMBER' ). " ZMSG 001: Negative Zahl &1 nicht erlaubt."
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING zcx_negative_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number < 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_negative_number EXPORTING iv_number = lv_number.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_message = 'Alle Zahlen sind gültig'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_positive_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_number FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_negative_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_custom_exception( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 5 ) ( 10 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Alle Zahlen sind gültig' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_custom_exception( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( -5 ) ( 10 ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_numbers( lt_numbers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected ZCX_NEGATIVE_NUMBER exception' ).
      CATCH zcx_negative_number INTO DATA(lx_neg_num).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_neg_num->mv_number exp = -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Negative Zahl' in = lx_neg_num->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Benutzerdefinierte Ausnahmen (`ZCX_NEGATIVE_NUMBER`) ermöglichen eine spezifischere Fehlerbehandlung, die auf die Geschäftslogik zugeschnitten ist. Durch die Vererbung von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` oder `CX_DYNAMIC_CHECK` und die Implementierung von `IF_T100_MESSAGE` können eigene Fehlermeldungen über das Nachrichten-Framework (Transaktion SE91) verwaltet werden, was die Wartbarkeit und Mehrsprachigkeit verbessert.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Custom Exception, ZCX_NEGATIVE_NUMBER, IF_T100_MESSAGE, RAISE EXCEPTION

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_price_for_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate  TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_for_flight.
    TRY.
        rv_price = it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid, connid = iv_connid, fldate = iv_fldate ]-price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle case where flight is not found
        rv_price = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder aus einer Quelltabelle enthält und dabei eine Transformation auf ein Feld anwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mapped,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             price_eur TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sflight_mapped.
    TYPES tt_sflight_mapped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mapped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights_to_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_mapped.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights_to_summary.
    rt_mapped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_raw_flights
      ( 
        flight_id = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate }|
        price_eur = COND p( WHEN flight-currency = 'USD' THEN flight-price * '0.90' " Simple conversion for demo
                            ELSE flight-price )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights.
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE zcl_sflight_mapper=>tt_sflight_raw.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_raw_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight1>).
    <fs_flight1>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight1>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight1>-fldate = '20251129'.
    <fs_flight1>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_flight1>-currency = 'EUR'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_raw_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight2>).
    <fs_flight2>-carrid = 'UA'.
    <fs_flight2>-connid = '0010'.
    <fs_flight2>-fldate = '20251130'.
    <fs_flight2>-price = '200.00'.
    <fs_flight2>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_sflight_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_mapped) = lo_mapper->map_flights_to_summary( lt_raw_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_mapped )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Two mapped flights expected'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_mapped[ 1 ]-flight_id
      exp = 'LH-0400-20251129'
      msg = 'First flight ID incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_mapped[ 1 ]-price_eur
      exp = '100.00'
      msg = 'First flight price incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_mapped[ 2 ]-flight_id
      exp = 'UA-0010-20251130'
      msg = 'Second flight ID incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_mapped[ 2 ]-price_eur
      exp = '180.00' " 200 * 0.90
      msg = 'Second flight price incorrect after conversion'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. String-Templates (`|...|`) und `COND` für bedingte Zuweisungen machen den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, COND, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( 0 ) )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_total_price_multiple.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_sflight_aggregator=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight1>).
    <fs_flight1>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight2>).
    <fs_flight2>-price = '25.50'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight3>).

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Akkumulationen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung auszudrücken, was den Code kürzer und fehlerresistenter macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der dynamische Werte und Berechnungen enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates (`|...|`) mit eingebetteten Ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_composer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compose_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

        iv_tax_rate TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_string_composer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compose_flight_info.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = iv_price * ( 1 + iv_tax_rate ).
    rv_info_string = |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid }: Preis { iv_price } EUR, inkl. MwSt. ({ iv_tax_rate * 100 }%): { lv_total_price } EUR|.

CLASS zcl_sflight_db_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf dem Preis: 'Günstig' (<100), 'Standard' (100-500), 'Teuer' (>500).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator für eine prägnante Fallunterscheidung.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_price_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_status.
    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      WHEN iv_price < 100 THEN 'Günstig'
      WHEN iv_price >= 100 AND iv_price <= 500 THEN 'Standard'
      WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN 'Teuer'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Methodenketten (Method Chaining) für mehrere Operationen an einem Objekt.
hint: Geben Sie `ME` aus den Methoden zurück, um Ketten zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_flight.

    METHODS set_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_flight.

    METHODS get_full_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_id) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_carrid.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_connid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_full_id.
    rv_full_id = |{ mv_carrid }-{ mv_connid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_flight) = NEW zcl_chainable_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_full_id) = lo_flight->set_carrid( 'LH' )->set_connid( '0400' )->get_full_id( ).
