explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenketten) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile verkettet werden. Dies wird durch das Zurückgeben einer Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) in den Setter-Methoden erreicht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Chaining, ME

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251129' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251129' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251129' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20251130' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251130' ) TO lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_ua_count) = lt_counts[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_count-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_flights_empty.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_all_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_counts ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion zur Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Gruppierungen direkt im ABAP-Code, ohne auf temporäre Tabellen oder manuelle Schleifen zurückgreifen zu müssen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in einen JSON-String.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 3 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_sflight pretty_print = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-age exp = 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-address-city exp = 'Testort' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_person-email ). " Email field is missing in JSON, should be initial
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `DESERIALIZE`-Methode von `/UI2/CL_JSON` ist tolerant gegenüber Abweichungen zwischen der JSON-Struktur und der ABAP-Zielstruktur. Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Deserialisieren eines ungültigen JSON-Strings in eine ABAP-Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für die Ausnahme CX_SY_JSON_PARSE_ERROR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string
                                   IMPORTING data = ls_data ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle (sflights) mit einer FOR-Expression, wobei die Filterkriterien durch Konstanten definiert sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Konstante im WHERE-Teil der FOR-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_with_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS: gc_target_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid VALUE 'LH',
               gc_min_price   TYPE sflight-price VALUE 500.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = gc_target_carrid AND price > gc_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_with_constants( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = zcl_filter_with_constants=>gc_target_carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > zcl_filter_with_constants=>gc_min_price ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` (ab ABAP 7.40) mit klassenweiten Konstanten für die Filterkriterien ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und lesbare Filterung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist ein Beispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Code, der die Absicht klar ausdrückt und 'Magic Values' vermeidet.
keywords: CONSTANTS, FILTER, Internal Table, Filtering, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in einen JSON-String, wobei bestimmte Felder umbenannt werden sollen (z.B. CARRID zu AirlineID).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Option `NAME_MAPPING` in `CL_UI2_CL_JSON=>SERIALIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_rename DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_flights_renamed
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_rename IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights_renamed.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight_source.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lt_name_mapping) = VALUE /ui2/cl_json=>json_name_mapping_tab(
        ( abap_name = 'CARRID' json_name = 'AirlineID' )
        ( abap_name = 'CONNID' json_name = 'FlightNumber' )
      ).

      rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_sflight
                                                name_mapping = lt_name_mapping
                                                pretty_print = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_serialize_flights_renamed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_flights_renamed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_rename( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_flights_renamed( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"AirlineID"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FlightNumber"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = 'CONNID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.55 bietet `CL_UI2_CL_JSON=>SERIALIZE` die Option `NAME_MAPPING`, um ABAP-Feldnamen beim Serialisieren in JSON-Feldnamen umzubenennen. Dies ist nützlich, um ABAP-Konventionen an externe JSON-Schnittstellen anzupassen, ohne die ABAP-Struktur selbst ändern zu müssen.
keywords: JSON, SERIALIZE, NAME_MAPPING, CL_UI2_CL_JSON, Field Renaming

explanation: Ähnlich wie bei der Serialisierung erlaubt `CL_UI2_CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE` ab ABAP 7.55 die Verwendung von `NAME_MAPPING`, um JSON-Feldnamen, die von den ABAP-Feldnamen abweichen, korrekt zuzuordnen. keywords: JSON, DESERIALIZE, NAME_MAPPING, CL_UI2_CL_JSON, Field Renaming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Deserialisierung eines XSTRING und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler ab, die durch ein ungültiges XSTRING-Format verursacht werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen von `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_deserialize_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS deserialize_safe IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
                                 RAISING   cx_sy_deserialization_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_deserialize_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_safe.
    DATA(lo_conv_obj) = NEW cl_abap_conv_obj( ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv_obj->deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            buffer = iv_xstring
          IMPORTING
            data = rs_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_deserialization_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_deserialization_error( text = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_deserialization_error.
    METHODS test_deserialize_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_error.
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) = '00'X. " Ungültiges XSTRING-Format
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_deserialize_error( ).
    " Erwartet, dass eine Ausnahme ausgelöst wird
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR'
        i_method_name = 'DESERIALIZE_SAFE'
        i_object = lo_cut
        i_parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_XSTRING' value = REF #( lv_invalid_xstring ) ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_success.
    DATA(ls_original_data) = VALUE zcl_deserialize_error=>ty_data( id = 1 name = 'Valid Data' ).
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_serialize_struct( ). " Assuming ZCL_SERIALIZE_STRUCT exists
    DATA(lv_valid_xstring) = lo_serializer->serialize_data( ls_original_data ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_deserialize_error( ).
    DATA(ls_deserialized_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_safe( lv_valid_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized_data-id exp = ls_original_data-id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der Deserialisierung von XSTRING-Daten ist es entscheidend, potenzielle Fehler abzufangen, die durch korrupte oder inkompatible Daten verursacht werden können. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit `CX_SY_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR` ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung und verhindert Programmabbrüche.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ, DESERIALIZE, Exception Handling, TRY...CATCH, CX_SY_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR, XSTRING

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtkapazität (Anzahl der Sitze).
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_grouped_capacity,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
        total_capacity TYPE i,
      END OF ty_grouped_capacity,
      tt_grouped_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_capacity) TYPE tt_grouped_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_capacity(
        carrid        = ls_group-carrid
        connid        = ls_group-connid
        total_capacity = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_grouped_capacity.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh_0400-total_capacity exp = 250 ).

Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und performanter als klassische Control-Break-Verarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )

    ).

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen Prozentsatz, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` zur direkten Modifikation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` für die direkte Modifikation von Tabellenzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage  TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights    TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid = iv_carrid.
        IF <fs_flight>-seatsmax > iv_min_capacity.
          <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der gebuchten Sitze für jede Flugverbindung innerhalb jeder Fluggesellschaft. Die Eingabetabelle ist nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung sortiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie die klassische `AT NEW`/`AT END` Control-Break-Verarbeitung. Beachten Sie die Sortierung der Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_booking_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      END OF ty_booking_data,
      tt_booking_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_booking_data
                        WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate. "Requires sorted table for AT NEW/END

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_connection_summary,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
        total_occupied TYPE i,
      END OF ty_connection_summary,
      tt_connection_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_booking_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_connection_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lv_current_conn_seats TYPE i.

    LOOP AT it_bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking).
      AT NEW connid.
        lv_current_conn_seats = 0.
      ENDAT.

      lv_current_conn_seats = lv_current_conn_seats + ls_booking-seatsocc.

      AT END connid.
        APPEND VALUE ty_connection_summary(
          carrid        = ls_booking-carrid
          connid        = ls_booking-connid
          total_occupied = lv_current_conn_seats
        ) TO rt_summary.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_date_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_date_range
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_date_from TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_date_to   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_date_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date_range.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      it_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      AND   fldate BETWEEN iv_date_from AND iv_date_to
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft und jede Flugverbindung die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzkapazität enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `VALUE` für die Aggregation und Strukturerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_conn_summary,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
        num_flights   TYPE i,
        avg_seatsmax  TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_conn_summary,
      tt_conn_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_conn_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connection_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_conn_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connection_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid connid = ls_group-connid )
      ( 
        carrid        = ls_group-carrid,
        connid        = ls_group-connid,
        num_flights   = GROUP SIZE,
        avg_seatsmax  = REDUCE decfloat16(
          INIT sum_seats = 0
          FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ) / GROUP SIZE
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation von Flugdaten durch, indem Sie eine neue interne Tabelle erstellen, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, die Verbindungs-ID und das Flugdatum enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `LET`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_raw,
      tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_light,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
      END OF ty_flight_light,
      tt_flight_light TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_light WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_light_flights) TYPE tt_flight_light.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_light_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_raw_flights
      LET lv_is_large_capacity = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > iv_min_capacity THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) IN
      WHERE ( lv_is_large_capacity = abap_true )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_raw,
      tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_connection_detail,
        connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
        num_flights   TYPE i,
        avg_seatsmax  TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_connection_detail,
      tt_connection_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection_detail WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connections   TYPE tt_connection_detail,
      END OF ty_carrier_summary,
      tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nested_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_flight_summary.
    rt_nested_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_carrier_group IN it_raw_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_carrier_group-carrid )
      ( 
        carrid = ls_carrier_group-carrid,
        connections = VALUE #( 
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_conn_group IN GROUP ls_carrier_group GROUP BY ( connid = ls_conn_group-connid )
          ( 
            connid        = ls_conn_group-connid,
            num_flights   = GROUP SIZE,
            avg_seatsmax  = REDUCE decfloat16(
              INIT sum_seats = 0
              FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_conn_group
              NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ) / GROUP SIZE
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität für jede Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit einer Vergleichslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_capacity_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_max_flight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_max_flight,
      tt_max_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_capacity_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE tt_max_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_capacity_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_capacity_flights.
    rt_max_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      ( 
        REDUCE ty_max_flight(
          INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_max_flight( seatsmax = 0 )
          FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-seatsmax > max_flight-seatsmax THEN <fs_flight> ELSE max_flight ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine bedingte Aggregation durch: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung innerhalb des `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_agg,
        carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
        total_seats_after_date TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrier_agg,
      tt_carrier_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_conditional_aggregation
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_date_threshold TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_agg) TYPE tt_carrier_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_aggregation.
    rt_carrier_agg = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      ( 
        carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        total_seats_after_date = REDUCE i(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group WHERE ( fldate > iv_date_threshold )
          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsmax )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_conn_info,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_conn_info,
      tt_conn_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_conn_info WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_filtered,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connections TYPE tt_conn_info,
      END OF ty_carrier_filtered,
      tt_carrier_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_carrier_connections
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_min_seats_for_carrier TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carrier_connections.
    rt_filtered_carriers = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_carrier_group IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_carrier_group-carrid )
      WHERE ( line_exists( GROUP ls_carrier_group[ seatsmax > iv_min_seats_for_carrier ] ) )
      ( 
        carrid = ls_carrier_group-carrid,
        connections = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_carrier_group
          ( connid = ls_flight-connid, seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_input,
           tt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

             number TYPE i,
           END OF ty_output,

      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR <fs_input> IN it_input
                         ( number = CONV i( <fs_input>-text ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von numerischen Werten in einer internen Tabelle von Strings, wobei die Strings vor der Addition in Integer konvertiert werden müssen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conv_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_from_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conv_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_from_strings.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR string_val IN it_strings
                       NEXT s = s + CONV i( string_val ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_conv_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id_str   TYPE string,
             value_str TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,
           BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id_int   TYPE i,
             value_dec TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_and_convert
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_conv_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_and_convert.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING id_int = CONV i( id_str )
                                                 value_dec = CONV decfloat16( value_str ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Elemente zu einer internen Tabelle hinzu, wobei die Werte aus einer anderen Tabelle stammen und während des Hinzufügens konvertiert werden müssen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT ... FROM VALUE` oder `APPEND ... FROM VALUE` mit `FOR` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_append_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id_char TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_str TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_line,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             id_int TYPE i,
             value_dec TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target_line,
           tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_with_conversion
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_append_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_with_conversion.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                         ( id_int = CONV i( ls_source-id_char )
                           value_dec = CONV decfloat16( ls_source-value_str ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_append_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_append_invalid_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_conversion.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_append_conv=>tt_source(
      ( id_char = '1' value_str = '10.5' )
      ( id_char = '2' value_str = '20.0' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_append_conv( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->append_with_conversion( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id_int exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value_dec exp = '10.5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id_int exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-value_dec exp = '20.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_append_invalid_conversion.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_append_conv=>tt_source(
      ( id_char = 'A' value_str = '10.5' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_append_conv( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      act = NEW zcx_sy_conversion_error( ) 
      exp = cx_sy_conversion_error 
      msg = 'Expected cx_sy_conversion_error' 
      ( lo_cut->append_with_conversion( lt_source ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `CONV` ermöglicht das deklarative Füllen und Transformieren interner Tabellen in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Methode, um Daten zwischen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Typen zu verschieben und dabei Konvertierungen durchzuführen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, CONV, Transformation

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die Datenalterungs-Temperatur für eine bestimmte Tabelle und einen bestimmten Mandanten. Dies ist ein Beispiel für die Verwendung der Klasse `cl_abap_stack_temperature` im Kontext der Datenalterung.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `GET_TABLE_TEMPERATURE` von `cl_abap_stack_temperature`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_temperature TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    METHODS get_table_aging_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_mandt      TYPE mandt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE ty_temperature.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_aging_temperature.
    TRY.
        rv_temperature = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_table_temperature(
          i_table_name = iv_table_name
          i_mandt      = iv_mandt
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_stack_temperature INTO DATA(lx_temp_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder Standardwert zurückgeben
        rv_temperature = 'E'. " Error
        MESSAGE lx_temp_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_check( ).
    " Annahme: Tabelle T000 existiert und hat eine Temperatur
    DATA(lv_temperature) = lo_cut->get_table_aging_temperature( iv_table_name = 'T000' iv_mandt = sy-mandt ).
    " Die genaue Temperatur kann variieren, daher prüfen wir nur, ob es nicht der Fehlerwert ist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_temperature exp = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_check( ).
    " Eine nicht existierende Tabelle sollte einen Fehler auslösen, der abgefangen wird
    DATA(lv_temperature) = lo_cut->get_table_aging_temperature( iv_table_name = 'Z_NON_EXISTENT' iv_mandt = sy-mandt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_temperature exp = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_stack_temperature` ist Teil des ABAP Data Aging Frameworks und ermöglicht die Abfrage der Temperatur von Tabellen. Dies ist entscheidend für Anwendungen, die datenalterungsfähige Objekte verwalten müssen. Die Methode `GET_TABLE_TEMPERATURE` liefert die aktuelle Temperatur (z.B. 'H' für Hot, 'C' für Cold). Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hier wichtig, da die Methode Ausnahmen auslösen kann.
keywords: cl_abap_stack_temperature, Data Aging, DB-Zugriff, Temperatur, Hot, Cold

Instructions: Formatieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in ein benutzerfreundliches Format, z.B. 'DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS', unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_format`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_format=>get_instance` und die Methoden `format_date` und `format_time`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_format_datetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_current_datetime
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_datetime) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_datetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_current_datetime.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lo_formatter) = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_date) = lo_formatter->format_date(
      date = lv_date
      format = cl_abap_format=>c_date_format_ext_long
    ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_time) = lo_formatter->format_time(
      time = lv_time
      format = cl_abap_format=>c_time_format_long
    ).

    rv_formatted_datetime = |{ lv_formatted_date } { lv_formatted_time }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_format_datetime( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_cut->format_current_datetime( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches_regex(
      act = lv_formatted
      pattern = '\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}'
      msg = 'Formatted date/time does not match expected pattern'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_format` bietet eine einfache und lokalisierungsunabhängige Möglichkeit, Datums- und Zeitwerte zu formatieren. Durch `get_instance` erhält man einen Formatierer, der dann mit vordefinierten Konstanten für verschiedene Formate verwendet werden kann. String-Templates vereinfachen die Zusammenführung der formatierten Teile.
keywords: cl_abap_format, Date, Time, Formatting, String Templates

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen Währungsbetrag (z.B. 12345.67 EUR) gemäß den lokalen Einstellungen unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_format`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_format=>get_instance` und die Methode `format_currency`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_format_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount  TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_currency TYPE sy-waers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_amount) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_amount.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( ).

    rv_formatted_amount = lo_formatter->format_currency(
      amount   = iv_amount
      currency = iv_currency
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_currency FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_currency.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_format_currency( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_eur) = lo_cut->format_amount( iv_amount = '12345.67' iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_usd) = lo_cut->format_amount( iv_amount = '9876.54' iv_currency = 'USD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches_regex(
      act = lv_formatted_eur
      pattern = '\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{3})*,\d{2} EUR|\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*\.\d{2} EUR'
      msg = 'Formatted EUR does not match expected pattern'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches_regex(
      act = lv_formatted_usd
      pattern = '\$\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*\.\d{2}|\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*\.\d{2} USD'
      msg = 'Formatted USD does not match expected pattern'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `format_currency`-Methode von `cl_abap_format` berücksichtigt automatisch die Währungseinstellungen und die Benutzereinstellungen für Dezimal- und Tausendertrennzeichen, was eine korrekte und lokalisierte Darstellung von Geldbeträgen gewährleistet. Dies ist besonders wichtig in internationalen Anwendungen.
keywords: cl_abap_format, Currency, Formatting, Numbers

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen String, indem Sie ihn auf eine bestimmte Länge auffüllen und ausrichten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_format=>get_instance` und die Methode `format_string` mit Padding- und Ausrichtungsoptionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_format_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_and_align_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_length       TYPE i
        iv_alignment    TYPE c DEFAULT 'L' " 'L' for Left, 'R' for Right, 'C' for Center
        iv_padding_char TYPE c DEFAULT ' '
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_and_align_string.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = cl_abap_format=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_alignment_enum) TYPE cl_abap_format=>t_alignment.

    CASE iv_alignment.
      WHEN 'L'.
        lv_alignment_enum = cl_abap_format=>c_alignment_left.
      WHEN 'R'.
        lv_alignment_enum = cl_abap_format=>c_alignment_right.
      WHEN 'C'.
        lv_alignment_enum = cl_abap_format=>c_alignment_center.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_alignment_enum = cl_abap_format=>c_alignment_left.
    ENDCASE.

    rv_formatted_string = lo_formatter->format_string(
      string        = iv_input_string
      length        = iv_length
      alignment     = lv_alignment_enum
      padding_char  = iv_padding_char
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_format_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_and_align_string( iv_input_string = 'Hello' iv_length = 10 iv_alignment = 'L' ) exp = 'Hello     ' msg = 'Left Align Failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_and_align_string( iv_input_string = 'Hello' iv_length = 10 iv_alignment = 'R' ) exp = '     Hello' msg = 'Right Align Failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_and_align_string( iv_input_string = 'Hello' iv_length = 10 iv_alignment = 'C' ) exp = '  Hello   ' msg = 'Center Align Failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_and_align_string( iv_input_string = 'ABAP' iv_length = 8 iv_padding_char = '*' ) exp = 'ABAP****' msg = 'Padding Char Failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_and_align_string( iv_input_string = 'Long String' iv_length = 5 ) exp = 'Long ' msg = 'Truncate Failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `format_string`-Methode von `cl_abap_format` bietet eine flexible Möglichkeit, Strings zu formatieren, indem sie auf eine bestimmte Länge aufgefüllt und ausgerichtet werden. Dies ist nützlich für die Erstellung von Berichten oder Ausgaben, die eine feste Spaltenbreite erfordern, und bietet eine moderne Alternative zu traditionellen `WRITE TO` oder `OVERLAY`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (Carrier ID, Connection ID). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Carrier IDs enthält, aber in Kleinbuchstaben umgewandelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `TO_LOWER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_itab_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_itab_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_carrids.
    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights ( to_lower( <fs_flight>-carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modern_itab_for( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_modern_itab_for=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result_carrids) = lo_cut->transform_carrids( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result_carrids )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Result table should contain 2 entries'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

keywords: FOR operator, Internal Tables, Transformation, TO_LOWER

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugsegmenten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_segment.
    TYPES: tt_flight_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_segments TYPE tt_flight_segments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
      FOR <fs_segment> IN it_segments
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_segment>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modern_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_input_segments) = VALUE zcl_modern_reduce=>tt_flight_segments(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '50.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_input_segments ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = '400.50'
      msg = 'Total price should be 400.50'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Iterationen, bei denen ein einzelner Wert aus einer internen Tabelle berechnet wird. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP` Schleifen und temporäre Variablen, was den Code funktionaler und weniger fehleranfällig macht.
keywords: REDUCE operator, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Sum

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf einen spezifischen Eintrag einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten mittels eines Tabellenausdrucks zu und geben Sie die Connection ID zurück. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.

CLASS zcl_modern_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

                       WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten (Carrier ID, Connection ID, Flight Date) aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` für einen bestimmten Carrier und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie die moderne `SELECT` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_modern_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.

    rt_flights = lt_sflight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren funktionalen Methoden, die String-Operationen (Trimmen, Großschreibung, Ersetzen) verkettet ausführen können, um einen String schrittweise zu transformieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `RETURNING VALUE(...)` und die Möglichkeit, Methodenaufrufe zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_string_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_string_builder.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_string_builder.
    METHODS replace_all
      IMPORTING
        iv_old TYPE string
        iv_new TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_string_builder.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_string_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    cl_abap_string_utilities=>trim( CHANGING cv_string = mv_current_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_current_string = to_upper( mv_current_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_all.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old IN mv_current_string WITH iv_new.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_string_ops FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_string_ops.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_string_builder( '  hello world  ' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->trim( )->to_upper( )->replace_all( iv_old = 'WORLD' iv_new = 'ABAP' )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'HELLO ABAP'
      msg = 'String should be "HELLO ABAP" after chaining operations'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, auch bekannt als Fluent Interface, ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes erheblich, da es eine "sprechende" API schafft. Jede Methode, die eine weitere Verkettung ermöglichen soll, gibt eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`me`) zurück.
keywords: Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Object Orientation, Functional Methods, String Processing

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Carrier ID und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Carrier. Nutzen Sie die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_modern_group_by=>tt_flights(

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_result_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-count exp = 1 msg = 'AA should have 1 flight' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_count-count exp = 1 msg = 'UA should have 1 flight' ).

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modern_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_modern_group_by=>tt_flights( ).

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung von Daten innerhalb einer internen Tabelle direkt im Loop. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke und lesbare Alternative zu manuellen Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` für Aggregationen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp (als String) erzeugt und mit einem Dummy-Eintrag füllt. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>GET_TABLE_DESCR` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_line        TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lr_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>get_table_descr( iv_table_type_name ).
        lr_line_descr  ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        CREATE DATA lr_line TYPE HANDLE lr_line_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                       <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                       <fs_comp>  TYPE ANY.

        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
        ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

        " Fill dummy data for the first component if it's a character type
        LOOP AT lr_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ( ls_comp-type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
                                ls_comp-type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string ).
            <fs_comp> = 'Dummy Value'.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

      CATCH cx_sy_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_table_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT_TAB' ). " SFLIGHT_TAB is a standard table type for SFLIGHT

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lr_table msg = 'Dynamic table should be created' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) exp = 1 msg = 'Table should contain one entry' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE ANY.
    READ TABLE <fs_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_line> msg = 'First line should be assigned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_table_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_table msg = 'No table should be created for invalid type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Programmierung mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und `CREATE DATA` ermöglicht es, Datenobjekte und Tabellen zur Laufzeit zu erzeugen, deren Typ erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder Schnittstellen, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen durchläuft und die erste Zahl zurückgibt, die größer als ein bestimmter Schwellenwert ist. Wenn keine solche Zahl gefunden wird, soll ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife in Kombination mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR`.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator kann eine `WHILE` Bedingung enthalten, um die Iteration vorzeitig zu beenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_while_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_greater_than
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_threshold  TYPE i
        iv_default    TYPE i DEFAULT 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_while_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_greater_than.
    rv_found_number = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = iv_default
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      WHILE result = iv_default " Continue as long as no number is found
      NEXT
        result = COND i(
          WHEN number > iv_threshold THEN number
          ELSE iv_default
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modern_while_reduce( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode mit optionalen Parametern enthält. Die Methode soll einen String verarbeiten und optional trimmen sowie in Großbuchstaben umwandeln, basierend auf den übergebenen Parametern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPTIONAL` für Parameter und `DEFAULT` Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optional_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_trim         TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL
        iv_to_upper     TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optional_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    rv_processed_string = iv_input_string.

    IF iv_trim = abap_true.
      cl_abap_string_utilities=>trim( CHANGING cv_string = rv_processed_string ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_to_upper = abap_true.
      rv_processed_string = to_upper( rv_processed_string ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Typ eines beliebigen übergebenen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit ermittelt und den Namen des Typs als String zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `GET_NAME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_name
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_name.
    DATA: lr_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    IF ir_data IS BOUND.
      lr_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data->* ).
      rv_type_name = lr_typedescr->get_name( ).
    ELSE.
      rv_type_name = 'UNBOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die das aktuelle Systemdatum und die Systemzeit in einem String-Template im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `sy-datum`, `sy-uzeit` und String-Templates mit Formatierungsoptionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_datetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_datetime_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_datetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_current_datetime.
    rv_datetime_string = |{ sy-datum DATE = ISO } { sy-uzeit TIME = ISO }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_formatted_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_formatted_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modern_datetime( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_current_datetime( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_date) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_expected_time) TYPE string.
    lv_expected_date = sy-datum.
    lv_expected_time = sy-uzeit.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches(
      act = lv_result
      exp = |{ lv_expected_date(4) }-{ lv_expected_date+4(2) }-{ lv_expected_date+6(2) } { lv_expected_time(2) }:{ lv_expected_time+2(2) }:{ lv_expected_time+4(2) }|
      msg = 'Formatted datetime should match YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates bieten leistungsstarke Formatierungsoptionen für Datum und Uhrzeit direkt im Template, wie `DATE = ISO` und `TIME = ISO`. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und lesbare Art, Datums- und Zeitwerte zu formatieren, ohne separate Konvertierungsfunktionen aufrufen zu müssen.
keywords: Date, Time, String Templates, SY-DATUM, SY-UZIET, Formatting

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für den `CL_GUI_ECL_VIEWERBOX`, z.B. wenn das Dokument nicht geladen werden kann oder ein ungültiger MIME-Typ übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke um die Methodenaufrufe des Viewers und fangen Sie relevante Ausnahmen ab (z.B. `CX_ECL_ERROR`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_document_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_content_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_mime_type       TYPE string
        iv_title           TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_document_safe.
    DATA: lo_dialog_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container,
          lo_ecl_viewer       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dialog_container
          EXPORTING
            width  = 800
            height = 600
            caption = iv_title.

        CREATE OBJECT lo_ecl_viewer
          EXPORTING
            parent = lo_dialog_container.

        lo_ecl_viewer->load_document(
          EXPORTING
            i_content_xstring = iv_content_xstring
            i_mime_type       = iv_mime_type
        ).

        lo_dialog_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_ecl_error INTO DATA(lx_ecl_error).
        MESSAGE lx_ecl_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " Log error or inform user appropriately
      CATCH cx_gui_errors INTO DATA(lx_gui_error).
        MESSAGE lx_gui_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " Log error or inform user appropriately
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " Catch any other unexpected errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für die Zeilenauswahl in einem ALV mit IDA, um auf Benutzerinteraktionen zu reagieren (z.B. eine Meldung mit den Details der ausgewählten Zeile auszugeben).
hint: Erstellen Sie eine lokale Event-Handler-Klasse, die `IF_SALV_GUI_TABLE_IDA_EVENTS` implementiert, und registrieren Sie diese mit `SET_HANDLER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ida_event_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_with_events
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_ida_alv TYPE REF TO if_salv_gui_table_ida.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FOR EVENTS double_click OF if_salv_gui_table_ida_events.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF if_salv_gui_table_ida_events
          IMPORTING
            e_row_id TYPE i.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_double_click.
        DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
        " In a real scenario, you would fetch the data for e_row_id from the ALV's data provider.
        " For simplicity, we simulate fetching data.
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight WHERE mandt = sy-mandt AND sflight_id = e_row_id.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          MESSAGE |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } ausgewählt. Datum: { ls_sflight-fldate }| TYPE 'I'.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE |Keine Daten für Zeile { e_row_id } gefunden.| TYPE 'W'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_event_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_with_events.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_event_handler    TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.

    mo_ida_alv = cl_salv_gui_table_ida_factory=>create_ida_table(
      iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      io_container  = lo_custom_container
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_event_handler.
    SET HANDLER lo_event_handler->on_double_click FOR mo_ida_alv->get_event_manager( ).

    mo_ida_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.

    METHODS display_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname.

          mo_ida_alv          TYPE REF TO if_salv_gui_table_ida.

CLASS zcl_ida_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_table.
    " Destroy previous ALV instance if exists to avoid issues
    IF mo_ida_alv IS BOUND.
      mo_ida_alv->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_ida_alv.
    ENDIF.

    mo_ida_alv = cl_salv_gui_table_ida_factory=>create_ida_table(
      iv_table_name = iv_table_name
      io_container  = mo_custom_container
    ).

    mo_ida_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_layout_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS display_sflight_with_layout
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name

CLASS zcl_ida_layout_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_with_layout.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_ida_alv          TYPE REF TO if_salv_gui_table_ida.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.

    lo_ida_alv = cl_salv_gui_table_ida_factory=>create_ida_table(
      iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      io_container  = lo_custom_container
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_ida_alv->load_layout( iv_layout_name = iv_layout_name ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        " Layout not found or other error, display default
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.

    lo_ida_alv->display( ).

    TRY.
        io_ida_alv->save_layout( iv_layout_name = iv_layout_name ).
        MESSAGE |Layout '{ iv_layout_name }' gespeichert.| TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_layout_handling.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,

    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ida_layout_alv( ).
    DATA(lv_layout_name) = 'TEST_IDA_LAYOUT'.

    TRY.
        " Attempt to load a layout (might not exist yet)
        lo_cut->display_sflight_with_layout( iv_container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' iv_layout_name = lv_layout_name ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected during layout load attempt' ).

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf seiner Auslastung. Wenn die Auslastung über 90% liegt, ist der Status 'Full', zwischen 50% und 90% ist er 'Partially Booked', und darunter ist er 'Available'. Nutzen Sie eine moderne CASE-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `CASE WHEN` Expression für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                               LET lv_occupancy = ( ls_sflight-booked / ls_sflight-max_occ ) * 100 IN
                               ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                 connid    = ls_sflight-connid,
                                 occupancy = lv_occupancy,
                                 status    = CASE WHEN lv_occupancy > 90 THEN 'Full'
                                                  WHEN lv_occupancy >= 50 THEN 'Partially Booked'
                                                  ELSE 'Available'
                                             END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' booked = 95 max_occ = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' booked = 60 max_occ = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250101' booked = 30 max_occ = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_full) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_full-status exp = 'Full' msg = 'Test Full' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_partially) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_partially-status exp = 'Partially Booked' msg = 'Test Partially Booked' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_available) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_available-status exp = 'Available' msg = 'Test Available' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE WHEN` Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung direkt im `VALUE #` Konstruktor, was den Code deutlich kürzer und funktionaler macht als traditionelle IF-ELSE-Blöcke.
keywords: CASE, WHEN, Expression, Conditional Logic, VALUE #, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche Auslastung. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `WHEN` für die Gruppierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `WHEN` in der Gruppierungsbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             number_of_flights TYPE i,
             average_occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lv_total_occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
                                               INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      CLEAR lv_total_occupancy.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_total_occupancy = lv_total_occupancy + ( ls_group_member-booked / ls_group_member-max_occ ) * 100.
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid          = ls_group_key-carrid
                      number_of_flights = lv_flight_count
                      average_occupancy = COND #( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_occupancy / lv_flight_count ELSE 0 ) )
        TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' booked = 90 max_occ = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' booked = 80 max_occ = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' booked = 70 max_occ = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two groups expected' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-number_of_flights exp = 2 msg = 'LH flight count' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-average_occupancy exp = '85.00' msg = 'LH average occupancy' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-number_of_flights exp = 1 msg = 'AA flight count' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-average_occupancy exp = '70.00' msg = 'AA average occupancy' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result msg = 'Empty table should result in empty result' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `COND #` für die bedingte Zuweisung des Durchschnitts wird der Code sehr ausdrucksstark und effizient für Datenanalysen.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, WHEN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, COND #
