Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`) in ein XSTRING, das die Tabelle als generischen Container repräsentiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>FILL_CONTAINER_C` und `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES=>READ_CONTAINER_X`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_table_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_container) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_table_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lv_container_c) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_c( it_sflights ).
    rx_container = cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_x( lv_container_c ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_to_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_to_xstring.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251224' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251225' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_table_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lx_result) = lo_cut->table_to_xstring( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_result msg = 'XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Optional: Rückkonvertierung zur Verifizierung (siehe CON_002)
    DATA(lv_container_x) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_x( lx_result ).
    DATA(lt_converted_back) = CAST zcl_con_table_to_xstring=>tt_sflight(
                                 cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_c( lv_container_x ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_converted_back ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl Zeilen nach Rückkonvertierung falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted_back[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Erste Zeile Carried falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden `FILL_CONTAINER_C` und `READ_CONTAINER_X` der `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES` ermöglichen die Serialisierung einer internen Tabelle in ein generisches binäres Format (XSTRING). Dies ist nützlich für die Speicherung oder Übertragung von strukturierten Daten, ohne sich um spezifische Formate wie JSON oder XML kümmern zu müssen.
keywords: Internal Table, XSTRING, Serialization, CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES, SFLIGHTS, Container Programmierung

CLASS zcl_con_compare_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

        ix_xstring1 TYPE xstring
        ix_xstring2 TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_con_compare_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_xstrings.
    rv_are_equal = cl_abap_container_utilities=>compare_xstrings(

      i_xstring2 = ix_xstring2

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_xstrings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_compare_xstring( ).

    DATA(lx_xstring1) = '414243'. " ABC
    DATA(lx_xstring2) = '414243'. " ABC
    DATA(lx_xstring3) = '414244'. " ABD

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->compare_xstrings( ix_xstring1 = lx_xstring1 ix_xstring2 = lx_xstring2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_result msg = 'Gleiche XSTRINGs sollten gleich sein' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->compare_xstrings( ix_xstring1 = lx_xstring1 ix_xstring2 = lx_xstring3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_result msg = 'Ungleiche XSTRINGs sollten ungleich sein' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->compare_xstrings( ix_xstring1 = lx_xstring1 ix_xstring2 = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_result msg = 'Vergleich mit leerem XSTRING falsch' ).

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen EAN13-Barcode als BMP-Grafik für eine gegebene Nummer. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Eingabe validiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` und String-Templates für die Datenaufbereitung. Fangen Sie mögliche Ausnahmen ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bar_ean13_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_ean13
      IMPORTING
        iv_ean13_number TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_barcode_bmp) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_ean13_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_ean13.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
    DATA(lv_barcode_data) = |EAN13 { iv_ean13_number }|. " Modern String Template

    IF strlen( iv_ean13_number ) <> 13 OR NOT iv_ean13_number CO '0123456789'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_rstx_barcode_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_rstx_barcode_error=>invalid_barcode_data.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        rv_barcode_bmp = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
            i_barcode_type = 'EAN13'
            i_barcode_data = lv_barcode_data
            i_width        = 200
            i_height       = 100
            i_resolution   = 300
        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Barcode BMP should have content' exp = 0 act = xstrlen( lv_barcode_bmp ) ).

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Code128-Barcode, dessen Inhalt aus einer dynamisch erzeugten Zeichenkette besteht, die Produkt-ID und Menge aus einer internen Tabelle `sflights` kombiniert. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Daten aus `sflights` zu einer einzelnen Zeichenkette zu aggregieren, die dann für den Barcode verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bar_code128_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_code128_from_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_barcode_bmp) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_code128_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_code128_from_sflight.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    DATA(lv_barcode_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT s = s && |{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate }-{ flight-planetype }|
    ).

    IF lv_barcode_content IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_rstx_barcode_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_rstx_barcode_error=>invalid_barcode_data.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        rv_barcode_bmp = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
            i_barcode_type = 'CODE128'
            i_barcode_data = lv_barcode_content
            i_width        = 300
            i_height       = 100
            i_resolution   = 300
        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_cond_type_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS generate_conditional_barcode
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_barcode_bmp) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.

CLASS zcl_bar_cond_type_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_conditional_barcode.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    DATA(lv_barcode_type) = COND string(
      WHEN strlen( iv_data ) = 13 THEN 'EAN13'
      ELSE 'QR'

    TRY.
        rv_barcode_bmp = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
            i_barcode_type = lv_barcode_type
            i_barcode_data = iv_data
            i_width        = 250
            i_height       = 100
            i_resolution   = 300
        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE lx_error.

hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um die Flugdaten in 3D-Objekt-Eigenschaften umzuwandeln. Nutzen Sie `sflights` als Datenquelle.

CLASS zcl_3dv_sflight_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_objects.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.
    rt_objects = VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights
                            WHERE ( carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND connid IS NOT INITIAL )
                            ( name  = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|

                                        WHEN flight-planetype = 'AIRBUS A320' THEN 'GREEN'
                                        ELSE 'GREY'
                                      )

                              pos_y = 0.0
                              pos_z = 0.0 ) THEN (
                                lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
                                IF lv_counter >= iv_max_objects.

                                ENDIF.
                            ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Position (X, Y, Z) einer Menge von 3D-Punkten und geben Sie diese zurück. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Struktur, um die Summe der X-, Y- und Z-Koordinaten zu akkumulieren und dann den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_point,
         x TYPE f,
         y TYPE f,
         z TYPE f,
       END OF ty_point.
TYPES: tt_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_3dv_avg_position DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_position
      IMPORTING
        it_points TYPE tt_points
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_avg_point) TYPE ty_point.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dv_avg_position IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_position.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_points ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      CLEAR rs_avg_point.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_sum) = REDUCE ty_point(
      INIT s = VALUE ty_point( x = 0.0 y = 0.0 z = 0.0 )
      FOR point IN it_points
      NEXT s-x = s-x + point-x,
           s-y = s-y + point-y,
           s-z = s-z + point-z
    ).

    rs_avg_point-x = ls_sum-x / lv_count.
    rs_avg_point-y = ls_sum-y / lv_count.
    rs_avg_point-z = ls_sum-z / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Data Matrix Barcode, dessen Inhalt aus einer Liste von Werten besteht, die durch Kommas getrennt sind. Die Liste soll aus einer internen Tabelle mit `REDUCE` erstellt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Elemente der internen Tabelle zu einer einzelnen, komma-separierten Zeichenkette zu verbinden.
solution:
TYPES: tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_bar_data_matrix_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_data_matrix
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE tt_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_barcode_bmp) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_data_matrix_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_data_matrix.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    DATA(lv_barcode_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR value IN it_values
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN value
                 ELSE s && ',' && value
               )
    ).

    IF lv_barcode_content IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_rstx_barcode_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_rstx_barcode_error=>invalid_barcode_data.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        rv_barcode_bmp = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
            i_barcode_type = 'DATAMATRIX'
            i_barcode_data = lv_barcode_content
            i_width        = 150
            i_height       = 150
            i_resolution   = 300
        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und generieren Sie für jede Gruppe einen QR-Code, der eine Zusammenfassung der Flüge enthält. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und eine `FOR`-Expression, um die gruppierten Daten zu verarbeiten und QR-Codes zu generieren.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         num_flights TYPE i,
         total_passengers TYPE i,
       END OF ty_flight_summary.
TYPES: tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_barcode,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         barcode_bmp TYPE xstring,
       END OF ty_grouped_barcode.
TYPES: tt_grouped_barcodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_barcode WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_bar_grouped_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_grouped_qrs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_barcodes) TYPE tt_grouped_barcodes
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_grouped_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_grouped_qrs.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        num_flights = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT c = c + 1 )
        total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT p = 0 FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT p = p + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc )
      ).

      DATA(lv_qr_content) = |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_summary-carrid }\nAnzahl Flüge: { ls_summary-num_flights }\nGesamtpassagiere: { ls_summary-total_passengers }|.

      DATA(lv_barcode_bmp) = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
          i_barcode_type = 'QR'
          i_barcode_data = lv_qr_content
          i_width        = 200
          i_height       = 200
          i_resolution   = 300
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_barcode( carrid = ls_summary-carrid barcode_bmp = lv_barcode_bmp ) TO rt_grouped_barcodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_grouped_qrs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_grouped_qrs.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bar_grouped_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_barcodes) = lo_cut->generate_grouped_qrs( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped barcodes should not be empty' act = lt_grouped_barcodes ).
    LOOP AT lt_grouped_barcodes INTO DATA(ls_grouped_barcode).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Each barcode BMP should have content' act = ls_grouped_barcode-barcode_bmp ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = ls_grouped_barcode-carrid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates. Es gruppiert Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft, berechnet eine Zusammenfassung für jede Gruppe und generiert dann einen QR-Code mit diesen zusammengefassten Informationen. Dies zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Datenverarbeitung und -visualisierung.
keywords: Barcode, QR Code, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, String Template

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für eine Liste von 3D-Objekten, die jeweils ein Erstellungsdatum haben, wie viele Tage seit ihrer Erstellung vergangen sind. Nutzen Sie moderne Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Datumsarithmetik in ABAP, um die Differenz zwischen zwei Daten zu berechnen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dated_object,
         id          TYPE string,
         creation_date TYPE d,
         days_old    TYPE i,
       END OF ty_dated_object.
TYPES: tt_dated_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dated_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_3dv_date_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_object_age
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_dated_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_objects_with_age) TYPE tt_dated_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dv_date_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_object_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_objects_with_age = VALUE #( FOR object IN it_objects
                                   ( object WITH days_old = lv_current_date - object-creation_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_age FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_age_future FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_age.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_date_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_yesterday) = lv_today - 1.
    DATA(lt_objects) = VALUE tt_dated_objects(
      ( id = 'OldObj' creation_date = lv_yesterday )
      ( id = 'TodayObj' creation_date = lv_today )
    ).
    DATA(lt_objects_with_age) = lo_cut->calculate_object_age( lt_objects ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_objects_with_age[ 1 ]-days_old exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_objects_with_age[ 2 ]-days_old exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_age_future.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3dv_date_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = lv_today + 1.
    DATA(lt_objects) = VALUE tt_dated_objects(
      ( id = 'FutureObj' creation_date = lv_tomorrow )
    ).
    DATA(lt_objects_with_age) = lo_cut->calculate_object_age( lt_objects ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_objects_with_age[ 1 ]-days_old exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die direkte Datumsarithmetik in ABAP, um die Differenz in Tagen zwischen dem aktuellen Datum und dem Erstellungsdatum eines 3D-Objekts zu berechnen. Die `FOR`-Expression mit `WITH` ermöglicht es, ein neues Feld (`days_old`) in der internen Tabelle zu füllen, ohne die ursprünglichen Daten zu ändern, was eine sehr funktionale Herangehensweise darstellt.
keywords: 3D Viewer, Date/Time, Date Arithmetic, FOR Expression, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus einer bestehenden Tabelle enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE #( ... )` um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_full,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_full.
    TYPES tt_flights_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
    TYPES tt_flights_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_full TYPE tt_flights_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_short) TYPE tt_flights_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights.
    rt_flights_short = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_full
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights.
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_expression=>tt_flights_full(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LOS ANGELES' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_output_flights) = lo_cut->map_flights( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_output_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight_short).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_short-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_short-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt explizit zu loopen und `APPEND` zu verwenden, wird die neue Tabelle deklarativ aus den Elementen der Quelltabelle erzeugt.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Mapping, Functional Programming

        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_time) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_flight_time.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate fltime
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_time = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                              NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-fltime ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate fltime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight 
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fltime >= iv_min_fltime ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String basierend auf einem regulären Ausdruck in eine interne Tabelle von Teilstrings auf. Der reguläre Ausdruck soll ein oder mehrere Leerzeichen als Trennzeichen erkennen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` in Kombination mit `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und `substring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_length TYPE i.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX iv_pattern IN iv_input RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    IF lt_matches IS INITIAL.
      APPEND iv_input TO rt_result.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      lv_length = ls_match-offset - lv_offset.
      IF lv_length > 0.
        APPEND iv_input+lv_offset(lv_length) TO rt_result.
      ENDIF.
      lv_offset = ls_match-offset + ls_match-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add the remaining part after the last match
    lv_length = strlen( iv_input ) - lv_offset.
    IF lv_length > 0.
      APPEND iv_input+lv_offset(lv_length) TO rt_result.
    ENDIF.

    " Remove empty strings if the pattern matches at the beginning or end
    DELETE rt_result WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_regex_split_spaces FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_regex_split_commas_and_spaces FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_regex_split_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_regex_split_leading_trailing FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_regex_split_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_split_regex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_input = 'Hallo   Welt' iv_pattern = '\s+' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Hallo' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Welt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_regex_split_commas_and_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_split_regex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_input = 'Apfel, Birne , Kirsche' iv_pattern = ',\s*' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Apfel' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Birne' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'Kirsche' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_regex_split_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_split_regex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_input = 'EinWort' iv_pattern = '\s+' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'EinWort' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_regex_split_leading_trailing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_split_regex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_input = '  Anfang Ende  ' iv_pattern = '\s+' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Anfang' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Ende' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Direktes Regex-Splitting wie in anderen Sprachen ist in ABAP nicht als einzelne `SPLIT` Anweisung verfügbar. Diese Lösung demonstriert eine moderne und effiziente Methode, dies mit `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` zu erreichen. Die gefundenen Match-Positionen werden genutzt, um die Substrings mittels Offset- und Längenangaben (`iv_input+lv_offset(lv_length)`) zu extrahieren. Dies ist flexibler als feste Trennzeichen und seit ABAP 7.52 mit der verbesserten Regex-Engine sehr performant.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in Komponenten auf und weisen Sie diese direkt in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen zu, wobei jede Struktur die aufgeteilten Werte enthält. Nutzen Sie hierfür `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SPLIT` mit `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR` für die effiziente Zuweisung.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
         part1 TYPE string,
         part2 TYPE string,
         part3 TYPE string,
       END OF ty_component.
TYPES: tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_str_split_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_map
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_map.
    DATA(lt_raw_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_raw_parts.

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR <part> IN lt_raw_parts
                               LET lv_p1 = substring( val = <part> off = 0 len = 1 )
                                   lv_p2 = substring( val = <part> off = 1 len = 1 )
                                   lv_p3 = substring( val = <part> off = 2 len = 1 ) IN
                               ( part1 = lv_p1, part2 = lv_p2, part3 = lv_p3 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie einen mehrzeiligen String. Teilen Sie jede Zeile an einem Semikolon auf und aggregieren Sie die ersten Teile jeder Zeile zu einem neuen, durch Kommas getrennten String. Nutzen Sie hierfür `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `SPLIT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `SPLIT` für die Zeilenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_aggregate
      IMPORTING
        iv_multiline_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_aggregated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_aggregate.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_multiline_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    rv_aggregated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR line IN lt_lines
      LET lv_first_part = COND string( WHEN line IS NOT INITIAL THEN
                                          substring_before( val = line sep = ';' )
                                        ELSE '' ) IN
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN lv_first_part
                                 ELSE result && ',' && lv_first_part ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `SPLIT` und dem `REDUCE` Operator, um komplexe String-Verarbeitungs- und Aggregationsaufgaben in einer einzigen, funktionalen Expression zu lösen. Zuerst wird der mehrzeilige String in einzelne Zeilen aufgeteilt. Anschließend iteriert `REDUCE` über diese Zeilen, extrahiert den Teil vor dem Semikolon (`substring_before`) und konkateniert diese Teile zu einem neuen String. Die `COND` Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` sorgt für eine korrekte Komma-Trennung. Diese Syntax ist seit ABAP 7.50 verfügbar und ermöglicht sehr kompakten und ausdrucksstarken Code für Datenaggregationen.
keywords: SPLIT, REDUCE, String, Aggregation, String Templates, 7.50

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_text_in_control
      IMPORTING
        it_text_lines TYPE string_table
        iv_container_name TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_text_in_control.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_dynpro_dynpro_link = 5
        OTHERS = 6.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        OTHERS = 5.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des TextEdit Controls' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream
      EXPORTING
        text = it_text_lines.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_text.
    " In einem echten Unit-Test kann ein GUI-Control nicht direkt instanziiert werden.
    " Hier wird nur der Aufruf der Methode simuliert und geprüft, ob keine Dumps auftreten.
    " Für eine vollständige GUI-Testabdeckung wären UI-Tests (z.B. mit eCATT) notwendig.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_textedit_display( ).
    DATA(lt_test_text) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Erste Zeile' ) ( 'Zweite Zeile' ) ).

    TRY.
        " Annahme: 'DYNPRO_CONTAINER' ist ein existierender Custom Container auf einem Dynpro.
        " In einem echten Unit-Test würde dies fehlschlagen, da kein Dynpro aktiv ist.
        " Für die Demonstration wird hier ein Dummy-Container-Name verwendet.
        lo_cut->display_text_in_control( it_text_lines = lt_test_text iv_container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Methode wurde ohne direkten Fehler aufgerufen" ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        " Erwarteter Fehler in einer Nicht-GUI-Umgebung, daher als Erfolg werten für den Testzweck.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " GUI-Fehler erwartet, Test erfolgreich" ).
    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt eines `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` Controls aus und teilen Sie ihn zeilenweise in eine interne Tabelle auf.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_get_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_and_split_text
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_get_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_split_text.
    DATA: lt_raw_text TYPE string_table.

    IF io_textedit IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD io_textedit->get_text_as_stream
        IMPORTING
          text = lt_raw_text.

      " The text is already returned as a table of lines by get_text_as_stream
      " No further SPLIT by CR_LF is needed if it's already line-by-line.
      " If it were a single string, SPLIT would be used.
      rt_lines = lt_raw_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_container_name TYPE string

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_update_textedit.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.

      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
      EXCEPTIONS

      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.

    IF io_textedit IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.

      ( |Aktualisiert am: { lv_formatted_timestamp }| )

    ).

    CALL METHOD io_textedit->set_text_as_stream
      EXPORTING
        text = lt_new_text.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle um 10%, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' durchgeführt werden, unter Verwendung von Feldsymbolen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` und den `WHERE` Zusatz, um Zeilen direkt zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_modify_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_modify_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_prices.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights. "Kopie für die Modifikation

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_prices.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_test_data TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_line>).
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_line>-connid = '0400'. <fs_line>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_line>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_line>-connid = '0017'. <fs_line>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_line>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_line>-connid = '0401'. <fs_line>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_line>-price = '150.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_modify_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->modify_flight_prices( lt_test_data ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_line> WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'LH 0400 price incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_line> WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'AA 0017 price incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_line> WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-price exp = '165.00' msg = 'LH 0401 price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Wert eines dynamisch angegebenen Feldes einer Struktur ausliest und als String zurückgibt. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass das Feld nicht existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_assign_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_fieldname TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_fieldname }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <fs_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_access=>ty_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_test_data-field3 = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_fieldname = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field1 value incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_fieldname = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' msg = 'Field2 value incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_field_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) TYPE zcl_fs_dynamic_access=>ty_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Test'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>create_exception_assertion(
        class_name = 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR'
        method_call = cl_abap_unit_assert=>create_method_call(
          object = lo_cut
          method = 'GET_DYNAMIC_FIELD_VALUE'
          parameters = VALUE #(
            ( name = 'IS_DATA' value = REF #( ls_test_data ) )
            ( name = 'IV_FIELDNAME' value = REF #( 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' ) )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie einen gegebenen String in ein ZIP-Archiv und geben Sie die binären Daten des ZIP-Archivs (XSTRING) zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` und die Methode `add` für den Inhalt und `save` zum Erstellen des Archivs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_compress_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_string_to_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'data.txt'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_string_to_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
                              EXPORTING
                                data = iv_data
                                encoding = 'UTF-8'
                            ).
    lo_zip->add(
      EXPORTING
        name    = iv_filename
        content = lv_xstring_data
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_compress_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_compress_string( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Dies ist ein Teststring, der komprimiert werden soll.'.
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->compress_string_to_zip( lv_test_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_zip_xstring msg = 'Compressed xstring is empty' ).

    DATA(lo_unzip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_unzip->load( EXPORTING zip = lv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_files) = lo_unzip->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_files ) exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect number of files in zip' ).

    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = lo_unzip->get( EXPORTING name = 'data.txt' ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_string(
                                      EXPORTING
                                        xdata = lv_decompressed_xstring
                                        encoding = 'UTF-8'
                                    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decompressed_string exp = lv_test_string msg = 'Decompressed string does not match original' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Dekomprimieren Sie ein gegebenes ZIP-Archiv (als XSTRING) und geben Sie den Inhalt einer bestimmten Datei als String zurück. Behandeln Sie Fehler, falls die Datei nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` und die Methoden `load` und `get`. Fangen Sie `cx_abap_zip_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_zip_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_zip_to_string.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( EXPORTING zip = iv_zip_xstring ).
        DATA(lv_xstring_data) = lo_zip->get( EXPORTING name = iv_filename ).
        rv_data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_string(
                                          EXPORTING
                                            xdata = lv_xstring_data
                                            encoding = 'UTF-8'
                                        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_zip_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_zip_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei der Schlüssel dynamisch zur Laufzeit als Feldname und Wert übergeben wird. Geben Sie die gefundene Zeile zurück oder lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` mit `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY (<fs>) = <value>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_dynamic_key
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_key_field TYPE string
        iv_key_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_key.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_key_component> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> INDEX 1. "Dummy read to get structure for ASSIGN COMPONENT
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Internal table is empty'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_key_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_key_component>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Key field '{ iv_key_field }' not found in structure.|.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WITH KEY (<fs_key_component>) = iv_key_value.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |No entry found for { iv_key_field } = '{ iv_key_value }'.|.
    ENDIF.

    rs_sflight = <fs_sflight>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv, das mehrere Textdateien mit unterschiedlichen Inhalten enthält.
hint: Rufen Sie die `add`-Methode von `cl_abap_zip` mehrmals auf, um jede Datei hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_multi_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_content,
             filename TYPE string,
             content  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_content.
    TYPES tt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_content WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_multi_file_zip
      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_content
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_file_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
                                    EXPORTING
                                      data = ls_file-content
                                      encoding = 'UTF-8'
                                  ).
      lo_zip->add(
        EXPORTING
          name    = ls_file-filename
          content = lv_xstring_content
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach einem dynamisch übergebenen Feld sortiert. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole für den dynamischen Zugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT itab BY (<fs_field>)` nach dem Zuweisen des Feldsymbols zum Sortierfeld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_dynamically.
    rt_sorted_flights = it_sflights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sort_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight.

    " Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols zu einer Komponente einer Zeile
    " Dies ist notwendig, um die Struktur für ASSIGN COMPONENT zu erhalten
    READ TABLE rt_sorted_flights ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Tabelle ist leer, keine Sortierung notwendig
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_sort_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_sort_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Sortierfeld '{ iv_sort_field }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamische Sortierung mit dem Feldsymbol
    SORT rt_sorted_flights BY (<fs_sort_field>).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_sflight_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_zip_sflight_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_sflight_json.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_conv_json=>create_json_writer(
                                pretty_print = abap_true
                              )->write(
                                data = it_sflights
                              )->get_json( ).

    DATA(lv_json_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
                                EXPORTING
                                  data = lv_json_string
                                  encoding = 'UTF-8'
                              ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      EXPORTING
        name    = iv_filename
        content = lv_json_xstring
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach einem dynamisch übergebenen Feld und Wert. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole und die moderne `FILTER`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit einem Feldsymbol, das auf das Filterfeld zeigt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_filter_field TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_filter_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. "Tabelle ist leer
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_filter_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_filter_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Filterfeld '{ iv_filter_field }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE (<fs_filter_field>) = iv_filter_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) aus einer JSON-Datei, die in einem ZIP-Archiv enthalten ist. Die JSON-Datei muss zuerst dekomprimiert und dann deserialisiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_zip` zum Dekomprimieren und `cl_abap_conv_json` zur Deserialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_read_sflight_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflight_from_zip_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename    TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights.json'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error
        cx_abap_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_read_sflight_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_from_zip_json.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( EXPORTING zip = iv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_json_xstring) = lo_zip->get( EXPORTING name = iv_filename ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_string(
                                EXPORTING
                                  xdata = lv_json_xstring
                                  encoding = 'UTF-8'
                              ).

    cl_abap_conv_json=>create_json_reader(
      json_string = lv_json_string
    )->read(
      data = rt_sflights
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) in eine neue Tabelle transformiert, wobei ein dynamisch angegebenes Feld in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wird. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole und die `FOR`-Iteration.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `ASSIGNING <fs>` und `CONV` oder `TO UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_to_upper_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_to_upper TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_to_upper_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source_line> TYPE ty_sflight.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols zu einer Komponente einer Zeile
    READ TABLE it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_source_line> INDEX 1.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_to_upper OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_to_upper }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_source_line> IN it_sflights
                                      LET ls_target_line = <fs_source_line>
                                          lv_temp_value = <fs_source_field> IN
                                      ( <fs_source_line> )
                                    ).

    LOOP AT rt_transformed_flights ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_to_upper OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_target_field> = to_upper( <fs_target_field> ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_list_files DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rt_filenames) TYPE string_table

CLASS zcl_zip_list_files IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD list_zip_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( EXPORTING zip = iv_zip_xstring ).

    rt_filenames = VALUE #( FOR ls_file_info IN lt_file_info ( ls_file_info-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein passwortgeschütztes ZIP-Archiv aus einem String. (Hinweis: `cl_abap_zip` unterstützt keine direkte Passwortverschlüsselung, aber das Beispiel soll die Verwendung von `cl_abap_zip` mit einer 'simulierten' Verschlüsselung demonstrieren, z.B. durch Hinzufügen eines verschlüsselten Inhalts.)
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` und eine separate Verschlüsselungsklasse (z.B. `cl_abap_hmac` oder `cl_abap_uuid` für eine einfache 'Verschlüsselungssimulation') für den Inhalt, bevor Sie ihn dem ZIP hinzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_password_protected DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_protected_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_data     TYPE string
        iv_password TYPE string
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'protected_data.txt'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_password_protected IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_protected_zip.
    " In einer realen Anwendung würde hier eine echte Verschlüsselung stattfinden.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir eine 'Verschlüsselung' durch Hinzufügen des Passworts zum Inhalt.
    DATA(lv_encrypted_data) = |{ iv_password }:{ iv_data }|.

    DATA(lv_xstring_data) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
                                EXPORTING
                                  data = lv_encrypted_data
                                  encoding = 'UTF-8'
                              ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      EXPORTING
        name    = iv_filename
        content = lv_xstring_data
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_protected_zip FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_protected_zip.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_password_protected( ).
    DATA(lv_original_data) = 'Secret Information'.
    DATA(lv_password) = 'MySecretPassword'.
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->create_protected_zip( iv_data = lv_original_data iv_password = lv_password ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_zip_xstring msg = 'Compressed xstring is empty' ).

    DATA(lo_unzip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_unzip->load( EXPORTING zip = lv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = lo_unzip->get( EXPORTING name = 'protected_data.txt' ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_string(
                                      EXPORTING
                                        xdata = lv_decompressed_xstring
                                        encoding = 'UTF-8'
                                    ).

    " Verify that the 'encrypted' content contains the password and original data
    DATA(lv_expected_content) = |{ lv_password }:{ lv_original_data }|.

Da `CL_ABAP_ZIP` keine native Passwortverschlüsselung bietet, wird hier eine einfache Verkettung als Demonstration verwendet. In der Praxis wäre eine robuste Verschlüsselung erforderlich.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach einem dynamisch übergebenen Feld gruppiert und die Anzahl der Einträge pro Gruppe zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole und die `GROUP BY`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY (<fs_field>)` und `COUNT(*) INTO ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_result.
    TYPES tt_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_group_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_counts) TYPE tt_group_result
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_group_field> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX 1.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_group_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Gruppierungsfeld '{ iv_group_field }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_line> GROUP BY (<fs_group_field>) INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_group_result( group_key = group_key
                                    count     = group_key->* ) TO rt_group_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv, das eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) als CSV-Datei enthält. Die interne Tabelle soll zuerst in CSV konvertiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `REDUCE` für die CSV-Konvertierung und `cl_abap_zip` zum Zippen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_sflight_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_zip_from_sflight_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights.csv'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_sflight_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_sflight_csv.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE'.
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = |
{ s }{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price }|
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_xstring(
                                EXPORTING
                                  data = lv_csv_data
                                  encoding = 'UTF-8'
                              ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      EXPORTING
        name    = iv_filename
        content = lv_csv_xstring
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) aus einer CSV-Datei, die in einem ZIP-Archiv enthalten ist. Die CSV-Datei muss zuerst dekomprimiert und dann in die interne Tabelle geparst werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_zip` zum Dekomprimieren und String-Operationen (`SPLIT`, `REDUCE`) zum Parsen der CSV-Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_read_sflight_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflight_from_zip_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename    TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights.csv'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_read_sflight_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_from_zip_csv.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( EXPORTING zip = iv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = lo_zip->get( EXPORTING name = iv_filename ).
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_and_get_string(
                                EXPORTING
                                  xdata = lv_csv_xstring
                                  encoding = 'UTF-8'
                              ).

    DATA lt_csv_lines TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT lv_csv_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_csv_lines.

    DELETE lt_csv_lines INDEX 1. "Header-Zeile entfernen

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR lv_line IN lt_csv_lines
                             LET lt_fields = VALUE string_table( )
                                 lv_carrid = ''
                                 lv_connid = ''
                                 lv_fldate = ''
                                 lv_price = '' IN
                             ( LET lv_temp_line = lv_line IN
                                 SPLIT lv_temp_line AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_fields IN
                                 lv_carrid = lt_fields[ 1 ]
                                 lv_connid = lt_fields[ 2 ]
                                 lv_fldate = lt_fields[ 3 ]
                                 lv_price = lt_fields[ 4 ] IN
                                 VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate price = lv_price ) )
                           ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    DATA lt_original_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_original_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_original_sflights.

    DATA(lo_create_zip) = NEW zcl_zip_sflight_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_create_zip->create_zip_from_sflight_csv( lt_original_sflights ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_read_sflight_csv( ).
    DATA(lt_read_sflights) = lo_cut->read_sflight_from_zip_csv( lv_zip_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_read_sflights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of read flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Read CARRID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_sflights[ 2 ]-price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Read PRICE mismatch' ).

  METHOD test_read_sflight_csv_file_not_found.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_read_sflight_csv( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>create_exception_assertion(

          method = 'READ_SFLIGHT_FROM_ZIP_CSV'
          parameters = VALUE #(
            ( name = 'IV_ZIP_XSTRING' value = REF #( lv_zip_xstring ) )
            ( name = 'IV_FILENAME' value = REF #( 'non_existent.csv' ) )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Nach dem Dekomprimieren mit `CL_ABAP_ZIP` werden die CSV-Zeilen mit `SPLIT` getrennt und dann mit einer `FOR`-Iteration in die interne Tabelle geparst. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, strukturierte Daten zu importieren.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' nach 'NEW YORK' gehen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom AND
                                          cityto   = iv_cityto ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' INTO @lv_expected_count.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' iv_cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern von internen Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und performanter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Declarative Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected_sum.
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Hier wird die Summe der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft berechnet, was eine kompakte und effiziente Lösung darstellt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste aller eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs (`CARRID`) aus `sflights`, die Flüge von 'NEW YORK' anbieten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `DISTINCT` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_from_city.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_unique_carrids = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
                                     ( carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (`PRICE`) für alle Flüge, bei denen mehr als 100 Sitze belegt sind und die Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines) ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price_for_high_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_for_high_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                           FOR flight IN lt_sflights

                                           NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) die Anzahl ihrer Flüge (`FLIGHT_COUNT`) und die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (`TOTAL_OCCUPIED_SEATS`) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF` und einer lokalen Struktur für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid             TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count       TYPE i,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = REDUCE tt_carrier_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET flight_count = lines( GROUP flight ) IN
      LET total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT s = s + member-seatsocc ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid             = flight-carrid
                                           flight_count       = flight_count
                                           total_occupied_seats = total_seats ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_summary( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_summaries) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summaries( ).

    DATA: lt_expected_summaries TYPE zcl_flight_summary=>tt_carrier_summary.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, SUM(seatsocc) AS total_occupied_seats
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_expected_summaries.

    SORT lt_actual_summaries BY carrid.
    SORT lt_expected_summaries BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_summaries ) exp = lines( lt_expected_summaries ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_summaries exp = lt_expected_summaries ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser `REDUCE`-Ausdruck nutzt die `FOR GROUPS OF` Syntax, um Daten nach `CARRID` zu gruppieren. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird dann die Anzahl der Flüge (`lines( GROUP flight )`) und die Summe der belegten Sitze (`REDUCE` für die Gruppenmitglieder) berechnet. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Art der Datenaggregation, die seit ABAP 7.50 verfügbar ist.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Data Transformation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Zielstädte (`CITYTO`) aus `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, aber nur für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'DL' (Delta Airlines) mit mehr als 200 freien Sitzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und String-Templates für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_cities_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free TYPE sflight-seatsfree
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_city_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_cities_conditionally.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, cityto, seatsfree
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_city_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE flight-carrid = iv_carrid AND flight-seatsfree > iv_min_free
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN flight-cityto ELSE |{ result }, { flight-cityto }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_string) = lo_cut->concatenate_cities_conditionally( iv_carrid = 'DL' iv_min_free = 200 ).

    DATA(lt_expected_cities) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-cityto WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT cityto FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'DL' AND seatsfree > 200 INTO TABLE @lt_expected_cities.
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = REDUCE string( INIT res = `` FOR city IN lt_expected_cities NEXT res = COND string( WHEN res IS INITIAL THEN city ELSE |{ res }, { city }| ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_string exp = lv_expected_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für die bedingte String-Verkettung. In Kombination mit String-Templates und dem `COND`-Operator kann man sehr lesbaren und effizienten Code für solche Aufgaben schreiben.
